topic-1-6.1-1.grammar.5.example.0.line.0.zh: 昨天我和铃木一起去唱卡拉OK了
topic-1-6.1-1.grammar.5.example.0.line.0.en: Yesterday I went with Suzuki to sing karaoke.

topic-1-6.1-1.grammar.5.example.0.line.1.zh: 欸，铃木？你说的那个人是我认识的人吗？
topic-1-6.1-1.grammar.5.example.0.line.1.en: Hey, Suzuki? Did you say that person I knew?

topic-1-6.1-1.grammar.5.example.1.line.0.zh: 车站附近开了一家新餐厅啊
topic-1-6.1-1.grammar.5.example.1.line.0.en: There's a new restaurant near the station.

topic-1-6.1-1.grammar.5.example.1.line.1.zh: 是啊，听说那家店又便宜又好吃。
topic-1-6.1-1.grammar.5.example.1.line.1.en: Yeah, they say it's cheap and delicious.

topic-1-6.1-1.grammar.5.example.2.line.0.zh: 还记得大约20年前全家一起去的那次旅行吗
topic-1-6.1-1.grammar.5.example.2.line.0.en: Remember that trip with the whole family about 20 years ago?

topic-1-6.1-1.grammar.5.example.2.line.1.zh: 啊，那个时候孩子们还小，挺辛苦的啊。
topic-1-6.1-1.grammar.5.example.2.line.1.en: Ah, the kids were young and hard.

topic-1-6.2-1.grammar.5.example.0.line.0.en: Contact me at the station. I'll pick you up right away.

topic-1-6.2-1.grammar.5.example.1.line.1.zh: 你问田中啊，他刚才被部长叫去会议室了。
topic-1-6.2-1.grammar.5.example.1.line.1.en: Ask Tanaka, he was called to the conference room by the Minister.

topic-1-6.2-1.grammar.5.example.2.line.0.zh: 其实我下个月要去北海道旅行
topic-1-6.2-1.grammar.5.example.2.line.0.en: I'm actually going on a trip to Hokkaido next month.

topic-1-6.2-1.grammar.5.example.2.line.1.zh: 挺好啊。不过你要去北海道的话，最好带件毛衣。
topic-1-6.2-1.grammar.5.example.2.line.1.en: Good. But if you're going to Hokkatas, you better bring a sweater.

topic-1-6.2-1.grammar.5.example.3.line.0.zh: 老师，我想高中毕业后去美国留学……
topic-1-6.2-1.grammar.5.example.3.line.0.en: Teacher, I want to study in the United States after high school...

topic-1-6.2-1.grammar.5.example.3.line.1.zh: 哦，你要去美国留学的话，那就得再多学点英语。
topic-1-6.2-1.grammar.5.example.3.line.1.en: Oh, if you're going to study in America, you have to learn more English.

topic-1-6.2-1.grammar.5.example.5.line.0.en: Hey, you want to go to "ミスド"?

topic-1-6.2-1.grammar.5.example.5.line.2.zh: 就是 Mister Donut 那家甜甜圈店啊。

topic-1-6.2-1.grammar.5.example.6.line.0.zh: 不好意思，“禁止入内”是什么意思
topic-1-6.2-1.grammar.5.example.6.line.0.en: I'm sorry, what do you mean "no entry"?

topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.0.line.0.en: For the sake of your health, it's better to quit smoking.

topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.0.line.1.zh: 也是。不过就是一直戒不掉……。

topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.1.line.0.en: Every day you read, Kanji can't remember.

topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.1.line.1.zh: 要是总记不住的话，最好每天多写几遍。
topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.1.line.1.en: If you can't, you'd better write a few more times a day.

topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.2.line.0.en: I'd like to see the choreographers...

topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.2.line.1.zh: 那你可以问问佐藤老师。他经常去看，应该能给你讲得挺明白。
topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.2.line.1.en: Then you can ask Mr. Sato. He often does. He should be able to make it clear to you.

topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.4.line.0.zh: 明天开会的资料准备好了吗
topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.4.line.0.en: Are you ready for the meeting tomorrow?

topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.4.line.1.zh: 不好意思，还没。我会在明天之前先复印好的。
topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.4.line.1.en: Excuse me, not yet. I'll copy it by tomorrow.

topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.6.line.1.zh: 没有，还没开始学呢。正准备现在开始。
topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.6.line.1.en: No, not yet. Ready to start now.

topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.7.line.0.zh: 你还在打那份深夜工吗
topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.7.line.0.en: Are you still doing that late-night work?

topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.7.line.1.en: No, it's a little hard to eat.

topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.8.line.1.zh: 嗯，还在开，不过我想也快结束了。
topic-1-6.2-2.grammar.6.example.8.line.1.en: Well, still open, but I think it's almost over.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.2.grammar.0.zh: 你认识一个叫山田的人吗？
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.2.grammar.0.en: Do you know a man called Yamada?

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.3.grammar.2.en: Yesterday I went to Hanayama Park.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.3.grammar.2.zh: 明天我要去看横滨的烟花大会。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.3.grammar.2.en: I'm going to the fireworks conference in Yokohama tomorrow.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.3.grammar.2.zh: 啊，那个烟花大会非常有名吧。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.3.grammar.2.en: Ah, the fireworks conference is very famous.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.3.grammar.3.zh: 也就是说，那个说法是假的，对吧。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.3.grammar.3.en: In other words, it's a fake, right?

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.3.grammar.3.zh: 那就是说，肉和鱼都不吃吗？
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.3.grammar.3.en: Does that mean that neither meat nor fish eat?

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.3.grammar.6.zh: 负责人已经去会场了吧。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.3.grammar.6.en: The person in charge has already gone to the conference room.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.3.grammar.6.zh: 是的，收到联系说正在会场检查资料。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.3.grammar.6.en: Yes, they have been contacted and said they are checking the information at the meeting site.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.dialog.zh: 哎，要不要跟社团的大家一起去旅行？我要是去美国留学了，就没那么容易跟大家见面了……去年去了京都之后，今年哪儿都没去。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.dialog.en: Hey, shall we all go on a trip with the club? Once I leave to study in the States I won't see everyone so easily... I went to Kyoto last year and haven't been anywhere since.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.dialog.zh: 不好意思，工作单位都还没定下来，哪还有心思去旅行啊。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.dialog.en: Sorry, but my job isn't even settled yet — a trip is the last thing on my mind.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.dialog.zh: 这样啊……你是想进游戏公司吧？怎么样？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.dialog.en: I see... You wanted to get into a game company, right? How's it going?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.dialog.zh: 嗯……信息倒是收集了不少，可就是很难……麻烦的是，这个行业哪儿都只招“若干名”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.dialog.en: Hmm. I've been gathering plenty of information, but it's tough... The trouble is, in this industry everyone hires just a handful of people.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.dialog.zh: 诶，这么热门的行业，招聘反而这么少啊。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.dialog.en: Wow. For such a popular industry, there are surprisingly few openings.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.dialog.zh: 只要有招聘我全都投了，自我介绍不知道写了多少遍。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.dialog.en: I've applied everywhere that's hiring — I can't count how many times I've written that self-pitch.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.dialog.zh: 两个朋友在聊找工作。先听一遍整体语气，再看每个语法点怎么在对话里落地。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.dialog.en: Two friends talking about the job hunt. Read for the overall tone first, then see how each grammar point lands in the exchange.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 放学去唱K吗？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Karaoke after school?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 哪还有心思唱K！得写报告，明天就截止了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Karaoke is the last thing on my mind! I have to write a report — it's due tomorrow.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 海水浴怎么样？玩得开心吗？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: How was the beach? Fun?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 人太多了，根本没法好好游。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: It was so crowded I could hardly swim at all.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 部长，朋友要来东京，下周我想请一周假……
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Sir, a friend is coming to Tokyo, so I'd like a week off next week...

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 这么忙的时候，你哪还有空休假。看看现在什么状况。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: We're this busy and you're asking for leave? Look at the situation.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 那件大衣真好看。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: That coat is lovely.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 那是我妈30年前穿的，可这么算起来设计也不算过时吧？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: My mother wore it 30 years ago, but it doesn't look dated for that, does it?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.dialog.zh: 真难啊。也不是只要有干劲就能被录用吧。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.dialog.en: That's rough. It's not as if enthusiasm alone gets you hired.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.dialog.zh: 就是啊。要是没有招聘，想努力都没处使……要是一直死盯着游戏公司，折腾半天最后哪儿都没进去，那可怎么办啊……
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.dialog.en: Exactly. If nobody's hiring, there's nothing I can do... I keep wondering what happens if I stick to game companies, go through all that trouble, and end up with no job at all.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.dialog.zh: 别想这些。得相信自己能成。至少学长也是，明明觉得肯定没戏，还是说先投了再说，最后不也进那家公司了吗。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.dialog.en: Don't think like that. You have to believe you'll make it. My senior thought he had no chance either, but he said he'd send it in anyway — and he ended up at that company.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.dialog.zh: 所以说，总之别放弃，坚持到最后吧。好吗。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.dialog.en: So anyway, don't give up — let's push through to the end. Right?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.dialog.zh: 两个朋友在聊找工作。先听一遍整体语气，再看每个语法点怎么在对话里落地。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.dialog.en: Two friends talking about the job hunt. Read for the overall tone first, then see how each grammar point lands in the exchange.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 报告写完了吗？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Finished the report?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 快了。再把最后的总结写完就结束了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Almost. Once I write the final summary I'm done.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 那辆车设计真漂亮。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: That car has a lovely design.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 车嘛，能跑就行了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: It's a car — as long as it runs, it's fine.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 为什么一周都不联系我？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Why didn't you contact me for a whole week?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 对不起，手机丢了，想联系也没法联系。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Sorry. I lost my phone, so there was no way to reach you.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 爸，我学分没过，得再读一年二年级了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Dad, I failed a course and have to repeat my second year.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 什么？到处玩到最后留级，你在想什么。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: What? You played around and ended up repeating a year — what were you thinking?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 真是抱歉。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: I'm so sorry.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 什么，还笑！道歉的时候不该嘻嘻哈哈的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: What are you grinning for! You don't smirk when you apologize.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 这么忙，看看情况再想吧？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: You're busy — why not see how things go first?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 今天负责人不在，就先拜托一下试试？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: The person in charge isn't in today, so why not just ask anyway?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.dialog.zh: 终于到明天了。第一次做汇报。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.dialog.en: Tomorrow's the day. Your first presentation.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.dialog.zh: 嗯。进公司这五年，就因为没经验吃了不少苦。不过是你跟我说过，不要放弃自己的梦想。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.dialog.en: Yeah. Five years at the company, and I struggled precisely because I had no experience. But you were the one who told me not to give up on my dream.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.dialog.zh: 一开始跟同期进公司的人比，知识和技术的底子都不够。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.dialog.en: At first I was behind the people who joined with me — less knowledge, fewer skills.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.dialog.zh: 被部长打回重做好多次，可我心想怎么能认输，就这么撑下来了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.dialog.en: The boss made me redo things over and over, but I kept telling myself I wasn't going to lose, and I pushed through.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.dialog.zh: 部长是希望你能早一天独当一面啊。所谓上司就是这么回事。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.dialog.en: He wanted you doing professional work as soon as possible. That's what a boss is.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.dialog.zh: 两个人聊这五年怎么熬过来的。先读整体语气，再看每个语法点落在哪一句。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.dialog.en: Two friends on how they got through five hard years. Read for the tone first, then see where each grammar point lands.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 学长，去面试是不是还得买包和大衣？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Do I have to buy a bag and coat for the interview?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 用不着特意买。平时又不穿，先凑合现在的鞋去吧？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: No need to go out of your way. You won't use them normally — just make do with your shoes for now.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 我明确拒绝了，他不会再来说借钱的事了吧。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: I turned him down flat, so he won't ask for money again.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 被拒一次他就会死心？那家伙肯定会再来的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: You think one refusal stops him? He'll be back for sure.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 真的吗？这种事我实在没法相信。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Really? I can't believe that.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 真的。我怎么会撒谎。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: It's true. Why would I lie?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 这次打工就是把它装进袋子？听起来很轻松。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: This part-time job is just bagging these? Looks easy.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 轻松什么呀，一天要装好几千个。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Easy? I bag thousands a day.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 老师，就因为山下，我们这组的作品还没完成。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Sir, because of Yamashita our group's piece isn't finished.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 有困难时互相帮忙才叫朋友。你去帮帮他。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Helping each other when someone's stuck — that's what friends are. Go help him.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 日本队能夺冠吧？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Japan will win it all, right?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 夺冠！？那也太指望过头了吧。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Win it all? That's expecting too much.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.dialog.zh: 部长正因为是为我着想，才说得那么严。他的心情我不是不理解，可当时真的难受。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.dialog.en: He was strict with me precisely because he cared. It wasn't that I couldn't understand how he felt — it was just hard.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.dialog.zh: 不过既然已经决定了，就想着能拼多少拼多少……
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.dialog.en: But I'd already decided, so I thought I'd do as much as I could...

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.dialog.zh: 是啊。你那么努力嘛。我一直觉得总有一天会被认可的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.dialog.en: Of course. You worked that hard. I always thought you'd be recognized someday.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.dialog.zh: 也为了一直支持我的你，明天绝不能搞砸。到这一步，就只有相信自己往前走了。就当自己是好莱坞明星，拿出最帅的样子来做汇报。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.dialog.en: For your sake too, after all your support, I can't afford to fail tomorrow. At this point all I can do is trust myself and go. I'll present as if I were a Hollywood star — as sharp as I can.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.dialog.zh: 两个人聊这五年怎么熬过来的。先读整体语气，再看每个语法点落在哪一句。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.dialog.en: Two friends on how they got through five hard years. Read for the tone first, then see where each grammar point lands.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 您喜欢喝酒吗？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Do you like a drink?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 不算特别喜欢，但也不是不能喝。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Not especially, but it's not that I can't.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 这个妆是不是太浓了？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Is this makeup too much?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 嗯……也不能说不浓，不过是派对嘛，没关系吧？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Hmm. It's not that it isn't bold, but it's a party — it's fine, isn't it?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 买这么多特产？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Buying that many souvenirs?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 因为这个人偶和这个点心，不在日本就买不到嘛。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Well, this doll and these sweets — you can't get them outside Japan.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 我想看那部音乐剧，可票一直买不到。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: I want to see that musical but tickets are impossible to get.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 这样啊。那部剧很火嘛。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: I see. It's popular, after all.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 表格只要输入公式马上就出来了……
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: A spreadsheet would do it instantly with a formula...

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 可自己算更快嘛。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: But calculating by hand is faster for me.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: B，你脸色很差。今天别硬撑，早点回去吧？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: You look pale. Why not go home early today?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 可是下午有个重要会议，我走不了啊……
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: But there's an important meeting this afternoon — I can't just leave.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 现在订机票不可能了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Booking a flight now is impossible.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 想想办法吧。客户那边系统出了故障，我不去不行。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Please work something out. Our client has a system failure — I have to be there.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 今天我请。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: I'm treating today.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 不不，那怎么行。今天不能让您请。是给学长庆祝，我们出钱。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: No, not at all. I can't let you pay today — it's a celebration for you, so we're covering it.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.dialog.zh: 这家自助餐真不错。上次去了一趟，菜单多得简直没法形容，从披萨、意大利面到土豆炖肉、烤鱼、北京烤鸭，日式、西式、中式全都有。而且全是刚出锅的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.dialog.en: This all-you-can-eat place was great. I went the other day — the menu was so huge I can't even describe it. Pizza, spaghetti, nikujaga, grilled fish, Peking duck — Japanese, Western, Chinese, everything. And all of it freshly made.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.dialog.zh: 啊，这家现在很火呢。牛排也挺好吃的……
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.dialog.en: Oh, that place is popular now. The steak's pretty good too...

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.dialog.zh: 所以大家一起去吧。我打算空一顿不吃再去。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.dialog.en: So let's all go. I'm planning to skip a meal before we do.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.dialog.zh: 小林你这说的什么话。胃的大小是会随饭量变化的呀。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.dialog.en: Kobayashi, what are you talking about? Your stomach's size adjusts to how much you eat — that's how it works.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.dialog.zh: 原来是这样。难怪上次吃不下，是胃变小了啊。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.dialog.en: Is that so. No wonder I couldn't eat much last time — my stomach had shrunk.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.dialog.zh: 就是啊。空着肚子去，别说多吃了，反而会比平时吃得更少。连这个都不知道，小林你算是自助餐新手。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.dialog.en: Exactly. Go hungry and far from eating more, you'll eat less than usual. Not even knowing that — Kobayashi, you're a beginner at buffets.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.dialog.zh: 两个朋友聊自助餐的吃法。先读整体语气，再看每个语法点落在哪一句。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.dialog.en: Two friends on how to work an all-you-can-eat buffet. Read for the tone first, then see where each grammar point lands.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 昨天的徒步比想象中辛苦多了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Yesterday's hike was harder than I expected.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 真的，一连走了五个小时没停。累得没法形容，最后感觉一步都迈不动了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Tell me about it — five straight hours of walking. I was tired past describing; by the end I honestly couldn't take another step.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 这个包子还热着呢。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: These buns are still warm.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 嗯，我买的刚出锅的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Yeah — I bought them straight out of the steamer.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 跟你说，我姐的孩子把在幼儿园刚学会的歌和舞表演给我看了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Hey, my sister's kid showed me a song and dance she'd just learned at kindergarten.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 那肯定很可爱吧。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: That must have been adorable.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 这台电脑啊，动不动就死机。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: This computer freezes up constantly.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 那换一台呗？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Then why not replace it?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 这巧克力一颗要一千日元呢。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: These chocolates are a thousand yen apiece.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 诶！真的？那难怪好吃啊。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: What? Really? Well, no wonder they're good.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 这条路弯多视野差，路灯又少……
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: This road has so many curves you can't see ahead, and hardly any streetlights...

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 真是。难怪事故多。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: True. No wonder there are so many accidents.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 我父母反对我换工作……
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: My parents are against me changing jobs...

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 所以你就还在犹豫啊。你说过马上就换的，我还纳闷怎么回事呢。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: So that's why you're still hesitating. You said you'd switch right away — I was wondering what happened.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 旅行怎么样？冲绳已经很热了吧？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: How was the trip? Okinawa must be hot already.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 没有。被雨淋了，别说热了，冷得要命，差点感冒。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: No — we got rained on. Far from hot, it was freezing. I nearly caught a cold.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 听说你开始跑步了？瘦了吗？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: I hear you took up jogging. Lost weight?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 这个嘛……运动完不是会饿吗？别说瘦了，反而胖了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Well... exercising makes you hungry, right? Far from losing, I gained.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 做一个菜都要花这么久，一个人生活恐怕不行吧？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: If one dish takes me this long, living alone is hopeless, isn't it?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 习惯了就能快起来，没问题的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: You'll speed up once you're used to it — don't worry.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.zh: 自助餐是跟店家的一场较量。经验和技巧都要。饮料少喝，挑贵的下手。还有，菜按自己能吃的量取，慢慢吃。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.en: A buffet is a contest with the restaurant. It takes experience and technique. Go easy on the drinks. Aim for the expensive stuff. And take only what you can eat, and eat slowly.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.zh: 干嘛要慢啊。在自助餐厅装斯文有什么用？总之就得一个劲儿地吃。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.en: Why slowly? There's no point acting refined at a buffet, is there? You've just got to keep eating.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.zh: 偏偏是新手才这么说。自助餐是马拉松。想回本，就得一直吃到最后一刻，中途不能乱节奏。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.en: It's always the beginners who say that. A buffet is a marathon. If you want your money's worth, keep eating to the very end without breaking your pace.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.zh: 哦，这样啊。你怎么这么清楚？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.en: Wow, really. How do you know all this?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.zh: 这附近的自助餐厅，我可是家家都去过了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.en: I've been to every single buffet around here.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.zh: 还有，有的店剩下就要罚款，得小心。上周跟朋友去吃烤肉自助，差点就被罚钱了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.en: And some places fine you for leftovers, so you have to be careful. Last week I went to a yakiniku buffet with a friend and nearly got fined.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.zh: 我拼尽最后一点力气吃掉了。想着与其交罚款，还不如硬撑一下。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.en: I dug deep and finished it myself. I figured putting in the effort was far better than paying a fine...

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.zh: 有大田在就安心了。我去凑人，一定一起去啊。拜托啦！
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.en: It's reassuring to have you along, Ota. I'll round up the members — we're definitely going together. Count on it!

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.zh: 两个朋友聊自助餐的吃法。先读整体语气，再看每个语法点落在哪一句。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.dialog.en: Two friends on how to work an all-you-can-eat buffet. Read for the tone first, then see where each grammar point lands.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 那家伙在老师面前装乖，可打扫也偷懒，作业还抄别人的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: He plays the good boy in front of the teacher, but he skips cleaning and copies his homework.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 真是的，气人。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Honestly, it makes me furious.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 赶上末班车太好了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Good thing you caught the last train.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 嗯。要是没坐上这趟，就得走回去了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Yeah. Miss this one and I'd have had to walk home.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 相机坏了，修理费要一万五。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: My camera broke and the repair is fifteen thousand yen.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 花一万五，还不如买个新的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: For that much you'd be better off buying a new one.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 报告赶不上截止了，怎么办。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: I won't finish the report by the deadline. What do I do?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 急成这样，还不如早点开始写。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: If you're going to panic like that, you should have started earlier.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 老师，我爸说要是不能喝他爱喝的酒，那还不如不治了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Sir, my father says if he can't have his usual drink, he'd rather not be treated at all.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 那可真难办。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: That is a problem.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 快冬天了。我怕冷。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Winter's coming. I can't stand the cold.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 比起热，冷还好些。冷的时候多穿点就行了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Cold beats hot — you can always put on more clothes.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 他不管我做什么都一声不吭地吃完。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Whatever I cook, he just eats it without a word.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 肯吃就不错了，总比被说“难吃”强吧。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: At least he eats it — better than being told it's awful.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 加班太多，真受不了啊，前辈。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: All this overtime is wearing me down, senpai.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 话是这么说，可现在不景气，得想着有活干就不错了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Maybe, but times are bad — you have to count yourself lucky just to have work.

katakana-renshucho.instruction.zh: 根据释义，用片假名写出本课教材中的外来语词形，平假名不算对。注意长音符号和小写假名。
katakana-renshucho.instruction.en: Write the loanword from this lesson in katakana; hiragana is marked wrong. Pay attention to long vowel marks and small kana.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.word.7.meaning.en: Mr.; Ms. (polite suffix after a name)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.word.8.meaning.zh: 亲昵称呼后缀，常用于孩子或亲近的人
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.word.8.meaning.en: affectionate name suffix, often used for children or close friends

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.word.9.meaning.zh: 称呼后缀，常用于男性同辈或晚辈
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.word.9.meaning.en: name suffix used for juniors or peers, often male

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.word.11.meanin.en: teacher; doctor (also used as a title)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.word.27.meanin.zh: 多大年纪（询问年龄的礼貌说法）

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.word.32.meanin.en: nice to meet you; I'm glad to make your acquaintance

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.word.33.meanin.en: Nice to meet you; I look forward to working with you.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.mean.zh: 「は」先把话题点出来，「です」再给判断，一句话说清「A 是 B」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.mean.en: は sets the topic and です carries the judgement: one pattern for "A is B".

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.form.zh: N1 は N2 です（否定：N2 じゃありません）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.form.en: N1 は N2 です (negative: N2 じゃありません)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.usag.zh: 自我介绍、报职业国籍都用它。日语没有「是」这个字，判断全压在句尾的「です」上，句尾一变整句就变。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.usag.en: Used for introductions, jobs and nationality. Japanese has no word for "is"; the ending です does that work.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.pitf.zh: 「は」读 wa，不读 ha。说自己的事不必句句「私は」，主语常直接省掉更自然。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.pitf.en: は is read wa, not ha. Drop 私は when talking about yourself; it usually sounds more natural.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.exam.en: Mr. Miller is a bank clerk.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.mean.zh: 把「です」换成「じゃありません」，同一句话立刻变成「A 不是 B」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.mean.en: Swap です for じゃありません and the same sentence turns into "A is not B".

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.form.zh: N1 は N2 じゃありません（正式：ではありません）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.form.en: N1 は N2 じゃありません (formal: ではありません)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.usag.zh: 否认身份、国籍、所属。日常口语用「じゃ」，邮件、敬语、正式场合换成「では」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.usag.en: For denying identity, nationality or affiliation. Use じゃ in speech, では in mail and formal settings.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.pitf.zh: 否定只加在句尾，别加在名词前：「学生じゃありません」对，「じゃない学生です」是另一个句型。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.pitf.en: Negation sits at the end, not before the noun: 学生じゃありません is right, じゃない学生です is a different pattern.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.exam.zh: 山田先生不是公司职员。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.exam.en: Mr. Yamada is not a company employee.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.2.mean.zh: 句尾加「か」，陈述句就变成问句，语气仍然客气。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.2.mean.en: Add か at the end and a statement becomes a polite question.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.2.form.zh: N1 は N2 ですか（答：はい、そうです／いいえ、ちがいます）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.2.form.en: N1 は N2 ですか (answer: はい、そうです / いいえ、ちがいます)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.2.usag.zh: 问身份、问所属。日语问句靠「か」收尾，不写问号也成立；口语里常省掉「か」，只把句尾读升调。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.2.usag.en: For asking who or what someone is. か marks the question even without a question mark; in speech か is often dropped and the rise carries it.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.2.pitf.zh: 「か」后面不要再加「です」。回答「是的」用「はい、そうです」比重复整句自然。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.2.pitf.en: Don't add です after か. Answer with はい、そうです rather than repeating the whole sentence.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.2.exam.zh: 田中先生是公司职员吗？
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.2.exam.en: Is Mr. Tanaka a company employee?

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.3.mean.zh: 「も」顶替「は」，表示「也一样」，把前面刚提过的内容整块接过来。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.3.mean.en: も replaces は to mean "too", inheriting whatever was just said.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.3.form.zh: N1 も N2 です（否定：も～じゃありません）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.3.form.en: N1 も N2 です (negative: も～じゃありません)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.3.usag.zh: 附和对方、补充同类信息时用。「私も」两个字就能代替一整句。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.3.usag.en: For agreeing or adding to what someone said. 私も alone can replace a whole sentence.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.3.pitf.zh: 「も」不能和「は」叠用，「私はも」是错的；要强调就单独说「私も」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.3.pitf.en: も never stacks on は: 私はも is wrong. Say 私も on its own.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.3.exam.en: Mr. Tanaka is a student too.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.3.exam.zh: 我也是 IMC 的职员。

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.4.mean.zh: 「の」把两个名词粘在一起，前一个说明后一个的归属、单位或类别。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.4.mean.en: の glues two nouns together: the first qualifies the second.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.4.form.zh: N1 の N2（私の本／IMC の社員／日本語の辞書）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.4.form.en: N1 の N2 (私の本 / IMC の社員 / 日本語の辞書)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.4.usag.zh: 中文的「的」大多对应「の」，但单位、国家、材料这类关系日语更爱用「の」，不要硬翻成「的」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.4.usag.en: Most Chinese 的 maps to の, but companies, countries and materials take の where Chinese would not use 的.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.4.pitf.zh: 一句里「の」连用三次以上就该拆句，「私の友達の田中さんの本」听起来像绕口令。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.4.pitf.en: Avoid chaining three の in one phrase; 私の友達の田中さんの本 sounds like a tongue twister.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.ques.zh: 礼貌地介绍自己的职业：我是银行职员。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.ques.en: Introduce yourself politely: I'm a banker.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.ques.zh: 名词直接接です。ます接动词的ます形词干；这里不加を或の。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.ques.en: A noun connects directly to です. ます attaches to a verb stem; neither を nor の is needed here.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.ques.zh: 澄清身份：我不是学生，是公司职员。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.ques.en: Clarifying identity: I am not a student, I'm an employee of the company.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.ques.zh: 名词的礼貌否定用じゃありません／ではありません；くありません用于い形容词。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.ques.en: Negate a noun with じゃありません or the more formal ではありません. ～くありません is used with i-adjectives, not nouns.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.ques.zh: 初次见面，不知道对方是不是医生。选出询问身份的一句。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.ques.en: On meeting someone for the first time, ask whether they are a doctor.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.ques.zh: 需要提问，而不是替对方作判断。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.ques.en: Questions need to be asked, not judged.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.ques.zh: 礼貌问句在です后加か。「医者です」是陈述；否定和过去式都没有询问当前身份。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.ques.en: ですか forms a polite question. 医者です is an affirmative statement; it is neither negative nor past tense.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.ques.zh: B也来自中国，要表达“我也是”。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.ques.en: B is also from China, to say “Me too”.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.ques.zh: 前后国籍相同，用も表示“也”；の连接名词，を标记宾语，で不能在此表示“也”。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.ques.en: The nationality is the same before and after, using も for "also" ; の connects noun, を tags for guests, and で cannot be used here for "also".

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.ques.zh: 说明自己是樱花大学的学生。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.ques.en: She is a student of Sakura University.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.ques.zh: 大学の学生用の连接所属单位与身份；大学に学生です不成立。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.0.ques.en: 大学の学生 uses の to connect an institution and a role. 大学に学生です is not grammatical.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.ques.zh: 你不是学生，而是公司职员。选出前后一致的回答。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.ques.en: You're not a student, you're an employee of the company. Choose a consistent answer.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.ques.zh: 先用いいえ否定“是学生”，再说明是公司职员。回答必须对应对方问的身份，不能把はい当成通用开场白。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.1.grammar.1.ques.en: First use いいえ to deny being a student, then explain that you are a company employee. Answer the identity asked about; はい is not a general opening phrase.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.word.3.meaning.zh: 这个～（靠近说话人，后接名词）

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.word.4.meaning.en: that ... (near the listener; before a noun)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.word.37.meanin.en: so; like that; that is right

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.word.38.meanin.en: to be wrong; to be incorrect

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.word.40.meanin.zh: 那个……；嗯……（搭话或犹豫时用）

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.word.41.meanin.en: Just a small token of my appreciation.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.word.42.meanin.en: Please; go ahead; here you are.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.word.43.meanin.zh: 谢谢；多谢（此处用于致谢）

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.word.45.meanin.zh: 今后要麻烦您多多关照
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.word.45.meanin.en: Thank you in advance for your help.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.word.46.meanin.zh: 我也请您多关照（回应对方的问候）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.word.46.meanin.en: Likewise; it is a pleasure to meet you too.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.mean.zh: これ指自己手边，それ指对方手边，あれ指离双方都远的东西。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.mean.en: これ is near you, それ is near the listener, あれ is far from both.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.form.zh: これ／それ／あれ は N です
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.form.en: これ／それ／あれ は N です

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.usag.zh: 指着东西问「这是什么」。距离感是这三个词的分水岭，选错词对方会去看错东西。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.usag.en: Used to point at things. Distance decides which word; the wrong one sends the listener's eyes elsewhere.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.pitf.zh: 中文「这个」不分远近，日语必须按说话人和听话人的位置选；拿不准时先用「これ」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.pitf.en: Chinese 这个 ignores distance; Japanese does not. When unsure, start with これ.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.exam.en: That building over there belongs to the company.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.1.mean.zh: この／その／あの后面必须跟名词，是「这个＋东西」的形容词用法。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.1.mean.en: この／その／あの must be followed by a noun, like an adjective.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.1.form.zh: この／その／あの＋N（不能单独使用）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.1.form.en: この／その／あの + noun (never on its own)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.1.usag.zh: 「この本」「その傘」，指认具体物品时比「これ」更顺，因为名词已经点明了是什么。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.1.usag.en: この本, その傘 — smoother than これ when the noun is already known.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.1.pitf.zh: 「このは私のです」是错的；后面没有名词就必须用「これ」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.1.pitf.en: このは私のです is wrong; with no noun following, use これ.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.mean.zh: 用「の」说明东西的内容或用途：这是「关于电脑」的书。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.mean.en: の marks what a thing is about or for: a book on computers.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.form.zh: これは N1 の N2 です
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.form.en: これは N1 の N2 です

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.usag.zh: 说明物品类别、内容、归属。中文说「电脑书」，日语说「パソコンの本」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.usag.en: For naming a thing's field or purpose. Chinese says 电脑书; Japanese says パソコンの本.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.pitf.zh: 「の」不只是「的」：「日本語の辞書」是日语词典，重点在内容而不在所属。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.pitf.en: の is not only possessive: 日本語の辞書 is a dictionary of Japanese, about content, not ownership.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.exam.zh: 这是一本关于电脑的书。

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.3.mean.zh: 疑问词「だれ」插在「の」前面，直接问东西的主人是谁。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.3.mean.en: だれ slots in before の to ask who owns something.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.3.form.zh: これは だれの N ですか（答：～のです）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.3.form.en: これは だれの N ですか (answer: ～のです)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.3.usag.zh: 捡到东西、确认物品归属时用。回答可以只说「私のです」，不必重复名词。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.3.usag.en: For lost property or checking whose thing it is. The answer can be just 私のです.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.3.pitf.zh: 问「谁」用「だれ」，问「哪个」用「どの」；「だれのかばん」中间不能插「は」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.3.pitf.en: Use だれ for who and どの for which; don't insert は inside だれのかばん.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.4.mean.zh: 用「そう」代替前面整句内容，回答「是的」或「不是」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.4.mean.en: そう stands in for the whole previous sentence, answering yes or no.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.4.form.zh: はい、そうです／いいえ、そうじゃありません
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.4.form.en: はい、そうです / いいえ、そうじゃありません

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.4.usag.zh: 回答「N ですか」最省事的说法，省掉重复整句的力气。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.4.usag.en: The shortest way to answer N ですか without repeating the sentence.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.4.pitf.zh: 「いいえ、そうじゃありません」和「いいえ、ちがいます」都可以；纠正对方说错的事实时更常说「ちがいます」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.4.pitf.en: Both いいえ、そうじゃありません and いいえ、ちがいます work; ちがいます is more common when correcting a wrong fact.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.ques.zh: 包在你手里，靠近说话人；指着它说“这是我的包”。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.ques.en: The bag is in your hand, near the talker; pointing at it says, "This is my bag."

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.ques.zh: 靠近说话人的物品用これ；それ通常靠近听话人，あれ离双方都远，どれ用于询问。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.ques.en: Goods close to the talker are used by これ; それ is usually close to the listener, あれ is far from both parties and どれ is used for questioning.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.ques.zh: 指着对方手边的那块表。空格后已有名词時計。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.ques.en: Point to the watch on the other side. There are noun hours after spaces.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.ques.zh: その必须接名词：その時計。それ本身代替物品，不能说それ時計。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.0.ques.en: その must precede a noun: その時計. それ replaces an object by itself; それ時計 is not grammatical.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.ques.zh: 这本书介绍做菜，说明书的内容。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.ques.en: It's about cooking, about the content of the book.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.ques.zh: 料理の本中の说明内容类别，不只表示所有者；料理を本です不成立。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.ques.en: In 料理の本, の identifies the subject matter, rather than necessarily an owner. 料理を本です is not grammatical.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.ques.zh: 捡到一把伞，想问“这是谁的伞”。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.ques.en: Picked up an umbrella and asked, "Whose umbrella is this?"

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.ques.zh: 询问所有者用だれの＋名词；だれ单独询问人，不能直接接傘。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.ques.en: Ask who owns something with だれの＋noun. だれ alone asks about a person and cannot directly precede 傘.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.4.ques.zh: 对方把你的记事本当成了词典。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.4.ques.en: They used your notebook as a dictionary.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.4.ques.zh: いいえ后否定对方的判断，再补充正确物品。そうです会确认错误判断。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.4.ques.en: いいえ They then denied each other's judgement and added the correct items. そうです Will confirm the error of judgment.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.ques.zh: 省去已知的名词本，回答“是田中的”。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.ques.en: Save the known noun Ben, answer "It's in the field."

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.ques.zh: 所属的の后可以省略已知物品：田中さんの（本）です。省掉の会变成“是田中本人”。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.2.grammar.2.ques.en: After possessive の, a known object can be omitted: 田中さんの（本）です. Omitting の instead identifies Tanaka himself.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.word.5.meaning.zh: 远处那边；那位（礼貌说法）

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.mean.zh: ここ＝这里（自己附近），そこ＝那里（对方附近），あそこ＝那边（双方都远）。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.mean.en: ここ is here, そこ is there by the listener, あそこ is over there.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.form.zh: ここ／そこ／あそこ は N です
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.form.en: ここ／そこ／あそこ は N です

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.usag.zh: 介绍场所、指路。和「これ」系列一样，按距离分三档，选词即选位置。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.usag.en: For introducing places and giving directions. Like これ, distance picks the word.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.pitf.zh: 指着地图上的位置常说「ここ」，哪怕实际距离很远，因为手指就在那儿。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.pitf.en: On a map people say ここ even for distant places, because the finger is right there.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.1.mean.zh: 主题是人或物，答案落在场所：「电梯在那边」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.1.mean.en: The topic is a thing or person; the answer is where it is.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.1.form.zh: N は ここ／そこ／あそこ です
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.1.form.en: N は ここ／そこ／あそこ です

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.1.usag.zh: 回答「どこですか」。主语提前、场所放句尾，是日语信息排列的常态。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.1.usag.en: The reply to どこですか. Topic first, place last — the usual Japanese word order.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.1.pitf.zh: 别按中文语序说「あそこはエレベーターです」，那是在介绍「那边是什么」，不是回答「电梯在哪」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.1.pitf.en: Don't flip it: あそこはエレベーターです answers "what is over there", not "where is the elevator".

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.2.mean.zh: 「どこ」问场所，和「は」配合，把要找的东西先提出来。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.2.mean.en: どこ asks where; with は the thing being looked for comes first.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.2.form.zh: N は どこですか（礼貌：どちらですか）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.2.form.en: N は どこですか (polite: どちらですか)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.2.usag.zh: 在店里、楼里找东西找地方都用它。对客人、上级换成「どちら」，语气立刻客气。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.2.usag.en: For finding things and places indoors. Switch to どちら with customers or superiors.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.2.pitf.zh: 「どちら」既问方向也问场所，比「どこ」客气；接待客人时别用「どこ」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.2.pitf.en: どちら covers direction and place and is politer than どこ; avoid どこ when serving a customer.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.3.mean.zh: 「ここ」系列的礼貌版，除了场所还能指方向和人。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.3.mean.en: The polite version of ここ — places, directions and people.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.3.form.zh: こちら／そちら／あちら／どちら
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.3.form.en: こちら／そちら／あちら／どちら

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.3.usag.zh: 接待、打电话、指路时用它更得体；「こちらは田中さんです」还能用来介绍人。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.3.usag.en: Standard for reception, phone calls and directions; こちらは田中さんです also introduces a person.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.3.pitf.zh: 对客人别说「ここは受付です」，换成「こちらが受付です」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.3.pitf.en: Don't say ここは受付です to a guest; say こちらが受付です.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.3.exam.en: The conference room is this way.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.4.mean.zh: 「いくら」问价钱，和中文「多少钱」一一对应。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.4.mean.en: いくら asks the price, exactly like 多少钱.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.4.form.zh: N は いくらですか
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.4.form.en: N は いくらですか

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.4.usag.zh: 购物、问费用都用它。回答直接给数字加「円」，不必再说整句。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.4.usag.en: For shopping and costs. The answer is just a number plus 円.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.4.pitf.zh: 问「几个」用「いくつ」，问价格只能用「いくら」，别混。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.4.pitf.en: いくつ asks how many; only いくら asks how much money.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.4.exam.en: This umbrella is a thousand yen.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.ques.zh: 你站在食堂里面，向新同学介绍“这里是食堂”。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.ques.en: You're standing in the canteen and you're telling your new classmates, "This is the canteen."

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.ques.zh: 场所用ここ；これ代指物品，这里不使用物品指示词。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.ques.en: The site uses ここ; これ for objects, which are not indicated here.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.ques.zh: 接待处就在听话人站的地方，要说“接待处在那里”。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.ques.en: The reception office is at the listening station, where it says: “The reception office is there”.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.ques.zh: 说明地点用そこ；それ不能代替场所，其余选项也不能完成本句。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.ques.en: Description of location with そこ; それ is not a substitute for the site and the rest of the options cannot be completed.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.ques.zh: 询问地点用どこ；だれ问人，いくら问价钱，何時问时间。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.ques.en: Use どこ to ask where, だれ to ask who, いくら to ask the price, and 何時 to ask the time.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.3.ques.zh: 你为客人指路，用礼貌的方向表达。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.3.ques.en: You point the way for the guests, in polite directions.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.3.ques.zh: こちら可礼貌地指方向和场所，直接接です。この后面必须有名词。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.3.ques.en: こちら refers politely to directions and places, directly to です. この must be followed by noun.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.ques.zh: 根据店员的金额回答，补全询价句。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.ques.en: Answers based on the amount of money paid by the clerk, completes the request for quotation.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.ques.zh: いくら询问价格，与三千円这个金额回答对应。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.0.ques.en: いくら asks for the price, which corresponds to the sum of 3,000 yen.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.2.ques.zh: 对方在问位置，选出直接回答地点的一句。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.2.ques.en: At the point of question, the other party selects the sentence that answers directly to the place.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.2.ques.zh: 二階表示楼层地点；二時是时刻，二千円是金额，二人是人数。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.3.grammar.2.ques.en: Two steps is a floor location; two thousand is the amount and two are the number.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.word.0.meaning.en: to wake up; to be awake

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.word.1.meaning.en: to go to bed; to lie in bed

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.word.3.meaning.en: to rest; to have a break

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.word.5.meaning.en: to end; to come to an end

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.word.38.meanin.en: That’s tough, isn’t it? (used when expressing sympathy)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.word.40.meanin.en: the phone number you asked for

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.word.41.meanin.en: ... please; could you help me with ...?

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.word.50.meanin.en: what day?; what day of the week?

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.0.mean.zh: 报时间就是「数字＋時＋分」，句尾照旧一个「です」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.0.mean.en: Telling time is number + 時 + 分, closed with です.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.0.form.en: 今、～時～分です (30 minutes = 半)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.0.usag.zh: 说现在几点、约时间。四時、七時、九時读「よじ・しちじ・くじ」，是必须背下来的固定读法。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.0.usag.en: For the time and appointments. 四時, 七時, 九時 are read よじ, しちじ, くじ — memorize them.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.0.pitf.zh: 「半」放在「時」后面（七時半），不能说「半七時」；「分」随数字在「ふん／ぷん」之间变。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.0.pitf.en: 半 follows 時 (七時半), never precedes it; 分 alternates between ふん and ぷん.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.1.mean.zh: 「ます」是日语的礼貌外壳：肯定「ます」、否定「ません」，说的是习惯或将来。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.1.mean.en: ます is the polite shell: ます for yes, ません for no, about habits or the future.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.1.form.zh: 五段：う段→い段＋ます（書く→書きます）；一段：去る＋ます；する→します；来る→来ます
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.1.form.en: Godan: u-row → i-row + ます (書く→書きます); ichidan: drop る; する→します; 来る→来ます

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.1.usag.zh: 日常礼貌对话的基本时态。谈每天的例行公事、打算做的事都用它。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.1.usag.en: The default polite tense for daily routines and plans.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.1.pitf.zh: 「来ます」读「きます」，不是「くります」；一段动词去掉「る」再加「ます」，别留下多余的「る」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.1.pitf.en: 来ます is read きます, not くります; with ichidan verbs drop る cleanly before adding ます.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.1.exam.en: I get up at six every morning.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.2.mean.zh: 过去式：肯定「ました」，否定「ませんでした」，只说已经发生的事。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.2.mean.en: Past tense: ました for yes, ませんでした for no.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.2.form.zh: Vます→Vました／Vません→Vませんでした
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.2.form.en: Vます → Vました / Vません → Vませんでした

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.2.usag.zh: 汇报昨天做了什么、刚才发生了什么。时间词一出现，动词就该换成过去式。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.2.usag.en: For reporting what happened. Once a past time word appears, the verb should follow.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.2.pitf.zh: 过去否定是「ませんでした」，不是「ました＋ではありません」：「行きましたではありません」是典型错误，应为「行きませんでした」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.2.pitf.en: The past negative is ませんでした, not ました plus ではありません: 行きましたではありません is wrong, use 行きませんでした.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.2.exam.en: I saw a film with a friend yesterday.
I didn't go to school last week.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.3.mean.zh: 「に」把动作钉在具体时刻上，像给动作盖一个时间戳。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.3.mean.en: に pins the action to a clock time, like a timestamp.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.3.form.zh: 時刻＋に＋V（七時に起きます）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.3.form.en: time + に + verb (七時に起きます)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.3.usag.zh: 说几点做某事；日期、星期后面也用「に」（日曜日に）。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.3.usag.en: For doing something at a set time; dates and weekdays take に too.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.3.pitf.zh: 「今日」「明日」「毎日」这类相对时间后面不加「に」，这是初级最高频的错。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.3.pitf.en: Relative words like 今日, 明日, 毎日 never take に — the most common beginner slip.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.3.exam.en: I go to bed at eleven.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.mean.zh: 「から」是起点，「まで」是终点，一头一尾把范围圈起来。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.mean.en: から is the start, まで the end: together they close a range.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.form.zh: N1 から N2 まで（时间、场所都适用）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.form.en: N1 から N2 まで (time or place)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.usag.zh: 说营业时间、路程、期间。也可以只用其中一个，「から」单独用很常见。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.usag.en: For opening hours, journeys and periods. Either half can stand alone, and から on its own is very common.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.pitf.zh: 两个词位置不能互换：「五時から九時まで」是从五点到九点，反过来意思就变了。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.pitf.en: Don't swap them: 五時から九時まで runs five to nine, and reversing it changes the meaning.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.exam.en: Class runs from nine to twelve.
I walk from home to the station.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.0.ques.zh: 何時问时刻，何時間问持续多久；不能用期间词来问钟表时间。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.0.ques.en: Ask when and how long it lasts; you cannot ask the clock time in terms of a period.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.1.ques.zh: 把働きます改为现在／将来的礼貌否定：星期天不工作。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.1.ques.en: Replace 働きます with current/future courtesy denial: not working on Sundays.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.1.ques.zh: 働きます→働きません。ませんでした是过去否定；働かないます混合了ない形与ます。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.1.ques.en: 働きます→働きません. ませんでした is past negative. 働かないます incorrectly mixes the nai-form and masu-form.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.2.ques.zh: 用勉強します表达“昨天在图书馆学习了”。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.2.ques.en: "Learned yesterday at the library" in 勉強します.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.2.ques.zh: 已完成的过去动作用ました：勉強しました。普通形した后不直接加です。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.2.ques.en: Use ました for a completed past action: 勉強しました. Do not directly add です to the plain form した.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.3.ques.zh: 具体时刻“七点”后选择助词。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.3.ques.en: Select the aid after the “seven-point” at a specific time.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.3.ques.zh: 动作发生的具体时间点用に；で不用于这里的钟点。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.3.ques.en: The specific time point for the action to occur uses に; で is not used for the clock here.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.ques.zh: 营业时间从九点到六点。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.ques.en: The opening hours range from 9:00 to 6:00.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.ques.zh: 起点用から，终点用まで，组成から～まで。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.ques.en: The starting point is から, and the final destination is まで, forming から-まで.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.ques.zh: 把休みます改为过去的礼貌否定，表示“昨天没休息”。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.ques.en: Replace 休みます with the previous courtesy denial, which means "no rest yesterday."

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.ques.zh: 礼貌过去否定是ます词干＋ませんでした，不是ないでした。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.ques.en: Polite past negative: masu-stem＋ませんでした, not ないでした.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.ques.zh: 选择自然表达“明天学习”的一句。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.ques.en: Choose the natural way to say “I will study tomorrow.”

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.ques.zh: 明日表示相对日期，不把它当作七時这样的具体时刻。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.ques.en: Tomorrow represents a relative date and does not treat it as a specific moment like seven.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.ques.zh: 明日通常不接に，直接作时间状语。具体钟点可以说七時に勉強します。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.4.grammar.4.ques.en: 明日 normally takes no に. A specific clock time can take it: 七時に勉強します.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.word.32.meanin.en: first day of the month; the first of the month

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.word.45.meanin.en: ... days; the ... day of the month

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.word.49.meanin.zh: 普通列车（通常各站停车）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.word.49.meanin.en: local train (usually stops at every station)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.mean.zh: 「へ」标出移动的方向，读作 e，不读 he。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.mean.en: へ marks the direction of movement and is read e.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.form.zh: 場所＋へ＋行きます／来ます／帰ります
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.form.en: place + へ + 行きます／来ます／帰ります

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.usag.zh: 说去哪儿。「行く」离说话人远去，「来る」朝说话人而来，「帰る」回自己的家或单位。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.usag.en: 行く moves away, 来る moves toward the speaker, 帰る returns to your own base.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.pitf.zh: 「帰ります」只能回自己的据点；回别人家要用「行きます」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.pitf.en: 帰ります only returns to your own base; going to someone else's home is 行きます.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.1.mean.zh: 「で」表示手段，交通工具放前面，说明「怎么去」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.1.mean.en: で marks the means — how you get there.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.1.form.zh: 乗り物＋で＋行きます（走路：歩いて行きます）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.1.form.en: vehicle + で + 行きます (on foot: 歩いて行きます)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.1.usag.zh: 说交通方式。走路去是「歩いて」，这一项不用「で」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.1.usag.en: For transport. Walking takes 歩いて, with no で.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.1.pitf.zh: 这里的「で」是手段不是场所，「電車に行きます」是错的，应为「電車で行きます」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.1.pitf.en: Here で is means, not place: 電車に行きます is wrong, use 電車で行きます.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.1.exam.en: Take the tram to the company.
I go to school by bus.
I ride a bicycle to the station.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.2.mean.zh: 「と」表示一起做动作的伙伴，相当于中文「和……」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.2.mean.en: と marks the person you do something with.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.2.form.en: person + と + verb (alone: 一人で)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.2.usag.zh: 说和谁一起去、一起做。独自一人用「一人で」，不能用「と」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.2.usag.en: For doing things together. Alone takes 一人で, never と.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.2.pitf.zh: 「と」和「で」别混：「友達と行きます」是一起去，「友達で行きます」不成立。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.2.pitf.en: Keep と and で apart: 友達と行きます means together, 友達で行きます is not Japanese.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.2.exam.en: Go to Kyoto with the family.
I'm going to see a film with a friend.
I'm going shopping with my mother.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.3.mean.zh: 时间点用「に」，把动作和具体时刻绑在一起。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.3.mean.en: に binds the action to a specific time.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.3.form.en: clock time or weekday + に + 行きます

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.3.usag.zh: 约时间、定计划：「日曜日に大阪へ行きます」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.3.usag.en: For appointments and plans: 日曜日に大阪へ行きます.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.3.pitf.zh: 时刻、日期、星期后面加「に」（星期的に可省）；「今日」「明日」「毎日」「来週」「きのう」这类相对时间不加「に」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.3.pitf.en: Clock times, dates and days of the week take に (optional with days of the week). Relative time words such as 今日, 明日, 毎日, 来週 and きのう take no に.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.3.exam.en: I'm going back to my country in March.
I'm meeting a friend on Saturday.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.4.mean.zh: 疑问词＋も＋否定＝全面否定：「哪儿都不去」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.4.mean.en: Question word + も + negative means "nowhere at all".

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.4.form.zh: どこへも／何も／だれも＋否定
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.4.form.en: どこへも／何も／だれも + negative

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.4.usag.zh: 强调「一点都不」。整句必须是否定，否则意思正好相反。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.4.usag.en: For emphasis on none at all. The sentence must be negative.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.4.pitf.zh: 句尾一定是否定；「どこへも行きます」会被听成「哪儿都去」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.4.pitf.en: The ending must be negative; どこへも行きます sounds like "I go everywhere".

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.4.exam.en: I'm not going anywhere during the summer break.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.ques.en: Shows the direction of the move.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.ques.zh: 京都へ行きます说明目的方向。这里也可以用に，但这道题其他三个助词都不能表示这个方向。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.ques.en: 京都へ行きます uses へ for the destination. に can also work here, but the other three choices cannot mark this direction.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.ques.zh: 交通手段用で。バスに乗ります用に，但题干动词是行きます。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.ques.en: Use で for a means of transport. バスに乗ります takes に, but this question uses 行きます.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.2.ques.zh: 朋友和你一起去，不是去找朋友。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.2.ques.en: Friends go with you, not friends.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.2.ques.zh: 同行者用と；“去找朋友”需要另外的表达，不能混淆同伴与目的。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.2.ques.en: Peers use と; “finding friends” requires a different expression and cannot confuse their peers with their purpose.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.ques.en: Describe the exact moment when you go home.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.ques.zh: 八時是时间点，用に；表示持续八小时则另用八時間。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.ques.en: 八時 is a clock time and takes に. 八時間 instead expresses a duration of eight hours.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.4.ques.zh: 哪里也不去。注意疑问词＋も。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.4.ques.en: Nowhere to go. Note the question word + も.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.4.ques.zh: どこへも与否定连用表示哪里也不去，这道题需要行きません。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.4.ques.en: どこへも with a negative means not going anywhere. The sentence requires 行きません.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.ques.zh: 步行固定说歩いて行きます，不能把歩く像交通工具名词一样直接接で。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.5.grammar.0.ques.en: Walking to 歩いて行きます cannot directly connect 歩く to で as a means of transport.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.word.1.meaning.en: to smoke a cigarette; to smoke

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.word.10.meanin.en: to take a picture; to take a photo

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.word.53.meanin.en: What is it?; What can I do for you?

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.0.mean.zh: 「を」标出动作直接作用的对象，读作 o。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.0.mean.en: を marks the direct object of the verb; it is read o.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.0.form.zh: N＋を＋V（毎朝コーヒーを飲みます）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.0.form.en: noun + を + verb (毎朝コーヒーを飲みます)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.0.usag.zh: 说「做什么」。日语把宾语放在动词前，「を」几乎只跟他动词。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.0.usag.en: For what you do to something. The object comes before the verb, and を takes transitive verbs.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.0.pitf.zh: 移动的目的地用「へ／に」，不用「を」：「学校を行きます」是错的，应为「学校へ行きます」。但经过、离开的场所用「を」：「公園を散歩します」「道を渡ります」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.0.pitf.en: The destination of movement takes へ／に, not を: 学校を行きます is wrong, use 学校へ行きます. A place you pass through or leave does take を: 公園を散歩します, 道を渡ります.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.0.exam.en: I watched a movie with my family last week.
I listen to the Japanese news every evening.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.1.mean.zh: 「で」标出动作发生的场所，是动作的舞台。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.1.mean.en: で marks where an action takes place — the stage.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.1.form.zh: 場所＋で＋V（図書館で本を読みます）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.1.form.en: place + で + verb (図書館で本を読みます)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.1.usag.zh: 在图书馆看书、在餐厅吃饭。场所后面用「で」，动作才有地方落脚。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.1.usag.en: Reading in a library, eating in a restaurant: the place takes で.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.1.pitf.zh: 和「に」分工明确：「図書館に本があります」是存在，「図書館で読みます」是动作。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.1.pitf.en: に is for existence, で is for action: 図書館に本があります vs 図書館で読みます.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.1.exam.zh: 在车站附近的店里吃了午饭。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.1.exam.en: I had lunch at a shop near the station.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.1.exam.zh: 昨天在百货商店买了伞。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.1.exam.en: I bought an umbrella at the department store yesterday.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.2.mean.zh: 动作性名词＋「をします」，把「打网球」「做作业」统一成一句话。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.2.mean.en: Action nouns + をします: one frame for games, homework and chores.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.2.form.zh: N（动作名词）＋を＋します（テニスをします／宿題をします）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.2.form.en: action noun + を + します (テニスをします / 宿題をします)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.2.usag.zh: 中文里动词各不相同（打、做、搞），日语只要名词加「します」就行。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.2.usag.en: Chinese picks a different verb each time; Japanese just adds します to the noun.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.2.pitf.zh: 「勉強します」「勉強をします」都可以；但已有「を」宾语时不能再用「を」：「日本語を勉強をします」是错的，应为「日本語を勉強します」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.2.pitf.en: Both 勉強します and 勉強をします are fine, but once there is a を object you cannot add another を: 日本語を勉強をします is wrong; say 日本語を勉強します.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.2.exam.en: I go jogging in the park every morning.
I played a game with a friend last night.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.3.mean.zh: 否定疑问「ませんか」用来邀约：「要不要一起……？」
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.3.mean.en: The negative question ませんか is an invitation: "won't you…?"

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.3.form.zh: Vます→Vませんか（いっしょに～ませんか）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.3.form.en: Vます → Vませんか (いっしょに～ませんか)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.3.usag.zh: 邀约时比「ましょう」客气，把决定权留给对方，对方拒绝也不尴尬。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.3.usag.en: Politer than ましょう: the decision stays with the listener.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.3.pitf.zh: 答应时说「いいですね。～ましょう」；拒绝别直说「いや」，用「すみません、ちょっと……」缓冲。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.3.pitf.en: Accept with いいですね。～ましょう; refuse softly with すみません、ちょっと…… instead of a blunt いや.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.3.exam.en: Would you like to have lunch?
Would you like to see a movie together tomorrow?
Shall we take a short break?

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.4.mean.zh: 「ましょう」提议一起做，或主动承担某件事。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.4.mean.en: ましょう proposes doing something together, or offers to do it.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.4.usag.zh: 双方已经有意向时的说法，语气比「ませんか」更主动、更干脆。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.4.usag.en: For when both sides are already willing — firmer than ませんか.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.4.pitf.zh: 对上级别用「ましょう」催促，换成「～ませんか」或「～ましょうか」更稳。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.4.pitf.en: Don't push a superior with ましょう; use ～ませんか or ～ましょうか.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.4.exam.zh: 没时间了，我们打车去吧。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.4.exam.en: We don't have time, so let's go by taxi.
It's cold, so let's close the window.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.0.ques.zh: 把报纸作为読む的宾语。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.0.ques.en: Make the newspaper the object of 読む.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.0.ques.zh: 読む的直接对象用を；新聞で表示利用报纸作为手段，不符合这里的宾语关系。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.0.ques.en: The direct object of 読む takes を. 新聞で would express a means, which does not fit the object relationship here.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.2.ques.zh: 有动作发生的地点用で；に常标记存在地点或到达点。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.2.ques.en: で; に regularly marks the location or point of arrival where the action takes place.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.2.ques.zh: 把运动名词与します连接。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.2.ques.en: Connect motion nun to します.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.2.ques.zh: テニスをします表示打网球；运动名词在这个结构中用を。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.2.ques.en: テニスをします means tennis; noun uses を in this structure.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.3.ques.zh: 想委婉邀请同学一起看电影。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.3.ques.en: I want to invite my classmates to watch the movie.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.3.ques.zh: ませんか用于邀请。“不看吗”的形式在这里表达一起做的提议，ません只是陈述否定。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.3.ques.en: ませんか is used for invitations. The form "Don't look at it" is here to express the proposal made together, and ません is just a negative statement.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.4.ques.zh: 你接受休息的邀请，提议一起休息。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.4.ques.en: You accept the invitation to rest, propose to rest together.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.4.ques.zh: 接受邀请可用ましょう：“好，一起休息吧”。其他选项不是同意一起休息。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.4.ques.en: Accepts the invitation using ましょう: "Okay, let's get some rest." The other options are not to agree to rest together.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.4.ques.zh: 把食べます改成礼貌邀请“一起吃好吗”。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.4.ques.en: Replace 食べます with a polite invitation to eat together.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.4.ques.zh: 去掉ます，加ませんか：食べませんか。不要把辞书形る保留在ません前。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.6.grammar.4.ques.en: Remove the ます plus ませんか: 食べませんか. Do not keep dictionaryform る before ません.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.word.29.meanin.zh: 母亲；妈妈（说自己的母亲）

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.word.31.meanin.zh: 父亲；爸爸（称呼父亲或说别人的父亲）

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.word.32.meanin.zh: 母亲；妈妈（称呼母亲或说别人的母亲）

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.word.34.meanin.zh: 还；尚未（依后文肯定或否定判断）

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.word.37.meanin.en: I'm off (and will be back later); see you later

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.word.38.meanin.en: Excuse me; I will be leaving now.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.word.40.meanin.en: local specialty or souvenir bought as a gift while traveling (travelling)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.0.mean.zh: 「で」还能表示工具、语言和材料，不只是交通工具。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.0.mean.en: で also marks tools, languages and materials.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.0.form.zh: 道具／言語／材料＋で＋V（日本語で書きます）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.0.form.en: tool, language or material + で + verb (日本語で書きます)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.0.usag.zh: 用日语写邮件、用筷子吃饭、用木头做桌子，都用同一个「で」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.0.usag.en: Writing in Japanese, eating with chopsticks, building with wood — all take で.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.0.pitf.zh: 一起做的人用「と」，不是「で」：「友達で行きます」错，「友達と行きます」对。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.0.pitf.en: People you go with take と, not で: 友達で行きます is wrong, 友達と行きます is right.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.0.exam.en: Please write this letter in English.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.1.mean.zh: 把要问的词句放进「」，问它在另一种语言里怎么说。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.1.mean.en: Put the word in 「」 and ask how it is said in another language.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.1.form.zh: 「A」は 中国語で 何ですか
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.1.form.en: 「A」は 中国語で 何ですか

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.1.usag.zh: 问翻译、问说法。回答时常省掉「は」，直接给对应词。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.1.usag.en: For asking translations. The answer usually drops は and just gives the word.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.1.pitf.zh: 「何ですか」问的是说法，不是意思；问意思用「どういう意味ですか」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.1.pitf.en: 何ですか asks for the wording; for meaning use どういう意味ですか.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.1.exam.en: What does "ありがとう" say in Chinese?
How do you say 「こんにちは」 in English?

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.1.exam.zh: 「いただきます」用中文怎么说？
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.1.exam.en: How do you say 「いただきます」 in Chinese?

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.2.mean.zh: 「あげます」是我方给出去，接受者用「に」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.2.mean.en: あげます is giving out; the receiver takes に.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.2.form.en: person + に + noun + を + あげます

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.2.usag.zh: 我给别人东西、送礼物、写信。给的对象永远是「に」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.2.usag.en: For giving gifts or writing to someone. The receiver always takes に.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.2.pitf.zh: 对上级别用「あげます」，用「さしあげます」或干脆换说法。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.2.pitf.en: Avoid あげます with superiors; use さしあげます or rephrase.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.2.exam.en: I gave my little brother a bicycle.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.2.exam.zh: 要送田中先生一份特产。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.2.exam.en: I'll give Mr. Tanaka a souvenir.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.mean.zh: 「もらいます」是从别人那里收进来，来源用「に」或「から」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.mean.en: もらいます is receiving; the source takes に or から.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.form.zh: 人＋に／から＋N＋を＋もらいます
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.form.en: person + に／から + noun + を + もらいます

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.usag.zh: 收礼物、收资料。来源是公司、学校这类组织时，多用「から」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.usag.en: For receiving things. Organisations as source usually take から.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.pitf.zh: 方向别弄反：给出去是「あげます」，收进来是「もらいます」，主语是谁决定用哪个。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.pitf.en: Watch the direction: あげます gives, もらいます receives; the subject decides.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.exam.en: Information was obtained from the company.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.exam.zh: 从母亲那里得到了一件毛衣。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.exam.en: I got a sweater from my mother.
I received a letter from Mr. Tanaka.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.4.mean.zh: 「もう」加过去式，表示动作已经完成。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.4.mean.en: もう with the past tense says the action is already done.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.4.form.zh: もう＋Vました（答：はい、もう～ました／いいえ、まだです）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.4.form.en: もう + Vました (yes: はい、もう～ました / no: いいえ、まだです)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.4.usag.zh: 回答「もう～ましたか」。中文的「已经」在日语里常靠「もう」加过去式一起表达。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.4.usag.en: The answer to もう～ましたか. Chinese 已经 needs both もう and the past tense.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.4.pitf.zh: 否定回答说「いいえ、まだです」最自然，不必硬造「まだ～ませんでした」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.4.pitf.en: Answer negatively with いいえ、まだです; no need to force まだ～ませんでした.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.4.exam.en: Have you bought the tickets yet?

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.0.ques.en: Describes the tools to be used for paper cutting.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.0.ques.zh: 工具用で，切的对象紙用を。两种成分承担不同作用。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.0.ques.en: Tools with で and cut object paper with を. The two components perform different roles.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.1.ques.zh: 询问“谢谢”用日语怎么说。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.1.ques.en: Ask how to say "thank you" in Japanese.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.1.ques.zh: 表达使用某种语言用～語で；这里的で表示语言手段。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.1.ques.en: Use ～語で for the language used. Here で marks a means of communication.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.2.ques.zh: 你把自己的书送给妹妹，从给出者的视角叙述。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.2.ques.en: You give your book to your sister, and you describe it from the point of view of the person who gave it.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.2.ques.zh: 我给妹妹用あげました。もらう、借りる、受け取る都让我是接收的一方，与场景相反。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.2.ques.en: Use あげました for giving to my younger sister. もらう、借りる、受け取る instead make me the receiver, contrary to the scenario.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.ques.zh: 资料来自公司这个机构。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.ques.en: The information came from this institution.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.ques.zh: 从机构得到物品用から说明来源，資料を是收到的对象。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.ques.en: Use から for the institution supplying the items; 資料を identifies the items received.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.4.ques.zh: 对もう～ましたか作“还没有”的简短回答用まだです；两个过去肯定回答会表示已经吃过。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.4.ques.en: The short answer to もう-ましたか as “not yet” is called まだです; the two affirmative answers in the past will indicate that they have eaten.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.ques.zh: 判断实际送出词典的人。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.ques.en: Work out who actually gave the dictionary.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.ques.zh: もらう以接收者私作主题，友達に表示来源，因此是朋友给我词典。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.7.grammar.3.ques.en: With もらう, the receiver 私 is the topic and 友達に marks the source. The friend therefore gives me the dictionary.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.word.33.meanin.zh: 蓝色的（部分搭配中指绿色）

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.word.45.meanin.en: what kind of; what sort of

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.word.46.meanin.zh: 哪一个（三个或三个以上）

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.word.48.meanin.en: not very ...; not much ... (with a negative)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.word.52.meanin.zh: 是啊；嗯，让我想想（依语境判断）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.word.52.meanin.en: That is right; well, let me think.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.word.58.meanin.zh: 是否已经习惯了日本的生活？
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.word.58.meanin.en: Have you got used to life in Japan?

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.0.mean.zh: い形容词直接接「です」就能作谓语，本身就是「是……的」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.0.mean.en: I-adjectives take です directly and already contain "is".

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.0.form.zh: N は い形＋です（否定：い→くないです）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.0.form.en: N は i-adjective + です (negative: い → くないです)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.0.usag.zh: 描述性质、状态：大きい、高い、おいしい。否定把「い」换成「くない」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.0.usag.en: For qualities: 大きい, 高い, おいしい. Negate by turning い into くない.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.0.pitf.zh: 「大きいじゃありません」是错的，否定只能说「大きくないです」或「大きくありません」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.0.pitf.en: 大きいじゃありません is wrong; negate as 大きくないです or 大きくありません.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.1.mean.zh: な形容词作谓语时只加「です」，词干后面不带「な」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.1.mean.en: Na-adjectives take です as a predicate; the stem drops な.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.1.form.zh: N は な形＋です（否定：じゃありません）
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.1.form.en: N は na-adjective + です (negative: じゃありません)

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.1.usag.zh: 静か、有名、元気、きれい。这些词看起来像名词，所以否定和名词一样用「じゃありません」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.1.usag.en: 静か, 有名, 元気, きれい behave like nouns, so they negate with じゃありません.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.1.pitf.zh: 「な」只在修饰名词时出现（静かな町），作谓语时加「な」就错了。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.1.pitf.en: な appears only before nouns (静かな町); adding it to a predicate is wrong.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.1.exam.en: It isn't lively near the station.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.2.mean.zh: い形容词直接放在名词前，不加任何连接成分。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.2.mean.en: I-adjectives sit straight before a noun.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.2.usag.zh: 中文「新电脑」和日语「新しいパソコン」顺序一致，这一条几乎不用费力记。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.2.usag.en: Chinese 新电脑 and Japanese 新しいパソコン share the same order.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.2.pitf.zh: 「多い」「少ない」一般不直接修饰名词，要说「多くの人」「少数の人」；但在「～が多い／少ない＋N」里可以（雨が多い国）。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.2.pitf.en: 多い and 少ない usually do not modify a noun directly; use 多くの人 or 少数の人. Inside a clause they can: 雨が多い国.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.2.exam.en: He is wearing a white shirt.
Do you know a good restaurant?

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.3.mean.zh: な形容词修饰名词时必须补一个「な」，这是它的招牌。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.3.mean.en: Na-adjectives need な before a noun — their signature.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.3.usag.zh: 看到名词前多出一个「な」，基本可以判断前面是な形容词。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.3.usag.en: A な before a noun is your cue that the word is a na-adjective.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.3.pitf.zh: 别把「な」当成词的一部分背，它只在连接名词时出现，作谓语时反而没有。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.3.pitf.en: Don't memorize な as part of the word; it only shows up before nouns.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.3.exam.zh: 奈良是一座有名的城市。
在安静的公园里休息了。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.3.exam.en: I rested in a quiet park.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.4.mean.zh: 「どう」问感受，「どんな」问性质，前者单独用，后者必须带名词。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.4.mean.en: どう asks how it feels; どんな asks what kind, and needs a noun.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.4.form.zh: N は どうですか／どんな＋N＋ですか
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.4.form.en: N は どうですか / どんな + noun + ですか

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.4.usag.zh: 「日本の生活はどうですか」问感受；「どんな町ですか」问是什么样的地方。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.4.usag.en: 日本の生活はどうですか asks how life feels; どんな町ですか asks what kind of town.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.4.pitf.zh: 「どんなですか」后面缺名词，是常见错句，应说「どんな N ですか」或「どうですか」。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.4.pitf.en: どんなですか is missing its noun; say どんな N ですか or どうですか.

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.4.exam.zh: 这个城镇的天气怎么样？
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.4.exam.en: How's the weather in this town?
What kind of music do you like?

minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.0.ques.zh: 把高い改成礼貌否定，表示包不贵。
minna-no-nihongo-shokyu.8.grammar.0.ques.en: Change 高い to polite negative, meaning it's not expensive.
