chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.1.zh: N＋さえ＋ば形／い形ければ／な形なら
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.1.en: N + さえ + ば-form / い-adj ければ / な-adj なら

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.1.zh: 「天気さえよければ」「体さえ丈夫なら」「ひらがなさえ読めれば」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.1.en: 天気さえよければ; 体さえ丈夫なら; ひらがなさえ読めれば.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.1.zh: 「さえ」后面必须跟条件形（ば／なら／ければ）。只写「天気さえいい」，句子就停在半空。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.1.en: さえ must be followed by a conditional (ば, なら, ければ). 天気さえいい alone leaves the sentence hanging.
Just keep an eye on it.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.1.zh: 只要天气好，从这里就能看到岛。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.1.en: As long as the weather is good, you can see the island from here.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.1.zh: 只要身体健康，什么事都能做。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.1.en: You can do anything as long as you're healthy.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.2.zh: 三个词三种力：さえ 提条件，しか 配否定表限定，こそ 做强调。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.2.en: Three different jobs: さえ sets a sufficient condition, しか limits with a negative, こそ emphasises.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.2.zh: Nさえ～ば：只要；Nしか＋否定：只；Nこそ：正是
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.2.en: Nさえ～ば: as long as; Nしか + negative: only; Nこそ: precisely

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.2.zh: 「ひらがなさえ読めれば」「ひらがなしか読めない」「漢字学習こそ大切だ」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.2.en: ひらがなさえ読めれば; ひらがなしか読めない; 漢字学習こそ大切だ.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.2.zh: 「しか」后面必须是否定：「しか読める」是错的。中文说「只会」，容易漏掉否定。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.2.en: しか demands a negative: しか読める is wrong. Chinese "only can" tempts you to drop it.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.2.zh: 只要能读平假名，就能读这本图画书。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.2.en: If you can read Hiragana, you can read it.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.2.zh: 有学生认为学习汉字才是最重要的。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.2.en: There are students who think learning Kanji is the most important thing.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.zh: 把「只要……就行」这种简单判断否掉：并不是……就……。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.en: It rejects the tidy "just do X and you're fine": doing X does not guarantee it.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.zh: 普通形＋というものではない／というものでもない；N／な形可接「（だ）というものではない」
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.en: plain form + というものではない / というものでもない; N / な-adj take （だ）というものではない

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.zh: 「服装さえ気をつければいいというものではない」「住めば上手になるというものでもない」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.en: 服装さえ気をつければいいというものではない; 住めば上手になるというものでもない.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.zh: 它否定的是「充分条件」，不是事实本身。语气比「わけではない」更带议论味。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.en: It denies sufficiency, not the fact. It argues harder than わけではない.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.zh: 并不是只注意穿着就行。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.en: It's not just about wearing it.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.zh: 外语也不是住到那个国家就一定能学好。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.en: If you don't live in that country, you can learn it.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.zh: 名牌大学毕业的人也不一定优秀。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.en: Also, those who graduate from famous universities are not necessarily excellent.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.4.zh: 照这个势头下去，恐怕会出现不好的结果。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.4.en: At this rate, something bad is likely to happen.
Vます (drop ます) + かねない

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.4.zh: 「誤解を招きかねない」「病気になりかねない」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.4.en: 誤解を招きかねない; 病気になりかねない.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.4.zh: 只接负面结果，夸人别说「成功しかねない」。也别和「かねる」（不能、不便）混：一个「恐怕会」，一个「做不到」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.4.en: Negative outcomes only: 成功しかねない is not praise. And keep it apart from かねる, which means "cannot": one predicts, the other refuses.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.4.zh: 过于倚靠椅背，可能会给人压迫感。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.4.en: Too much reliance on the back of a chair may create a sense of oppression.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.4.zh: 说那样的话，可能会招致误解。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.4.en: In that case, it might be misleading.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.4.zh: 吃饭时不考虑营养均衡，可能会生病。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.4.en: Eating without taking into account nutritional balance may become ill.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.zh: 先认下前面的事实，再转出跟预期不一样的后面：虽然……但是……。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.en: Concede the fact, then turn to what does not follow from it.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.zh: V／い形普通形＋ものの；な形＋な／である＋ものの；N＋である＋ものの
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.en: V / い-adj plain + ものの; な-adj + な / である + ものの; N + である + ものの

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.zh: 书面语的转折：「給料はあまり高くないものの、人間関係はいい」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.en: Written concession: 給料はあまり高くないものの、人間関係はいい.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.zh: 前后必须是「承认事实 + 与预期不符」，不能像「が」那样随便转折；口语里更常说「けど」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.en: It needs concession plus a mismatch with expectation; it is not a free-for-all が. Speech prefers けど.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.zh: 虽说“人的内在很重要”，外表和说话方式仍会影响第一印象。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.en: Although “the intrinsic importance of the human person”, appearances and ways of speaking can affect the first impression.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.zh: 现在的公司虽然工资不太高，但人际关系好，所以我很满意。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.en: I am satisfied with the fact that companies today are not well paid, but they have good relationships.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.zh: 他虽然措辞礼貌，但态度不好，因此给人的印象很差。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.en: He was polite in his language, but not well-meaning and therefore gave a poor impression.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.kanji.1.e.zh: 人的第一印象由外表决定。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.kanji.1.e.en: First impressions are decided by appearance.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.kanji.2.e.zh: 决定印象的要素有两个。

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.kanji.3.e.en: The content of what you say matters.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.kanji.6.e.zh: 来自听觉的信息也很多。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.kanji.6.e.en: Much information also comes through hearing.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.kanji.7.e.zh: 重视从耳朵进入的信息。

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.kanji.12..zh: 前倾的姿势看起来没有自信。

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.kanji.13..en: To sit up straight and listen.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.kanji.15..zh: 露出笑容能传达给对方。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.kanji.15..en: Showing a smile gets through to people.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.kanji.17..en: To lean back against the chair.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.kanji.20..en: Habits you acquire are hard to change.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.0.zh: 「にすぎない」强调数量有限：仅仅10人。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.0.en: にすぎない limits the quantity: only ten people.
The number of participants is not yet decided.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.0.zh: 普通形＋にすぎない：話したにすぎない，表示只是讲了听到的内容。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.0.en: plain Form + にすぎない: 話したにすぎない indicates that only what has been heard is said.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.1.zh: な形容词条件形用なら：丈夫なら。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.1.en: な adjective condition in なら: 丈夫なら.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.zh: 表达“只要天气好，从这里就能看到山”
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.en: Express “As long as the weather is good, you can see the mountain from here.”

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.zh: さえ～ば表示只要满足条件即可。よければ表示天气好的条件；悪ければ改变为天气坏，よくても／悪くても是让步表达，均不符合题意。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.3.en: さえ — ば indicates that the condition is met. よければ means the condition of a good weather; 悪ければ changes to bad weather, and よくても / 悪くても is an expression of compromise and does not correspond to the issue.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.1.zh: 「しか」与否定呼应，表示限定：只会读平假名。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.1.en: "しか" and negative echoes are limited: only hiragana is read.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.zh: 強調「努力才是最重要的」
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.en: Emphasize that effort is the most important thing.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.zh: 「こそ」用于突出强调：努力才是最重要的。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.en: "こそ" is used to highlight that efforts are the most important.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.zh: 「というものではない」否定简单绝对的判断，并非越贵就一定越好。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.en: The "というものではない" negatives the simple absolute judgement, not necessarily the more expensive it is.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.zh: ます形去ます＋かねない：招きかねない。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.en: Masu-stem + かねない: 招きかねない.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.zh: 「かねない」表示不好的结果有可能发生。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.en: "かねない" means that bad results can happen.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.zh: な形容词接ものの用「な」或「である」：丁寧なものの。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.8.grammar.5.en: な adjective receives ものの using "な" or "である": 丁寧なものの.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.0.zh: 毕业后的去处，不是“公司名”本身。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.0.en: where you end up working, not the company name itself

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.1.zh: 招聘广告的常见写法，人数不公开。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.1.en: the standard vague headcount in job ads

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.2.zh: 企业招人的行为/广告；找工作的动作是「就職活動」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.2.en: a company hiring; the job hunt itself is 就職活動

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.3.zh: 求职时推销自己的那段话。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.3.en: the self-pitch in a job application

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.4.zh: 「黙ってしまった」带点突然安静下来的语感。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.4.en: to fall silent; 黙ってしまった suggests an abrupt hush

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.5.en: exercise gadgets — often the ones gathering dust

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.7.zh: 由「寝た＋きり」来的复合词。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.8.zh: 后面多接失误：「うっかり忘れた」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.8.en: usually precedes a slip: うっかり忘れた

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.1.zh: 比「都合」客观，指当下的局面。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.1.en: the objective situation, unlike 都合
a polite way to say you got an upset stomach
as in ～に追われる, to be hounded by

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.1.zh: 技术从实验室走到市场。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.1.en: a technology moving from lab to market
as in 両国間の関係
works as both noun and な-adjective

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.2.en: as in 手編みのセーター

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.2.zh: 上级对下级；被动态「命じられる」更常见。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.2.en: top-down; the passive 命じられる is more common

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.2.zh: 「アイデアが浮かぶ」＝点子冒出来。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.2.en: アイデアが浮かぶ: an idea comes to mind
ヒット means a big seller

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.2.zh: 正式场合的“欢迎”，日常口语用「ようこそ」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.2.en: formal welcome; everyday speech uses ようこそ
合唱コンクール is a choral contest

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.word.3.en: bigger than a pond, smaller than a lake

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 从那一次之后就一直（没）……。说话人把“最后一次”当成分界线，后面的事往往与预想相反。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Marks the last time something happened: nothing has happened since, or the state has stayed the same.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: V-た ＋ きり（だ）／口语 V-たっきり
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: V-た + きり (casual: V-たっきり)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 后项多接否定或状态不变的表达：別れたきり会っていない／出かけたきり帰ってこない。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: What follows is usually negative or an unchanged state: 別れたきり会っていない, 出かけたきり帰ってこない.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 别和「～まま」混：「まま」强调状态没变，きり强调“那一次之后没有下一次”。另有「V-ます＋っきり」表示一直持续（かかりっきり），「数量詞＋きり」表示只有（2人きり）。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Not the same as ～まま: まま stresses an unchanged state, きり stresses that there was no next time. Note also V-ます+っきり (kept doing) and quantity+きり (only).

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 他说了句“对不起”之后就不作声了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: He said sorry and then went silent.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 家里有好几件只用过两三次就再没碰过的健身器材。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: At home there are several exercise gadgets I used two or three times and never touched again.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 牛排啊，我半年前吃过一次就再没吃过了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Steak? I had it once six months ago and haven't since.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 我家的狗身体彻底垮了，每天几乎都躺着起不来。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Our dog has gotten so weak he's bedridden almost every day.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 说明自己现在不是能做某事的状况，所以做不了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Says you are in no state to do something, so of course you can't.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: N／V-る ＋ どころではない／どころじゃない
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: N / V-る + どころではない (casual: どころじゃない)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 多用来拒绝邀请、说明忙乱：カラオケどころじゃないよ！レポート、書かなきゃ。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Used to turn down an invitation or explain you're swamped: カラオケどころじゃないよ！レポート、書かなきゃ.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 「～どころか」是“岂止……”，方向相反、表示递进，别混。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Don't confuse it with ～どころか, which means let alone and moves the other way.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: ……是事实（＝确实想买才买的），但是……。为了强调这个事实，常带「は」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Grants that something is true, then contrasts it: sure, but... The は is often added to stress the fact.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 普通形 ＋ ものの／なA＋な ＋ ものの／N＋である ＋ ものの
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: plain form + ものの (な-adjective: なA + な, noun: N + である)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 逆接，后项多与预想不符或做不到：買ったものの、履く機会がない。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: A concessive: what follows usually falls short of the expectation: 買ったものの、履く機会がない.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 书面色彩强，口语更常说「けど／が」；「～ても」是假设逆接，ものの 是既成事实的逆接。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Mostly written; speech prefers けど／が. ～ても is hypothetical concession, ものの is about an established fact.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 游泳班是上了，可到现在还只能游25米。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: I do go to swimming lessons, but I still can't swim more than 25 meters.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 这双鞋是看中设计买的，可完全没机会穿。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: I bought these shoes because I loved the design, but I never get to wear them.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 虽说新技术已经开发出来，但投入实用还需要时间吧。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: They say the new technology has been developed, but putting it to practical use will still take time.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 两国关系的修复虽然困难，但仍需为改善而努力。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Restoring relations between the two countries is difficult, but efforts toward improvement are still needed.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 把“令人困扰的是……”“高兴的是……”这类评价提到句首，强调说话人的心情。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Fronts the speaker's reaction — troublingly, happily — and then states the fact.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: V-た／いA／なAな ＋ ことに
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: V-た / い-adjective / な-adjective+な + ことに

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 固定搭配：驚いたことに・うれしいことに・不思議なことに・残念なことに。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Fixed set: 驚いたことに, うれしいことに, 不思議なことに, 残念なことに.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 与表示个人习惯的「～ことにしている」无关，别混。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Unrelated to ～ことにしている, which describes a personal habit.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 进酒店房间一看，令人惊讶的是，桌上放着玫瑰花束和酒店经理的欢迎留言。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: When I entered the hotel room, to my surprise there was a bouquet of roses and a welcome note from the manager on the table.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 高兴的是，我们高中在合唱比赛里拿了冠军。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Happily, our high school won the choral competition.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 五色沼奇妙的地方在于，五个湖沼的水色竟然全都不一样。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Curiously, the five ponds of Goshikinuma are said to each have water of a different color.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 遗憾的是，我常去的那家理发店关门了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Unfortunately, the salon I always went to has closed.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 从……这一点来考虑的话，与预想不同。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Judged by that standard, the result is not what you'd expect.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: N ＋ にしては（なA ＋ にしては：学生にしては／きれいにしては）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: N + にしては (な-adjective: なA + にしては, e.g. 学生にしては / きれいにしては)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 「小学1年生にしては背が高い」のように、基準と結果のずれを言う。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: States a gap between the benchmark and the result: 小学1年生にしては背が高い.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 「～に比べて」是拿两者作比较，にしては 是“按这个标准衡量，结果出乎意料”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: ～に比べて compares two things; にしては says the result surprises you given the standard.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 现在很红的艾莉娜作为模特来说个子不算高。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Elena, who's popular now, is not particularly tall for a model.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 这个便当才300日元，量却不少，味道也好。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: For 300 yen this box lunch is generous and tasty.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 那寿司，第一次做来说做得挺好啊。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: That sushi turned out well for a first attempt.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 带着感情回顾自己至今做过、经历过的事，多是自言自语式的感叹。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: A rueful or moved exclamation about what you've been through — usually said to yourself.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 普通形 ＋ ことか；なA＋な ＋ ことか（例：なんと静かなことか）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: plain form + ことか

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 常与「どんなに・どれだけ・どれほど」连用：どれだけ勉強したことか。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Usually paired with どんなに・どれだけ・どれほど: どれだけ勉強したことか.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 与表示经历的「～ことがある」不同，ことか 只感叹，不陈述事实。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Not the experiential ～ことがある: ことか only exclaims, it doesn't report a fact.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 别人都说我聪明，可为了考上这个，我到底学了多少啊。我的努力大概没人知道吧。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: People say I'm smart, but they have no idea how much I studied to pass this exam.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 小时候因为父亲调职不得不跟好朋友分开，当时有多难过啊。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: As a child I had to part with my best friend because of my father's transfer — how sad that was.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 在语言不通的外国生病，当时心里有多没底啊。到现在我都感谢那时的护士。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Falling ill in a country where I couldn't speak the language left me so helpless. I'm still grateful to the nurse from then.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 周末好像要来台风，真担心。运动会要是取消了，一直盼着的女儿该多失望啊。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: A typhoon may hit this weekend. If the sports day is cancelled, how crushed my daughter will be.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 说了那一句之后就没再开口，用「～たきり」；「ものの」「あげく」后面不能接这种单纯的状态持续。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: The last action with nothing after it takes ～たきり. ものの and あげく cannot carry this kind of continuing state.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 「使ったきり」＝用过那几次之后就没再用，正好接「の」修饰名词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: 使ったきり means used a couple of times and never again; it modifies the noun with の.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 选出最自然的说法。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Choose the most natural option.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 不是能唱K的状况，用「どころじゃない」；「どころか」是“岂止”，方向相反。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: You're in no state for karaoke: どころじゃない. どころか would mean let alone, the opposite direction.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: “买是买了”这个既成事实之后转逆，用「ものの」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Concede the fact that you bought them, then reverse: ものの.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 把“令人惊讶的是”提前，用「驚いたことに」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Front the reaction with 驚いたことに.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 按300日元这个标准衡量，结果超出预想，用「～にしては」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Judged by the 300-yen price, it exceeds expectations: ～にしては.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 与「どれだけ」呼应、带感叹地回顾，用「ことか」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Paired with どれだけ for an exclamation about the past: ことか.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 选出最自然的说法。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Choose the most natural option.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.zh: 过去式「どころじゃなかった」＝当时根本没那个余地。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-1.gramma.en: Past form どころじゃなかった: there was no room for it at the time.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.0.en: as in 行きつけの美容院

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.1.zh: 当天营业结束是「閉店」，长期停业也是。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.1.en: covers both closing for the day and shutting down

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.5.en: as in 時間帯によって混む

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.6.zh: 注意不是“日中关系”的「日中」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.6.en: not the 日中 of Japan-China relations

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.8.zh: 企业招人用「採用」，学校录取用「合格」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.8.en: companies 採用; schools 合格

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.9.zh: 多接不好的经历：「さんざん苦労した」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.9.en: usually before a hard experience: さんざん苦労した

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.1.zh: 常带“折腾半天还是”的语感。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.1.en: as in 最後のまとめ
as in ご都合さえよければ
also the cabinet of a speaker

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.1.zh: 可作な形容词，如「面倒な仕事」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.1.en: Works as a な-adjective: 面倒な仕事.
to take on what someone asks of you

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 大学课程的单位；也指计量单位。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: course credits; also a unit of measure

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 大学里因学分不足多读一年。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: repeating a year for missing credits

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 衣服专用；试鞋用「履いてみる」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: for clothes; shoes take 履いてみる
as in 店員にすすめられた
as in 楽をしてお金をもうける
as in お金をもうける

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.3.en: either giggling or chattering, depending on context

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 只要……就……。把某件事当作唯一的必要条件。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: As long as this one condition holds, the rest follows.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: N＋さえ＋…ば／V-ます＋さえ＋すれば・しなければ／なAで＋さえ＋あれば・なければ／Nで＋さえ＋あれば・なければ
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: N+さえ+…ば / V-ます+さえ+すれば / なAで+さえ+あれば / Nで+さえ+あれば

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 「給料さえよければどんな仕事でもいい」のように、最低条件を提示する。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Names the minimum condition: 給料さえよければどんな仕事でもいい.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 「さえ」还能表示“连……都”的极端例，要看后面有没有「ば」来判断。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: さえ alone can also mean even; check whether ば follows to tell them apart.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 只要您方便，我明天就过去拜访。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: If it suits you, I'll come by tomorrow.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 只要能吃，味道我不挑。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: As long as it's edible, I don't care about the taste.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 真可惜啊，樱。要是没摔倒就是第一名了……
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Too bad, Sakura. If only you hadn't fallen, you'd have come first.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 留学生活虽然辛苦，但我相信只要身体健康什么困难都能挺过去，所以要坚持下去。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Life as an international student is hard, but I'll keep going, believing that good health gets me through any difficulty.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 因为某种理由（连我也不知道），所以想做也做不到，等于「どうしようもない」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: There's no way to do it, whatever you try — the same as どうしようもない.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: V-ます（ますを取る）＋ ようがない
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: V-ます stem + ようがない

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 「私も知らないから教えようがない」のように、不可能の理由を添える。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Adds the reason it's impossible: 私も知らないから教えようがない.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 不是“不想做”，是“想做也没办法”；也别跟「～ないようにする」混。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: It means there's no way, not that you don't want to. Not to be confused with ～ないようにする.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 本来要出差，可大雪导致航班取消，想去也去不了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: I was supposed to go on a business trip, but the flight was cancelled in heavy snow, so there's no way to get there.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 想进武田产业，但他们不招应届生，实在没办法。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: I want to work at Takeda Sangyo, but they don't hire new graduates, so there's nothing I can do.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 花了很多时间、经历各种周折之后的最终结果，多用于不好的结果。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: The end result after a long, tangled effort — usually a bad one.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: V-た ＋ あげく（に）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: V-た + あげく(に)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 「遊びまわったあげくに留年するなんて」のように、折腾半天换来坏结果。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: The shape is 遊びまわったあげくに留年するなんて — all that messing about, and he repeats a year.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 后面不能接意志、命令；与「～末に」相近，但あげく 更强调“折腾半天结果还不好”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Can't be followed by volition or commands. Close to ～末に, but あげく stresses a bad payoff after a fuss.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 刚才那位客人试了半天，结果什么都没买就走了……
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: That customer tried on one thing after another and then left without buying anything.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 犹豫了三个多小时，最后决定买店员一开始推荐的那台电脑。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: After dithering for over three hours, I bought the laptop the clerk had recommended first.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 提醒、劝告“不能做……、不应该做……”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Warns that something simply shouldn't be done.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: V-る ＋ ものではない／もんじゃない
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: V-る + ものではない (casual: もんじゃない)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 「人の悪口を言うもんじゃありません」のように、道理上不该做。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: It's about what's not right to do: 人の悪口を言うもんじゃありません.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 语气是“按理不该”，不是禁止令；对长辈用会失礼。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: It's a matter of propriety, not a ban; using it toward superiors is rude.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 靠卖药赚钱这种事，想都不该想。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: You shouldn't even think about making money off medicine.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 不该说别人坏话。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: You shouldn't speak ill of others.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 公司内部的事再小，也不该跟外人说。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Company matters, however small, shouldn't be discussed with outsiders.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 也许不行，但先试试看。前后用同一个动词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: It may not work, but give it a try anyway — the same verb appears twice.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: V-る ＋ だけ ＋ V-てみる
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: V-る + だけ + V-てみる

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 「行くだけ行ってみよう」のように、結果はともかく行動する。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Act first, result later: 行くだけ行ってみよう.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 与表示限定的「～だけ」不同，这里“だけ”前后是同一动词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Unlike limiting だけ, here the same verb sits on both sides.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 现在去可能也来不及了，但先去看看再说吧。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: It may be too late if we go now, but let's go anyway and see.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 这条裙子真好看。可能不适合我，不过先穿上试试吧。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: This dress is lovely. It might not suit me, but I'll try it on anyway.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: “只要写完总结就行”，用「さえ～ば」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: As long as the summary is written, it's done: さえ～ば.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: な形容词用「で＋さえ＋あれば」，表示唯一条件。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: A な-adjective takes で+さえ+あれば for the sole condition.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 「連絡のしようがない」＝想联系也没办法，用「V-ます＋ようがない」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: 連絡のしようがない means there was no way to get in touch.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 折腾半天换来坏结果，用「～たあげく（に）」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: A bad outcome after a lot of messing about: ～たあげく(に).

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 口语的「もんじゃない」接在动词辞书形后，表示按理不该。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Casual もんじゃない after the dictionary form: it's not right to.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 同一动词前后重复、「V-る＋だけ＋V-てみる」表示先做了再说。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Same verb twice with だけ: do it first and see.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 「教えようがない」＝想教也没法教。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: 教えようがない: there's no way to teach it.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 犹豫很久之后的结果，用「～たあげく」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: The result after long dithering: ～たあげく.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.word.0.zh: 多带“盼了很久/拖了很久”的语感。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.word.0.en: often carries a finally, at long last feel

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.word.1.en: people who joined the company the same year

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.word.3.en: やり直しさせる: to make someone redo it

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.word.4.zh: 「市場」在这里读 しじょう。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.word.4.en: 市場 is read しじょう here

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.word.5.zh: 对象用「を」：人をからかう。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.word.5.en: takes を: 人をからかう

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.word.1.en: being sent off the field or out of the hall
the other side, the other party
in speech it often means the other party
to be bitten by an insect
as in とりあえずやってみる
as in 足をねんざする

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.word.2.en: the newest person on the team

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.word.2.zh: い形容词，两种意思看语境。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.word.2.en: an い-adjective; which sense depends on context
as in 貧しい暮らし

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 因为这一个原因，导致了不好的结果，带遗憾、后悔的语气。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: One cause, and because of it a bad result followed — said with regret.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: V-た／いA ＋ ばかりに；なA＋な／N＋である ＋ ばかりに
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: V-た / い-adjective + ばかりに; な-adjective: なA＋な; noun: N＋である

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 后项一定是坏结果：言ったばかりに怒らせてしまった／足りないばかりに受からなかった。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: What follows is always a bad outcome: 言ったばかりに怒らせてしまった, 足りないばかりに受からなかった.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 与「～おかげで」方向相反（おかげで 多接好结果）；「ばかりに」不能接好结果。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: The mirror image of ～おかげで, which usually brings a good result; ばかりに never does.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 就因为说了实话，把他惹火了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Just because I told him the truth, I made him angry.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 就因为差了两厘米身高，没能当上警察。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: He missed becoming a police officer only because he was two centimeters too short.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 今年的苹果只因为被台风刮伤，市场价就掉了下来。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: This year's apples lost their market value simply because the typhoon bruised them.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 他仅仅因为父母是名人，就总被人取笑，挺可怜的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: He gets teased constantly just because his parents are famous — I feel for him.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 没必要……、用不着……。多用于建议和安慰。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: There's no need to — mostly used to advise or reassure.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: V-る ＋ ことはない／こともない
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: V-る + ことはない (also こともない)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 劝人别做某事，或说某件事根本不必发生：わざわざ買うことはない。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Tells someone not to bother: わざわざ買うことはない.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 与「～ないことはない」（不是不……）方向相反，注意别混。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: The opposite of ～ないことはない, which means it's not that you can't.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 只是脖子疼而已，用不着住院。错的是对方。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: A sore neck is no reason to be hospitalized. He's the one in the wrong.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 被虫子咬一下而已，不必去医院，两三天就好了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: You don't need a hospital for a bug bite — it'll heal in two or three days.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 和「～より」意思相同，比较两个以上事物，说明程度差异。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Same meaning as ～より: compare two or more things and state the difference.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: N ＋ に比べて
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: N + に比べて

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 今年は去年に比べて…／田舎は都会に比べて… のように、比较的基准放在前面。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: The benchmark comes first: 今年は去年に比べて, 田舎は都会に比べて.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 与「～に対して」（对比、对象）和「～によって」（根据）区分开。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Keep it apart from ～に対して (contrast, target) and ～によって (depending on).

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 听说草莓比柠檬的维生素C还多。真的吗？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: They say strawberries have more vitamin C than lemons. Really?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 无论在哪个国家，乡下人都比城里人更热情、更爱帮忙——我有这种印象。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: In any country, country people strike me as kinder and more helpful than city people.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 在日本，冬天比夏天日照时间短两小时以上。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: In Japan, winter days have over two hours less sunlight than summer.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 自言自语式的强烈否定：决不……。也用来否定对方说的话：绝对不是……。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: A fierce refusal, often muttered to yourself — or a flat denial of what someone just said.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: V-る／いA／なAな／Nな ＋ ものか／もんか（ものですか／もんですか）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: V-る / い-adjective / な-adjective+な / N+な + ものか (polite: ものですか)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 口语里常说「～もんか」「～もんですか」，语气很强。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Speech prefers ～もんか and ～もんですか; either way it's forceful.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 语气很硬，对长辈用会失礼；女性多用「～ものですか」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Too blunt for superiors; women tend to use ～ものですか.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 服务这么差的店，我再也不来了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: I'm never coming back to a shop with service this bad.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 公司因为业绩不好要砍三成工资？哪有这种荒唐事。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: The company cutting pay 30 percent over poor results? As if that could happen.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 表达说话人的想法不是个人意见，而是一般都这么认为。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Presents the speaker's view as the general way things are, not a personal opinion.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: N ＋ というものだ（普通形・なAだ 的情况也有）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: N + というものだ (also after plain form and な-adjectives)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 说“这才是所谓的……”“按理说就该……”：それが親というものだ。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: This is what X really means; that's how X is supposed to be.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 与「～というものではない」（并非……）不同，后者是否定。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Not the same as ～というものではない, which denies it.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 就算不富裕，一家人和睦地过日子才叫幸福。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Even if money is tight, a family living in harmony — that's what happiness is.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 说我批评了社长？岂有此理。那是误会。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Me criticizing the president? Nonsense. That's a misunderstanding.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 再辛苦的工作，只要想到能帮上别人就能坚持下去。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: However hard the work, if you think it helps someone you can keep going — that's how it is.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: Comparing two years: ～に比べて.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: A fierce never again: ～もんか.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-1.gramma.en: This is what a friend is — a general claim: ～というものだ.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 与「～からこそ」同义，强调理由：正因为……。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Same as ～からこそ but stronger: precisely because.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: V-ば／なA・N であれば ＋ こそ

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 后项多是由这个理由产生的行动或判断：愛すればこそ制限する。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: What follows is the action or judgement that reason produces: 愛すればこそ制限する.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 「からこそ」更口语；「ばこそ」偏书面、语气更重。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: からこそ is more conversational; ばこそ is bookish and heavier.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 正因为爱这座山的自然，才严格限制游客数量。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: It's precisely because we love this mountain's nature that we strictly limit visitor numbers.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 正因为待在日本才能做高水平的研究，所以在出成果之前我不想回国。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Only because I'm in Japan can I do advanced research, so I don't want to go home until this work bears fruit.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 可以说这部3D电影正因为有高超的CG技术才做得出来。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: You could say this 3D film exists precisely because of advanced CG technology.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 正因为是好朋友，才能互相指出对方的缺点。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: It's precisely because they're close friends that they can point out each other's faults.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 不能明确说“绝对……”，没底气或不想把话说死时的说法。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: For when you can't say it outright — no confidence, or you'd rather not commit.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: V-ない／いA く／なA で ＋ ないことはない／ないこともない
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: V-ない / いAく / なAで + ないことはない (also ないこともない)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 双重否定，语气留有余地：飲めないことはない＝不是不能喝。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: A double negative that leaves room: 飲めないことはない means it's not that I can't drink.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 与「～ことはない」（没必要）方向相反，注意别混。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: The opposite of ～ことはない (no need to); don't mix them up.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 卡拉OK也不是不去，就是被人叫的时候陪着去一下而已。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: It's not that I never go to karaoke — I go along when I'm invited, that's all.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 打针嘛，不可能完全不疼，不过护士不同疼的程度完全不一样。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: It's an injection, so of course it hurts a little — but how much depends entirely on the nurse.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 做到极限：能……就尽量……。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: To the limit: as much as you can.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: V-できる ＋ だけ（也有 V たい／ほしい／好きな ＋ だけ 的形式）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: V-できる + だけ (also V-たい / ほしい / 好きな + だけ)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 「食べ放題だったので食べられるだけ食べた」のように、上限まで行う。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Go to the ceiling: 食べ放題だったので食べられるだけ食べた.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 与表示限定的「～だけ」区分，这里不是“只有”，而是“尽可能”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Different from limiting だけ — this is as much as possible, not only.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 春节前，小林能带多少特产就带多少，回国了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Before the Spring Festival, Lin went home carrying as many souvenirs as she could.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 请把能用“生”这个汉字的词尽量都写出来。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Write as many words as you can that use the kanji 生.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 难过的时候，想哭多久就哭多久吧。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: When you're sad, cry as much as you want.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 今天刚摘的番茄。想要多少拿多少。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: These tomatoes were picked today. Take as many as you like.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 说明理由或辩解：因为……嘛。もん 主要是女性和儿童用语。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Gives a reason or an excuse — because, that's why. もん is mainly women's and children's speech.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 普通形 ＋ もん
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: plain form + もん (the stem form also works)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 口语，带撒娇或辩解的语感：だって…だもん。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 正式场合不用；成年男性用会显得孩子气。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 科长说想在明天的会上把这个方案通过，可没那么容易定下来。问题还一大堆呢。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 因为某种理由“不能做”，或“不做不行”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Can't do it — or can't get away without doing it — for a specific reason.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: V-る／V-ない ＋ わけにはいかない
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: V-る / V-ない + わけにはいかない

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 「休むわけにはいかない」＝不能休息；「働かないわけにはいかない」＝不得不工作。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: 休むわけにはいかない: I can't take the day off. 働かないわけにはいかない: I have to work.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 与「～わけではない」（并非……）不同，别混。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Not the same as ～わけではない, which denies.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 只有……。多见于通知、告示等书面语。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Only — mostly in notices and written announcements.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: V-る／N ＋ のみ
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: V-る / N + のみ

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Also ただ～のみ: あとは結果を待つのみだ.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: V-た / い-adjective / な-adjective+な / N+の + つもり

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 「旅行に行ったつもりで…」のように、仮定の気持ちで行動する。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Act on the assumption: 旅行に行ったつもりで…

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 与表示打算的「～つもりだ」不同，这里是“就当是……”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Not the ～つもりだ of intention — here it means pretend that.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 就当是去旅行了，看看这张《列车之旅》的DVD乐一乐吧。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Let's pretend we went traveling and enjoy this Train Journey DVD.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 听说女儿在体验学习时，当自己是妈妈一样照顾婴儿。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Apparently at the hands-on class my daughter cared for the baby as if she were its mother.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 总以为自己还年轻就熬夜，会把身体搞坏的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: If you keep pulling all-nighters thinking you're still young, you'll wreck your health.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 那位护理员说，她是把老人当真正的家人来照顾的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: The care worker said she looks after the elderly as if they were her own family.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 正因为爱这片自然才限制游客，用「～ばこそ」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Precisely because we love it: ～ばこそ.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 不能说完全不疼，双重否定留余地，用「～ないことはない」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: It's not that it doesn't hurt at all: ～ないことはない.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 想哭多少哭多少，用「～たい＋だけ」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Cry as much as you want: ～たい+だけ.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 撒娇式说明理由，用「～もん」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: A pouty reason: ～もん.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 因为有会议所以不能回去，用「～わけにはいかない」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Can't leave because of the meeting: ～わけにはいかない.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 告示类书面语“只限邮寄”，用「～のみ」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: A written notice for by post only: ～のみ.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 就当是去旅行了，用「～たつもりで」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Pretend we went: ～たつもりで.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 「～ないわけにはいかない」＝不得不做，这里说“不能不出”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: ～ないわけにはいかない: we can't get away without paying.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.word.0.en: ～放題 means all you can do of it

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.word.3.en: written 北京烤鸭 in Chinese

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.word.4.zh: 日本料理、西餐、中餐的合称。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.word.4.en: Japanese, Western and Chinese cuisine together

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.word.6.en: a な-adjective: 空腹で行く

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.word.9.zh: 称呼别人女儿时的敬称。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.word.9.en: the polite word for someone's daughter

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.word.1.en: as in 5時間ぶっ続けで歩く
as in ペンキをぬる
よその人 means a stranger
casual, more frequent than よく

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.word.2.en: as in くしゃみが出る
as in いたずらする

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.word.3.en: also a curve on a graph

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 程度高得没法用语言形容，带感叹、诉苦的语气。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: So extremely that words fail — said with a sigh of wonder or complaint.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 普通形 ＋ のなんのって；なA＋な ＋ のなんのって（例：嫌なのなんのって）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: plain form + のなんのって; な-adjective: なA＋な ＋ のなんのって

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 多接表示感觉、状态的词：痛いのなんのって／うるさいのなんのって／忙しかったのなんのって。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Usually follows words of sensation or state: 痛いのなんのって, うるさいのなんのって, 忙しかったのなんのって.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 只用于口语，且限于跟自己人说话；不能接数字或客观事实。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Spoken only, and only with people close to you; it never carries numbers or plain facts.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 拔了虫牙以后，疼得简直没法说。什么都吃不了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: After they pulled my bad tooth, the pain was beyond words. I can't eat anything.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 隔壁房间的人用电视看足球，吵得不得了，我完全睡不着。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: The guy next door was watching soccer on TV — the noise was unreal, I couldn't sleep at all.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 突然被部长叫去，说要不要跟他女儿相亲。我吓了一跳，简直不敢信。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: The boss suddenly called me in and asked if I'd meet his daughter for an arranged marriage talk. You can't imagine how startled I was.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 上午忙得不可开交，连上厕所的工夫都没有。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: This morning was frantic beyond belief — I didn't even have time for the bathroom.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 刚做好、刚完成，还带着那个状态。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Just made, just finished — still in that fresh state.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: V-ます ＋ たて（作る・できる・焼く・なる 等）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: verb stem + たて (作る, できる, 焼く, なる and similar)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 焼きたてのパン／できたてのご飯／ペンキぬりたて／覚えたての歌，都强调“刚完成，还热乎/还新”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: 焼きたてのパン, できたてのご飯, ペンキぬりたて, 覚えたての歌 — the point is it has just been done.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 与「～たばかり」不同：たて 强调状态新鲜，且只接有限的几个动词；たばかり 只讲时间近。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Different from ～たばかり: たて stresses the fresh state and attaches to only a few verbs, while たばかり just marks recent time.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 刚煮好的米饭真是好啊，感觉能吃好几碗。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Freshly cooked rice is really something. I feel like I could eat bowl after bowl.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 这个长凳说是刚刷的漆。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: They say this bench has just been painted.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 对身边亲近的人提出批评、抱怨时用，带亲昵的责怪语气。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: For criticising someone close to you — a fond sort of scolding.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: N ＋ ったら（也作 N ＋ ってば）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: N + ったら (also N + ってば)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 把对方的名字或称呼直接接上 ったら，后面接抱怨内容：お父さんったら、また…。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Attach it straight to the name: お父さんったら、また…

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 只能用于平辈、晚辈或家人；对上级用会失礼。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Only for peers, juniors and family; rude to a superior.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 我家狗啊，我穿上浴衣，它把我当成外人叫起来了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Our dog — when I put on a yukata, he mistook me for a stranger and started barking.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 我弟弟呀，把我留着的点心全吃光了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: My little brother went and ate every sweet I'd been saving.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 我妈呀，老是擅自进我房间。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: My mother keeps walking into my room without asking.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 我们社长啊，说要在正门立自己的铜像。真是头疼。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Our president says he's putting a bronze statue of himself at the main entrance. What a headache.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 说明机械、系统或身体机制：一旦做了某事或发生某事，就会自动接下去发生另一件事。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Explains a mechanism: do this, or let that happen, and the next thing follows automatically.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: V-る／V-ない ＋ ようになっている
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: V-る / V-ない + ようになっている

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 泥棒が窓を壊すとブザーが鳴るようになっている／お金を入れると水が出るようになっている，都是“设计成这样的”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: 泥棒が窓を壊すとブザーが鳴るようになっている, お金を入れると水が出るようになっている — it is built to work that way.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 与「～ようにしている」（自己刻意保持的习惯）区分：なっている 是客观机制。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Not ～ようにしている, which is a habit you keep on purpose; なっている is how the thing works.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 灰尘进到鼻子里就会打喷嚏，身体自然把它排出去。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Dust gets in your nose, you sneeze, and the body expels it — that's how it's set up.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 听说最近的回转寿司靠盘子上的感应器，能自动算出吃了多少钱。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Apparently modern conveyor-belt sushi places use a sensor on the plate to tally what you've eaten automatically.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 这家酒店的门一关上就会自动上锁，外出时请务必带上这张房卡。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: The doors here lock themselves when they close, so please be sure to take this key card when you go out.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 世界第一台自动售货机是两千多年前在埃及造的，据说投币就会出水。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: The world's first vending machine was built in Egypt over two thousand years ago, and it was set up to dispense water when you inserted a coin.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 这个打火机把点火部分做硬了，小孩乱玩也打不着火。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: This lighter has a stiff ignition, so a child playing with it can't get a flame.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 想不通的事，知道原因后恍然大悟：难怪……、原来如此。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: The click of understanding once you learn the reason: so that's why.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 普通形 ＋ わけだ；なA な／N な（N である） ＋ わけだ（「～というわけだ」的形式也有）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: plain form + わけだ; な-adjectives and nouns take な (nouns also である) + わけだ (also ～というわけだ)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 開かないわけだ、かぎがかかっているよ／人気があるわけだ、おいしいもの，都是“理由明白了”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: 開かないわけだ、かぎがかかっているよ / 人気があるわけだ、おいしいもの — the reason has just become clear.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 理由不明时用「どういうわけか」（不知为什么）；与「～はずだ」（推测）不同，わけだ 是事后的领会。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: When the reason is unknown you say どういうわけか. Unlike ～はずだ (prediction), わけだ is hindsight.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 这个游戏难怪火。一玩才知道，角色有个性，故事也独特，太棒了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: No wonder this game is popular. I tried it — the characters are distinctive and the story is original. It's excellent.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: A どころか B：不是 A，反而是相反的 B；或 B 比 A 程度更甚。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: A どころか B: not A but the opposite B — or B is even worse than A.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 普通形 ＋ どころか；なA 词干（な）／N ＋ どころか
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: plain form + どころか; な-adjective stems (with or without な) and nouns + どころか

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 雨が降るどころかすごくいい天気になった（相反）／漢字どころかひらがなもわからない（更甚）。A 常是对方说的或自己原先以为的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: 雨が降るどころかすごくいい天気になった (opposite) / 漢字どころかひらがなもわからない (worse). A is often what the other person said or what you first assumed.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 后项要出乎意料，不能是同一方向的程度加强；与「～ばかりか」（不仅……而且）语感不同。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: B must overturn the expectation; it isn't just a stronger version of A. Different from ～ばかりか (not only).

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 高中时别说出国旅行，连国内旅行都没去过。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: In high school I'd never travelled abroad — I hadn't even travelled within Japan.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 一开始别说在网上跟人聊天了，连怎么联网都不知道。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: At first I couldn't chat with anyone online — I didn't even know how to get connected.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 刚来日本时路不熟，别说骑车去超市了，连一个人在家附近走走都做不到。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: When I first came to Japan I didn't know the roads — forget cycling to the supermarket, I couldn't even walk around the neighbourhood alone.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 照现在这个状态下去不会有好的结果——带批评、担心的语气。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Keep going like this and it won't end well — a note of criticism or worry.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: V-る／V-ない ＋ ようでは／ようじゃ
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: V-る / V-ない + ようでは (casual: ようじゃ)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 后面接否定性判断：～ようでは、社会人としてまずい／～ようじゃ、やっていけない。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: What follows is a negative verdict: ～ようでは、社会人としてまずい / ～ようじゃ、やっていけない.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 与「～ようだ」（推测）无关；这里 よう 是“样子、状态”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Nothing to do with ～ようだ (seems); here よう means the state of things.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 完全不注意打扮的话，作为社会人不太行吧？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: If you don't give a thought to how you look, that's a problem for a working adult, isn't it?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 连截稿日都守不住，是当不了漫画家的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: If you can't meet deadlines, you can't make it as a manga artist.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 老师说，就算到了高级，遇到生词还一个个查字典，阅读是不会变好的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: My teacher told me that even at an advanced level, if you look up every unknown word one by one, your reading won't improve.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 刚烤好的，用「～たて」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Just baked: ～たて.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 写到一半没写完，用「～かけ」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Half-written and unfinished: ～かけ.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 刚摘下来的，用「とれたて」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Just picked: とれたて.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 喝了一半的，用「～かけ」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Half-drunk: ～かけ.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 自己刻意保持的习惯，用「～ようにしている」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: A habit you keep on purpose: ～ようにしている.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 机器本身的设计，用「～ようになっている」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: How the device is built: ～ようになっている.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 人一来就自动亮灯，是设备机制，用「～ようになっている」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: The lights come on automatically: ～ようになっている.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 知道理由后的领会，用「～わけだ」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Understanding the reason: ～わけだ.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 根据情况推测，用「～はずだ」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: An inference from what was said: ～はずだ.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: “应该做什么”，用「～べきか」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: What one ought to do: ～べきか.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 不是安静，反而很吵，用「～どころか」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Far from quiet, it's noisy: ～どころか.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 别说车了，连房子也不行，用「～どころか」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Forget a car — even a house is out of reach: ～どころか.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 别说五公里，一公里都跑不了，用「～どころか」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Not five kilometres — not even one: ～どころか.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 知道原因后的领会，用「～わけです」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Now the reason is clear: ～わけです.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 大得没法形容，用「～のなんのって」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: So big words fail: ～のなんのって.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 对身边人带责怪地称呼，用「～ったら」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Scolding someone close by name: ～ったら.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 照这个状态下去不行，用「～ようじゃ」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: At this rate it won't work: ～ようじゃ.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 别说德语，连英语都说不利索，用「～どころか」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Not German — not even English: ～どころか.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.word.0.en: 見通し: how far you can see ahead

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.word.3.en: as in チャットする

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.word.6.en: alongside 初級 and 中級

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.word.1.en: as in 高いものを狙う
元 here means what you paid

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.word.1.zh: 常与「～ところだった」连用。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.word.2.en: 偉ぶる means to put on airs
お嬢様ぶる: to act the young lady
as in 賞を独占する

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.word.3.en: まずい is the opposite of おいしい
as in バレンタインチョコ

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 其实并不是那样，却故意做出那个样子给人看。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Not actually so, but putting on that appearance.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: N／なA 词干／いA 词干 ＋ ぶる（如 上品ぶる・偉ぶる・悪ぶる・いい子ぶる）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: noun, な-adjective or い-adjective stem + ぶる (上品ぶる, 偉ぶる, 悪ぶる, いい子ぶる)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 常与「優等生・悪者・大人・上品・いい子・偉い」等词搭配；ぶる 按一类动词活用：ぶらない／ぶって。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Pairs with words like 優等生, 悪者, 大人, 上品, いい子, 偉い. ぶる conjugates like a godan verb: ぶらない, ぶって.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 带贬义，暗示“装出来的”；不能用于真心的状态。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Always slighting — it implies a pose, never a genuine state.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 以前我在喜欢的女孩面前装坏。其实只是没勇气说喜欢而已。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: I used to act tough in front of a girl I liked. The truth is I just didn't have the courage to tell her.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 那人明明是大企业的社长，却一点架子都没有。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: He runs a major company but doesn't put on airs at all.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 就算在帅哥面前，要我装大小姐也做不到。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Even in front of someone handsome, I could never pull off acting like a young lady.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 某个立场的人普遍有某种倾向——带批评的口气。也用于“偏偏在这种时候”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: People in that position all tend to do this — said critically. Also for a bad-timing twist.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: N ＋ に限って
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: N + に限って

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 金持ちに限ってけちだ／初心者に限って偉そうに言う，都是“这一类人偏偏这样”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: 金持ちに限ってけちだ / 初心者に限って偉そうに言う — this kind of person, of all people.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 另有「～のとき運悪く」用法：急いでいるときに限ってバスが来ない。与「～に限る」（最好）无关。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: A second use is bad timing: 急いでいるときに限ってバスが来ない. Nothing to do with ～に限る (the best).

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 偏偏是不懂的人爱摆架子说大话。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: It's always the ones who know nothing who talk big.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 偏偏是有钱人小气，不愿掏钱。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: It's the rich who are stingy and hate parting with money.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 山田说偏偏是开好车的人住便宜公寓，真的吗？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Yamada said the people driving expensive cars are the ones living in cheap flats. I wonder if that's true.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 偏偏在没钱的日子，朋友来叫喝酒。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Of all days, on the broke ones my friends invite me out for a drink.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 偏偏赶时间的时候公交不来。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: The bus never comes when you're in a hurry.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 明明有重要的考试，偏偏今天睡过头了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: I had an important exam, and of all days I overslept today.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 说话人的判断：应该……、最好……。多用于给建议。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: The speaker's judgement — you should, it's best to. Mostly advice.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: V-る／V-ない ＋ ことだ
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: V-る / V-ない + ことだ

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 强くなりたかったら、自分の長所を伸ばすことです／風邪を防ぐには換気をすることです。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: 強くなりたかったら、自分の長所を伸ばすことです / 風邪を防ぐには換気をすることです.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 与「～ことがある」（有时）和「～ことになった」（决定）区分；ことだ 只表劝告。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Not ～ことがある (sometimes) or ～ことになった (it was decided); ことだ gives advice only.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 工作也好别的也好，别一个人烦恼，找人商量商量。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Whatever it is, don't agonise alone — talk it over with someone.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 想变强，就得把自己的长处磨出来。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: If you want to get stronger, build on what you're already good at.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 要防霉，就得每天给房间通风。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: To keep mould away, air the room every day.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 想跟室友过得愉快，就得注意别给对方添麻烦。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: To live happily with a roommate, be careful not to inconvenience each other.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 所有的……、每一个……。同一个名词重复，强调无一例外。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Every last one — the noun is repeated to leave no exceptions.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: N ＋ という ＋ N（同一名词重复）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: N + という + N (the same noun twice)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 店という店が閉まっていた／木という木が燃えた，都是“全部、一个不剩”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: 店という店が閉まっていた / 木という木が燃えた — all of them, without exception.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 重复的名词必须完全相同；不能换成同类词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: The repeated noun must be identical; you can't swap in a related word.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 这次森林火灾，这一带的树一棵不剩全烧了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: In this forest fire, every single tree around here burned — not one was left.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 田中导演凭这部片子，把今年电影相关的奖项几乎全包了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: With this film, director Tanaka swept every film award going this year.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 圣诞节去伦敦，店家家都关门，什么都没买成。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: I went to London at Christmas and every shop was shut — I couldn't buy a thing.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 樱花季节每条路上都挤满游客，对当地人来说真是麻烦。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: In cherry-blossom season every street overflows with tourists — a nuisance for the locals.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 差点就变成那种状况，实际上没有发生。常与「危うく」连用。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: It nearly came to that, but didn't. Usually with 危うく.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: V-る ＋ ところだった（也接「～なければならない」「～ざるを得ない」等）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: V-る + ところだった (also after ～なければならない, ～ざるを得ない)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: もう少しでけがをするところだった／危うく遅刻するところだった，都是“好险”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: もう少しでけがをするところだった / 危うく遅刻するところだった — that was close.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 与「～はずだった」（本该……却没）不同：ところだった 是“险些发生”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Not ～はずだった (was supposed to): ところだった is a near miss.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 今早睡过头三十分钟，差点迟到。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: I overslept by half an hour this morning and nearly missed being late.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 看漫画看入迷了，要不是朋友提醒，就坐过站了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: I was absorbed in a manga — if my friend hadn't told me, I'd have missed my stop.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 爷爷的病要是再晚发现一点，就来不及了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: If my grandfather's illness had been found a little later, it would have been too late.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: A 的话太不划算，那就宁可选 B——B 也未必好，但比 A 强。也可用于后悔。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: If it means A, I'd rather have B — B isn't great, but better than A. Also used for regret.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: V-る ＋ くらいなら
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: V-る + くらいなら

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 1時間待つくらいならほかの店に行こう／15,000円も払うくらいなら新しいのを買う。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: 1時間待つくらいならほかの店に行こう / 15,000円も払うくらいなら新しいのを買う.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 后项常带「～ほうがいい」「～たほうがましだ」；后悔时用「～ばよかったのに」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: B often ends in ～ほうがいい or ～たほうがましだ; for regret it's ～ばよかったのに.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 花钱坐电车，还不如骑自行车去，虽然费时间。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Rather than pay for the train, I'd sooner cycle even if it takes longer.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 跟别的情况比，虽说不上好，但至少不是最糟。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Compared with the alternative, not good but at least not the worst.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: V-た／N の ＋ ほうがましだ（常与 ～より・～だけ・まだ・ずっと 连用）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: V-た / N + の + ほうがましだ (often with ～より, ～だけ, まだ, ずっと)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 「まずい」って言われるよりましでしょ／仕事があるだけましだ，都是“总比……强”。

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「本来就……嘛」——讲的是世上的常理，不是眼前某一件具体的事。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: “That's just how it is” — this states a general truth about the world, not one particular event.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 把一件事抬到「本来就是这样」的高度：人都会犯错、孩子总爱玩、时间过得快。句子里一般不点具体某个人，说的是一般情况，语气里带点感慨或说教。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: It lifts something to the level of 本来就是这样: people make mistakes, children play, time flies. The subject is usually general rather than one named person, and the tone carries a sigh or a mild lecture.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 动词辞书形／ない形＋ものだ；い形容词＋ものだ；な形容词＋な＋ものだ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Dictionary form / ない-form + ものだ; i-adjective + ものだ; na-adjective + な + ものだ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 中文的“应该”会误导人。这里不是推测，是在讲道理：根据线索推断才用「はずだ」，陈述“世道本来如此”才用「ものだ」。另外别和「たものだ」混——辞书形讲常理，た形讲回忆。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Chinese 应该 is misleading here. This is not inference: use はずだ when deducing from evidence, and ものだ when stating how the world generally works. Do not confuse it with たものだ either — dictionary form states a general truth, た-form recalls the past.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 人嘛，谁都会犯错。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Everyone fails at some point — that is just how people are.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 婴儿夜里就是要哭的。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Babies cry at night; that is simply what babies do.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 上了年纪，就觉得时间过得特别快。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: As you get older, time really does fly.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「想当年啊……」——回忆过去反复做过的事，语气里带怀念。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: “Back in those days…” — recalls something done over and over in the past, with nostalgia.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 说的是一段时期里常有的事，一开口就像“小时候啊”“那会儿啊”。和单纯叙述过去的「～ていた」比，它多了一层感慨，常出现在闲聊、随笔里。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: It describes what used to happen over a stretch of time, the way people start with when I was a kid. Compared with plain ～ていた, it adds a layer of feeling, which is why it shows up in conversation and personal essays.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 动词た形＋ものだ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Verb た-form + ものだ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 中文母语者容易只当成“过去时”。重点不在时间，在怀念。客观报告过去的状态用「～ていた」就够，加「たものだ」会像老人在感慨。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Learners often read it as a plain past tense. The point is not the time but the nostalgia. For a neutral report of a past state, ～ていた is enough; たものだ sounds like someone reminiscing.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 小时候常在这条河里游泳。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: When I was a child I used to swim in this river all the time.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 学生时代，常和朋友聊到深夜。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: In my student days we would talk with friends until late at night.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 从前这一带也是很安静的。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: This neighbourhood used to be so quiet, back in the day.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「因为……嘛」——给已经发生的事补一个理由，带解释或辩解的口气。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: “Because…, you see” — supplies a reason for something that already happened, often as an excuse.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 事情已经出了，说话人在说明“我不是故意的，是因为……”。道歉、迟到、推掉邀约时最常听见，后半句常接「遅れました」「できませんでした」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Something has already gone wrong and the speaker is explaining that it was not on purpose. It is common in apologies, for lateness, and when turning down an invitation, with 遅れました or できませんでした in the main clause.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 普通形＋ものだから（な形容词・名词＋な＋ものだから）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Plain form + ものだから (na-adjective / noun + な + ものだから)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「から」只是中性交代原因；「ものだから」是在请求体谅，像“你也知道嘛，所以……”。对上级或写正式文书时少用，会显得太随便。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: から states a cause neutrally; ものだから asks the listener to be understanding, roughly you know how it is, so…. Avoid it with superiors or in formal writing, where it sounds too casual.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 因为早上睡过头了，所以没赶上电车。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: I overslept, so I missed the train.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 路上堵得厉害，所以来晚了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: The traffic was terrible, so I was late for our appointment.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 我日语还听不太懂，能请您说慢一点吗？
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: I still don't follow Japanese well, so could you speak a little more slowly?

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「虽说……可是……」——先认下前半句，后半句却不如人意。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: “Granted…, but…” — concedes the first half, then reports a result that fell short.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 书面语，多见于文章、报告和新闻。A 是事实，但顺着 A 该出现的 B 没有出现，说话人只是平静地指出这个落差。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: A written register found in articles, reports and news. A is true, but the B that should follow from A did not happen, and the speaker simply notes the gap.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 动词・い形容词普通形／な形容词词干＋な・である／名词＋である＋ものの
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Verb / i-adjective plain form; na-adjective stem + な or である; noun + である + ものの

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 别和「ものを」混。「ものの」是平静的转折，不带责怪；「ものを」带“明明可以……你却……”的埋怨，是情绪化的。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Do not confuse it with ものを. ものの turns calmly with no blame; ものを carries the complaint of you could have, and yet you didn't.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 驾照是拿到了，但几乎没开过车。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: I got my licence, but I hardly ever drive.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 试了新药，可是没有效果。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: They tried the new drug, but it had no effect.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 虽然回了公司，却没再被委以原来的工作。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: He returned to the company, but was never given his old work again.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 两种假设共用一个外壳：「要是真能……就好了」和「万一……可就糟了」，看前面的动词形式分。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Two kinds of hypothetical share one frame: if only I could…, and if anyone were to…, it would be a disaster. The verb form in front tells you which.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 可能形＋ものなら，是明知做不到还是忍不住想；意向形＋ものなら，是一旦真做了就会有严重后果。前者常接「～たい」，后者常接「大変だ」「終わりだ」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Potential form + ものなら expresses a wish the speaker knows is out of reach and usually pairs with ～たい. Volitional form + ものなら warns of serious consequences and pairs with 大変だ or 終わりだ.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 可能形＋ものなら；意向形（～よう）＋ものなら
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Potential form + ものなら; volitional form (～よう) + ものなら
