nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 不能笼统记成“如果”。中文都用“要是……”，日文靠动词形式区分：看到「戻れる」是想回去，看到「戻ろう」是警告别回去。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Do not reduce it to if. Chinese uses 要是 for both, but Japanese splits them by verb form: 戻れる means wanting to go back, 戻ろう means warning against going back.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 要是能行，我真想再回到学生时代。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: If I could, I would go back to my student days once more.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 这事要是跟他提一句，准传得满家都知道。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: If you so much as tell him this secret, the whole family will know.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 在社长面前说那种话，马上就会被开除。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Say something like that in front of the president and you will be fired on the spot.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「明明……却偏偏……」——带埋怨或替对方可惜。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: “You could have…, and yet…” — carries reproach, or regret on someone else's behalf.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 本来有更好的做法，或者本该出现另一个结果，现实偏不。常见于「～ばいいものを」「～たらいいものを」，说话人站在“我早就说过”的位置上。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: A better course was open, or another result was expected, and reality went the other way. It often appears as ～ばいいものを or ～たらいいものを, with the speaker in the position of having said so all along.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 普通形＋ものを（常见：～ばいいものを／～たらいいものを）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Plain form + ものを (often ～ばいいものを / ～たらいいものを)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 语气比「ものの」重得多，是情绪化的。写客观报告用「ものの」，说“你怎么不早说呢”用「ものを」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: It is far more emotional than ものの. For a neutral report use ものの; for why on earth didn't you say so, use ものを.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 你早说的话我就帮你了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: If you had told me earlier, I would have helped.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 本来闭嘴就没事，偏偏多嘴说了不该说的。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: He could simply have kept quiet, but he had to go and say the wrong thing.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 打个电话我就去接你了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: One phone call and I would have come to pick you up.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「可不能……啊」——从做人的道理出发劝人，不是硬性规定。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: “One simply doesn't…” — advice grounded in decency rather than a rule.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 长辈、老师、社论的口吻：人不该这样。常见于「人の悪口を言うものではない」「約束を破るものではない」这类教训，也用于自省。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: The voice of an elder, a teacher or an editorial: people should not behave this way. It appears in admonitions like 人の悪口を言うものではない or 約束を破るものではない, and in self-reflection.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 动词辞书形＋ものではない
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Dictionary form + ものではない

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 三种“不许”要分清：「てはいけない」是规则禁止，「べきではない」是理性规范，「ものではない」是道德劝说。对平辈用会显得居高临下。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Three kinds of prohibition: てはいけない is a rule, べきではない a reasoned norm, ものではない moral advice. Used with a peer it sounds condescending.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 不该在背后说人坏话。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: One should not speak ill of others behind their backs.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 年轻的时候，不该净挑轻松的路走。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: When you are young you should not always take the easy road.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 对长辈不该用那种口气说话。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: You should not speak that way to someone senior to you.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「这才叫……」——给一件事下定义、作评价。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: “Now that is what you call…” — defines or evaluates something.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 说话人认为某件事才真正配得上某个说法，常带感慨或断言，句尾几乎固定为「～というものだ」。多用于议论、演讲和随笔。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: The speaker holds that something genuinely deserves a name, usually with a note of conviction. The ending is almost always ～というものだ, and it belongs to argument, speeches and essays.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 普通形／名词＋というものだ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Plain form / noun + というものだ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 普通「という」只是引用或命名，没有评价；加了「ものだ」才变成“这才算得上”。也别写成「ということだ」——那是传闻或总结。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Plain という only quotes or names. Adding ものだ turns it into an evaluation. Do not write ということだ either, which reports hearsay or sums up.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 默默帮助有困难的人，这才叫亲切。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Quietly helping someone in trouble — now that is what kindness means.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 决定的事做到最后，这才叫负责。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Seeing through what you have decided — that is what responsibility means.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 不表达自己的意见、只看别人脸色，那不叫配合，叫服从。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Never stating your own view and only watching others' faces is not cooperation — it is submission.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 想当年……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: I was thinking about it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「～たものだ」是在带着感慨回忆过去反复发生的事。这里不是单纯说“聊过”，而是“想当年，我们常常聊到天亮”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: ～たものだ recalls repeated past events with emotion: we used to talk until dawn, rather than simply having talked once.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 本来就……嘛
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: It was...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 这里说的是普遍规律：到了新环境，谁一开始都会不安。中文的“人嘛，本来就……”最贴近这种常理语气。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: And here's the general rule: when we get to a new environment, everyone starts to worry. The Chinese word "people," it's the most common tone.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 因为……嘛
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Because...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 说话人在解释没能及时回复的原因，带一点“是因为会议拖长了嘛”的说明、辩解语气。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: The speaker explained the reasons for the failure to respond in a timely manner, with an explanation and justification “because the meeting was prolonged”.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 虽说……可是……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: A neutral concession, without blame or regret.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 合格这件事成立，但会话仍没自信，结果与预期有落差。「ものの」是较客观的逆接。 补充：ものを也能表示“明明已经通过”，但带更强的不满或遗憾；ものの是较中性的转折。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Target expression: ものの. Intended meaning: A neutral concession, without blame or regret. Compared alternatives: ものを. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 要是真能……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: If it's true...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: “能休一周”在现实中不太容易实现，因此用「ものなら」表达“要是真能做到的话”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: "A week off" is not easy to achieve in reality, so it's called "ものなら" and "if you can do it."

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 明明……却偏偏……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: But it's just...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 本来只要商量一下就能帮忙，他却偏偏独自熬夜做完。这里有明显的遗憾和埋怨，所以用「ものを」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: He could have helped if he had just talked about it, but he did it alone. There were obvious regrets and grievances, so use "ものを. "

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 哪能…… / 可不能……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: How can... / Can't...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 这不是法律禁令，而是在讲做人做事的常理：哪能不听解释就单方面责备别人。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: This is not a legal prohibition; it is the common sense to do things: to blame others unilaterally if they do not listen to an explanation.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 这才叫……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: That's what I call...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 说话人在对“真正的友情”作评价、下定义。「というものだ」最自然地对应“这才叫真正的友情”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: The talker evaluates and defines "real friendship". "というものだ" most naturally corresponds to "that's what true friendship is."

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 想当年……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: I was thinking about it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「昔」「祭りになると」共同提示过去反复出现的景象，句中还有回忆和感慨的味道。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: 昔 and 祭りになると together evoke a recurring past scene, with a sense of recollection and emotion.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 虽说……可是……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: A neutral concession, without blame or regret.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 练习了很多次，但正式场合仍说不出话，是客观的预期落差；没有责怪谁的情绪，因此选「ものの」。 补充：ものを可强调努力付诸东流的遗憾；ものの只是承认练习过但结果不理想。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Target expression: ものの. Intended meaning: A neutral concession, without blame or regret. Compared alternatives: ものを. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 因为……嘛
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Because...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 正在为“忘带资料”解释原因：因为早上慌慌张张出门了嘛。这个解释语气正是「ものだから」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: The explanation for "forgetting information" is because it's open in the morning. It's called "ものだから".

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 要是真能……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: If it's true...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 回到过去几乎无法实现，所以不是普通的“如果”，而是带强烈愿望的“要是真能回去的话”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Returning to the past is almost impossible, so it is not the ordinary “if” but the “if it is possible to go back” with a strong desire.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 「原来如此，怪不得……」——听完原因，自己把结论接上。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: “Ah, so that's why…” — the listener puts the pieces together after hearing the reason.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 前半给事实或原因，后半是“这么说就说得通了”。常出现在对话里表示理解，也可以用来解释自己刚发现的事。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: The first half gives the fact or cause and the second half says that explains it. It appears in conversation to show understanding, and also when the speaker has just worked something out.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 普通形＋わけだ（な形容词・名词＋な＋わけだ）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Plain form + わけだ (na-adjective / noun + な + わけだ)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 不是「から」的同义词。「から」是说话人主动给原因；「わけだ」是听完之后确认“难怪”。方向和视角都不同。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It is not a synonym of から. から has the speaker supplying a cause; わけだ has the speaker confirming that this explains it after hearing it. The direction and viewpoint differ.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 天天都在练啊，怪不得进步这么快。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: She practises every day, so of course she improves quickly.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 空调坏了啊，怪不得这么热。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: The air conditioner was broken — no wonder it was so hot.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 在日本住了十年，日语当然好。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: After ten years in Japan, it is only natural that his Japanese is good.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 「怎么可能……」——从常识或证据出发，断定绝不可能。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: “How could it possibly…” — a flat denial grounded in common sense or evidence.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 对某个说法直接否定，语气比单纯的否定重得多，常带“你在开玩笑吧”的味道。书面和口语都能用。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It rejects a claim outright, far more forcefully than a plain negative, with a note of you must be joking. It works both in speech and in writing.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 普通形＋わけがない（な形容词词干＋な・である；名词＋の・である）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Plain form + わけがない (na-adjective stem + な or である; noun + の or である)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 和「はずがない」几乎同义，但「わけがない」更像反问“哪有这种道理”，情绪更外露；正式文书里「はずがない」更常见。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Nearly the same as はずがない, but わけがない sounds more like a retort, as if to say that makes no sense, and shows more feeling. Formal writing prefers はずがない.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 他怎么可能忘记那种约定。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: There is no way he would forget a promise like that.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 一晚上怎么可能读完整本书。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: There is no way anyone could read this whole book in one night.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 这么冷，怎么可能在外面等。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It is freezing out — of course nobody could wait outside.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 「也不是说……」——承认一半，否掉对方可能顺势推出的结论。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: “It's not that…” — concedes part of it while blocking the conclusion the listener is about to draw.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 常见结构是“A 是 A，但也不是 B”。用来纠正误解，语气比直接否定缓和，后半句常接「ただ」「でも」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: The usual shape is A is A, but it is not as far as B. It corrects a misunderstanding more gently than a flat denial, and the second clause often starts with ただ or でも.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 普通形＋わけではない（な形容词・名词＋な＋わけではない）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Plain form + わけではない (na-adjective / noun + な + わけではない)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 不是全盘否定。中文常译成“并不是”，很多人偷懒写成“不是”，语气一下就硬了，还会让读者以为整句都推翻了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It is not a wholesale denial. The usual Chinese rendering is 并不是; dropping the 并 makes the tone abrupt and suggests the whole statement is being overturned.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 也不是说我讨厌甜食。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It is not that I dislike sweets.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 虽说住在日本，日语也不是完美无缺。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Living in Japan does not mean my Japanese is perfect.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 贵的东西也不一定就好。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Expensive things are not necessarily good.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 「并不意味着……」——否定一整套说法或因果推论。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: “That does not mean…” — rejects a whole claim or the inference drawn from it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 把前面整句话引用过来，再说它推不出某个结论。适合议论、说明文，句子往往较长。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It quotes the whole preceding statement and then denies that it leads anywhere. It suits argument and expository writing, where the sentences tend to be long.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 普通形＋というわけではない（名词・な形容词也可接だ）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Plain form + というわけではない (nouns and na-adjectives may take だ)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 与「わけではない」意思接近，区别在对象：单个词或状态用「わけではない」，一整句话、一种说法用「というわけではない」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Close in meaning to わけではない, but the object differs: a single word or state takes わけではない, a whole sentence or claim takes というわけではない.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 贵并不意味着质量就一定好。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Being expensive does not mean the quality is good.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 名校毕业并不意味着工作能力强。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Graduating from a famous university does not mean someone works well.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 天天吃一样的东西，也不代表就吃腻了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Eating the same thing every day does not mean I am tired of it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 「做得到，但不能做」——受身份、责任或情理约束。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: “I could, but I can't” — blocked by duty, position or what people would think.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 能力上没问题，可立场不允许。常见于“考试前不能玩”“受了恩不能不还”“明天要早起不能喝”。句尾固定为「～わけにはいかない」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: There is no lack of ability; the position forbids it. Typical cases: not going out before an exam, not ignoring a favour, not drinking when you must be up early. The ending is always ～わけにはいかない.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 动词辞书形＋わけにはいかない
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Dictionary form + わけにはいかない

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 中文都译“不能”，但「できない」是客观上做不到，「わけにはいかない」是能做到却不该做。这是考试最常设的陷阱。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Chinese renders both as 不能, but できない means it is impossible while わけにはいかない means it is possible yet improper. This is the trap exams set most often.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 重要考试就在眼前，我可不能跑去玩。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: With an important exam coming, I cannot go out and have fun.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 受过人家照顾，这请求我没法拒绝。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: I cannot turn down a request from someone who has done so much for me.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 明天要早起，今天可不能喝酒。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: I have an early start tomorrow, so I cannot drink today.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 「不得不……」——不做在情理上过不去。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: “I have no choice but to…” — not doing it would be indefensible.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 双重否定，最后落在“只能做”。常和「以上」「からには」呼应，强调是处境逼着自己，而不是规矩要求。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: A double negative that lands on having to. It often follows 以上 or からには and stresses that circumstances leave no way out, rather than a rule demanding it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 动词ない形＋わけにはいかない
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: ない-form + わけにはいかない

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 比「なければならない」更强调具体处境。“规定要这样”用「なければならない」，“人家都开口了，我不能不去”用「ないわけにはいかない」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It stresses a concrete situation more than なければならない does. Use なければならない for what the rules require, and ないわけにはいかない for having been asked and so being unable to refuse.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 既然人家邀请了，我也不能不去。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Since I have been invited, I cannot very well skip it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 借的钱不能不还。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: I cannot avoid paying back money I borrowed.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 学长开口了，我不能不帮。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: When a senior asks me, I cannot refuse to help.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 原来如此 / 怪不得……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: I see. No wonder...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 知道“每天练三小时”这个原因后，自然得出“怪不得进步这么快”的结论。「わけだ」表示根据前面的事实理解了结果。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Knowing the reason for the "three hours a day" comes to the conclusion that "no wonder it's progressing so fast." わけだ means that the results are understood on the basis of the facts.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 原来如此 / 怪不得……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: I see. No wonder...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 今天是节假日，所以银行关门也就说得通了。这里的「わけだ」相当于“原来如此，难怪……”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It's a holiday, so it makes sense that the bank is closed. "わけだ" here is like, "That's the way it is," no wonder.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 并不是说……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: A clarification correcting a possible misunderstanding, without an emphatic impossibility claim.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 后句说明只是为了健康而少吃，并不是讨厌甜食，用部分否定、纠正误解的「わけではない」。わけにはいかない表示“不能那么做”；わけだ是顺理成章的结论；ばかりだ表示变化一路发展，都与后句矛盾或接不上。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: わけではない corrects a possible misunderstanding: I don't dislike sweets, I'm just cutting back. わけにはいかない means "can't afford to"; わけだ draws a natural conclusion; ばかりだ means "keeps getting more". None fits the next sentence.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 并不是说……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: A clarification that the negative conclusion is not entirely true.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 忙是真的，但并非完全见不了面，用「わけではない」否定“完全不能见”的推断。わけだ是结论；ないわけにはいかない表示“不得不”；一方だ要接表示变化的动词，「会えない一方だ」不成立。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: わけではない denies the inference that we can't meet at all. わけだ draws a conclusion; ないわけにはいかない means "have to"; 一方だ needs a verb of change, so 会えない一方だ is ungrammatical.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 怎么可能……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: A strong judgment that the event is impossible.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 根据“他责任感很强”这一判断，说话人强烈断定他不可能忘记重要约定。「わけがない」就是“怎么可能”。 补充：わけにはいかない可从责任角度说“不能忘”，わけがない则判断他不可能忘。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Target expression: わけがない. Intended meaning: A strong judgment that the event is impossible. Compared alternatives: わけにはいかない. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 怎么可能……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: A strong judgment that the event is impossible.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 工作量太大，一小时内全部做完在说话人看来不可能，因此用带强烈否定判断的「わけがない」。 补充：わけではない可以否定“能全部完成”；わけがない则强烈断定不可能。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Target expression: わけがない. Intended meaning: A strong judgment that the event is impossible. Compared alternatives: わけではない. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 不能那么做……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: A constraint arising from responsibility, rather than inability or a prediction.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 不是客观上出不了门，而是因为明天有重要考试，情理和立场上不能去玩。「わけにはいかない」强调这种约束。 补充：わけがない表示断定自己不会去；わけではない表示澄清并不是去玩。若强调考试带来的约束，优先わけにはいかない。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Target expression: わけにはいかない. Intended meaning: A constraint arising from responsibility, rather than inability or a prediction. Compared alternatives: わけがない / わけではない. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 不能那么做……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: A constraint arising from a promise.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 既然答应保密，情理上就不能告诉别人。这里不是能力上的“说不了”，而是立场上“不可以说”。 补充：わけがない可表示“我绝不会说出去”；わけにはいかない强调受托保密的责任。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Target expression: わけにはいかない. Intended meaning: A constraint arising from a promise. Compared alternatives: わけがない. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 不能不…… / 不得不……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: An obligation: one cannot reasonably refuse to participate.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 「ないわけにはいかない」是双重否定：受过老师照顾又被邀请，因此情理上不能不参加，也就是“必须参加”。 补充：参加しないわけがない表示“我不可能不参加”；参加しないわけにはいかない表示人情上不能缺席。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Target expression: わけにはいかない. Intended meaning: An obligation: one cannot reasonably refuse to participate. Compared alternatives: わけがない. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 不能不…… / 不得不……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: An obligation: one cannot reasonably refuse to apologize.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 既然自己的失误给别人添了麻烦，就不能不道歉。「謝らないわけにはいかない」自然对应“不得不道歉”。 补充：謝らないわけがない强调不可能不道歉；謝らないわけにはいかない强调有道歉义务。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Target expression: わけにはいかない. Intended meaning: An obligation: one cannot reasonably refuse to apologize. Compared alternatives: わけがない. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 并不意味着……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It doesn't mean...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 长期住在日本并不等于所有汉字都能读。「というわけではない」否定从前项推出的整体结论，中文就是“并不意味着……”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Long-term residence in Japan does not mean that all kanjis can read. "というわけではない" rejects the entire conclusion of the previous item, and Chinese means "does not mean...".

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 并不意味着……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It doesn't mean...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 价格高不必然推出品质好。这里不是说好品质“绝对不可能”，而是否定两者之间的必然关系。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: High prices do not necessarily lead to good quality. This is not to say that good quality is “absolutely impossible”, but rather to deny the inevitable relationship between the two.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「还是……最好」——拿经验给出一个“就选这个”的推荐。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: “You're best off…” — a recommendation based on experience, pointing at one option.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 问句里常听见“什么好？”“怎么办才好？”，这就是它的答法。说话人自己试过、吃过亏，所以语气笃定：要说这个情况，就这一条路。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: It answers questions like what is good or what should I do. The speaker has tried it and knows better, so the tone is firm: for this situation there is one sensible choice.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 名词／动词辞书形・ない形＋に限る
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Noun / dictionary form or ない-form + に限る

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「に限り」划范围，「に限る」给结论。中文都写“限”，但一个是“仅限本日”，一个是“还是睡觉最好”。看后面有没有名词性成分就能分。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: に限り draws a boundary while に限る delivers a verdict. Both look like 限 in Chinese, but one means only today and the other means sleeping is best. Whether a noun follows tells you which.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 累了的时候，还是早点睡最好。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: When you are worn out, an early night is the best cure.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 夏天热的时候，还是冰啤酒最爽。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: On a hot summer day, a cold beer is the best thing there is.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 拿不定主意的时候，还是用最初的方案最稳。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: When in doubt, the first plan is the safest bet.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「仅限……」——在公告、规则里划一条明确的界线。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: “Limited to…” — draws a firm boundary in notices and rules.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 资格、日期、范围只到这条线为止。语体正式，广告、告示、条款里最常出现，后面接一句普通的说明，不带口语语气。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Eligibility, dates or scope stop at this line. It is formal and belongs to ads, notices and terms, followed by a plain statement with no conversational tone.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 名词＋に限り
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Noun + に限り

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「だけ」也能说“只有”，但「に限り」更像贴在墙上的告示，普通聊天里说会显得硬。中文别一律译“只有”，公告场合用“仅限”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: だけ can also mean only, but に限り reads like a notice on the wall and sounds stiff in conversation. In Chinese, reserve 仅限 for notices and use 只有 elsewhere.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 仅限今天，全部商品半价。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Today only, everything is half price.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 仅限会员使用本服务。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: This service is available to members only.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 仅限前一百名，赠送纪念品。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: A commemorative gift for the first hundred arrivals only.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「偏偏……」——麻烦专挑最不合适的时候来。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: “Of all the times…” — trouble arrives at the worst possible moment.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 平时不出事，偏偏赶在最不希望它发生的那个节骨眼上。带无奈和抱怨，后半句多是坏消息。也用于「うちの子に限って」这类“唯独他不可能”的辩解。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Nothing usually goes wrong, but it does on the very day it hurts most. The tone is helpless and complaining, and the second half is usually bad news. It also appears in defences like うちの子に限って, meaning not my child of all people.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 名词＋に限って
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Noun + に限って

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 两种用法别混：抱怨“偏偏这时候”最常考；「～に限って～ない」是“唯独某人绝不会”。前者后面接坏事，后者后面接否定，看到否定就知道是第二种。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Two uses: the complaint about timing is what exams test most, and ～に限って～ない means someone of all people would never. Bad news follows the first, a negative follows the second, so a negative tells you which one you have.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 偏偏赶时间的时候，电车就晚点。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: The train runs late on exactly the days I am in a hurry.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 偏偏没带伞的那天就下雨。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: It rains on precisely the days I leave my umbrella at home.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 我家孩子绝不会做那种事。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: My child of all people would never do such a thing.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「不光……，连……也」——把范围从 A 扩出去。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: “Not only A but also…” — pushes the scope beyond A.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 先否掉“只到 A 为止”，再把 A 以外的也拉进来，后半句常跟「も」。用于说明某件事影响面比想象大。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: It first denies that A is the whole story, then pulls in what lies beyond A, usually with も in the second half. It shows that something reaches further than expected.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 名词＋に限らず
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Noun + に限らず

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「だけでなく」只是普通的“不仅”，范围感弱；「に限らず」强调的是“不受这个框框限制”。说“这家店不光年轻人来”时用に限らず更自然。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: だけでなく is an ordinary not only and carries little sense of scope; に限らず stresses that the frame does not hold. For this shop draws more than young people, に限らず is the natural choice.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 这家店不光受年轻人欢迎，也很受家庭顾客欢迎。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: This restaurant is popular not only with young people but with families too.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 不只是日语，学任何外语都要靠每天积累。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Not Japanese alone — any foreign language needs daily accumulation.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 这个问题不只在东京，全国都在发生。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: This problem is not limited to Tokyo; it is happening nationwide.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「只要……就……」——给后项设一个持续成立的前提。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: “As long as…” — sets a condition that has to keep holding for the rest to stand.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: A 这个状态一直持续，后面的判断、意志或结果就一直成立。常见于决心、承诺，句尾多接「～たい」「～つもりだ」「～はずだ」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: While state A continues, the judgement, intention or result in the second half holds. It appears in resolutions and promises, often with ～たい, ～つもりだ or ～はずだ.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 动词辞书形・ている形／い形容词／な形容词＋な／名词＋である＋限り
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Dictionary or ている form / i-adjective / na-adjective + な / noun + である + 限り

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 不是“仅限某人”的范围限制，而是时间上的持续条件。中文都写“只要”，但日文这里看的是状态能不能延续：身体还行的期间、我活着的期间。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: This is not a scope limit on a person but a condition that persists over time. Chinese uses 只要 for both, but here the question is whether the state lasts: while the body holds up, while I live.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 只要身体还行，我就想继续工作。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: As long as I stay healthy, I want to keep working.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 只要我活着，就会守着这家店。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: As long as I am alive, I intend to keep this shop going.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 只要是学生，就得守规矩。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: As long as you are a student, you have to follow the rules.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「就……来看」——先把结论的边界划出来，给判断留余地。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: “As far as … goes” — fences off the evidence before judging, leaving room for doubt.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 结论只基于自己接触到的信息，超出这个范围不敢保证。常见于调查、汇报、说明，句尾多接「～ない」「～ようだ」这类留有余地的说法。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: The conclusion rests only on what the speaker has seen, and nothing beyond that is guaranteed. It appears in reports and explanations, usually with a hedged ending such as ～ない or ～ようだ.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 动词辞书形・た形・ている形＋限りでは
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Dictionary, た- or ている form + 限りでは

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「限り」设的是持续条件，「限りでは」划的是信息边界。前者说“只要还在”，后者说“在我看到的范围内，超出部分我不负责”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: 限り sets a condition that persists; 限りでは fences the evidence. The first says as long as it remains, the second says this is all I have seen and I speak for nothing beyond it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 就我调查到的情况来看，没有什么大问题。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: As far as my research goes, there is no major problem.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 单看这份资料，计划似乎进展顺利。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Judging from this document alone, the plan seems to be going smoothly.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 据我所知，他还没结婚。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: As far as I know, he is not married yet.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 还是……最好
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: It's better...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 寒冷的夜晚最推荐热乎乎的火锅。这里是在给出“还是火锅最好”的选择，所以用「に限る」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: A hot pot is the preferred choice on a cold night. Use に限る to recommend it as the best option.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 还是……最好
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: It's better...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 说话人根据经验推荐最好的做法：心情低落时，还是找可信赖的朋友聊聊最好。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Those who spoke suggested the best practice on the basis of experience: it would be better to talk to a trusted friend when the mood was depressed.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 仅限……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: A formal notice limiting who is eligible.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 正式规定把可使用休息室的人限定为会员，用「に限り」。に限る是“最好是……”；限りでは表示“据……范围内”；「限りに」不能直接接在名词后面，都不成立。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: に限り restricts use to members, in notice style. に限る means "X is best"; 限りでは means "as far as"; 限りに cannot follow a noun directly.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 仅限……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: A formal notice limiting who is eligible.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 优惠只适用于本月内申请的人，是明确划定范围的「に限り」。に限る是“最好是……”；「限りでは」「限りに」不能直接接在名词后面，都不成立。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: に限り marks who the offer applies to. に限る means "X is best"; 限りでは and 限りに cannot follow a noun directly.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 偏偏……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Of all times; especially when you least expect it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 平时没事，偏偏有重要会议那天闹钟没响，带有倒霉和抱怨的语气。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Normally, nothing happened, except that the alarm clock of the important meeting was not ringing and had a bad luck and complaining tone.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 偏偏……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Of all times; especially when you least expect it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 不带伞时偏偏下雨，正是“越不希望越发生”的「に限って」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: It rains precisely when one has no umbrella. Use に限って for this unwelcome coincidence.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 不光……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: It's not just...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 讨论范围不只在日本，还扩展到许多国家，因此用「に限らず」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: The discussion extends beyond Japan to many countries. Use に限らず.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 不光……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: It's not just...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 使用者从学生扩展到社会人士，中文语感是“不光学生”，所以选「に限らず」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Users include working adults as well as students. Use に限らず to mean not limited to students.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 只要……就……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: As long as...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 引き受けている限り表示“只要还承担着这项工作”。若强调“既然已经决定就要负责”，更适合「決めたからには／決めた以上は」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: 引き受けている限り means “as long as one is still undertaking this work.” To emphasize responsibility arising from a decision already made, use 決めたからには or 決めた以上は.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 只要……就……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: A continuing condition: as long as the stated condition holds.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 只要住在这个城市，没车也不成问题。这里是持续条件，不是信息范围。 补充：限りでは可以把适用范围限定在住在这个城镇的情况下；限り更直接表达持续条件。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Target expression: 限り. Intended meaning: A continuing condition: as long as the stated condition holds. Compared alternatives: 限りでは. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 按提示的意思选择自然的说法。这道题有两个说法都成立，解析里说明了它们的区别。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Select a natural expression for the indicated meaning. More than one answer is accepted here; read the explanation for the differences.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 就……来看 / 据……所知
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: A conclusion limited to the scope of what was checked.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「確認した限りでは」限定结论所依据的信息范围；「では」让这个限定更明确。「限りが」不能接在这里。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: 確認した限りでは limits the conclusion to what was checked, and では makes that limitation explicit. 限りが is not a valid continuation here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 就……来看 / 据……所知
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: For the purposes of... / To the knowledge

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 根据新闻目前报道到的信息判断似乎无人受伤，属于限定信息来源的「限りでは」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: The judgment that no one seems injured is limited to what the news currently reports. Use 限りでは to delimit the information source.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「只……」——先划一条界线，事情到这儿为止。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: “Only…” — draws a line and says the matter stops there.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 最基础的限定。和可能形、愿望搭配时意思会转成“能多少就多少”，如「食べたいだけ食べる」。所以看到だけ，先看前面是什么形式。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: The basic limit. With a potential form or a wish it shifts to as much as one can, as in 食べたいだけ食べる. So when you see だけ, check the form in front of it first.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 名词／普通形＋だけ；动词可能形＋だけ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Noun / plain form + だけ; potential form + だけ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 基础的だけ是“只有”，但「できるだけ」不是“只做一点”，而是“尽可能多做”。同一个词，方向相反，这是最常读反的地方。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Plain だけ means only, but できるだけ does not mean doing just a little — it means doing as much as possible. Same word, opposite direction, and this is where readers slip most often.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 想吃多少就吃多少。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: You may eat as much as you like.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 把身上所有的钱全花光了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: I spent every bit of money I had.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 光看是看不出真假的。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: You cannot tell whether it is genuine just by looking.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「尽量……」——把动作推到能力允许的最大值。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: “As … as possible” — pushes the action to the limit of what can be done.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 强调尽可能接近目标，语气比「なるべく」更用力。常见搭配：「できるだけ早く」「できるだけ多く」「できるだけ避けたい」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: It stresses getting as close to the goal as possible and is stronger than なるべく. Usual collocations: できるだけ早く, できるだけ多く, できるだけ避けたい.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: できるだけ＋动词／形容词
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: できるだけ + verb or adjective

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 和「なるべく」的区别在力度：なるべく是“尽量吧”，できるだけ是“在能做到的范围内最大限度”。中文都译“尽量”，但后者更接近“尽可能”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: The difference from なるべく is force: なるべく is a soft try to, while できるだけ is the maximum within reach. Chinese uses 尽量 for both, but the latter is closer to 尽可能.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 请尽量早点回复。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Please reply as soon as you possibly can.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 为了健康，我尽量多走路。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: For my health I walk as much as I can.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 在人前最好尽量别发火。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: In front of others you should avoid getting angry as far as possible.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「正因为……所以更……」——原因越强，结果越被放大。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: “Precisely because…” — the stronger the cause, the more it amplifies the result.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: A 的程度、经历或期待很高，于是 B 的感受也被推高。好坏都行：期待していただけに残念だ，努力しただけに嬉しい。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: A is strong in degree, experience or expectation, so the feeling in B is raised accordingly. It works both ways: 期待していただけに残念だ and 努力しただけに嬉しい.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 动词・い形容词普通形／な形容词词干＋な／名词＋だけに
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Verb or i-adjective plain form / na-adjective stem + な / noun + だけに

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「だけあって」偏正面评价，“不愧是”；「だけに」只讲因果被放大，好坏都行。别只凭正负面色硬分——「経験が長いだけに説明が上手だ」也完全成立。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: だけあって leans positive, as in no wonder; だけに only says the cause is amplified and works either way. Do not split them by positive versus negative alone — 経験が長いだけに説明が上手だ is perfectly fine.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 正因为之前特别期待，失败时才格外失望。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: I had expected so much that the failure hurt all the more.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 用了这么多年，对这件工具格外有感情。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Having used this tool for years, I am attached to it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 正因为是有名的店，休息日才排起长队。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Being a famous restaurant, it draws long queues on holidays.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「不愧是……」——看到结果，感叹果然和身份相称。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: “Just like you'd expect from…” — the result matches the reputation.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 先看到符合身份、经验或评价的结果，再回头感叹“难怪”。几乎都用于积极评价，常和「さすが」一起出现。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: The result fits the status, experience or reputation, and the speaker looks back and says no wonder. It is almost always positive and often appears with さすが.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 动词・い形容词普通形／な形容词词干＋な／名词＋だけあって
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Verb or i-adjective plain form / na-adjective stem + な / noun + だけあって

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 和「だけに」有重叠，区别在重心：だけあって落在“评价果然没错”，だけに落在“原因强所以结果强”。负面结果用だけあって会不自然。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: It overlaps with だけに but the weight differs: だけあって lands on the reputation being deserved, だけに on the cause being strong. With a bad result, だけあって sounds odd.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 不愧是学了十年日语，发音就是很自然。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Ten years of studying Japanese show — his pronunciation is remarkably natural.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 到底是专业的，干活就是快。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: He is a professional, and it shows in how fast he works.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 不愧是名店，这里的菜样样好吃。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: The place deserves its reputation — every dish is excellent.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「不枉……」——回头给先前的付出结账：这份投入值。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: “Worth every bit of…” — settles the bill on earlier effort and finds it paid off.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 看到成果之后，评价之前的努力、花费、等待或名声确实没有白费。句尾固定，前面多用た形，带满足感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: After seeing the result, the speaker judges that the effort, expense, wait or reputation was not wasted. The ending is fixed, usually after a た-form, and carries satisfaction.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 普通形＋だけのことはある（常见：た形＋だけのことはある）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Plain form + だけのことはある (usually た-form + だけのことはある)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「だけあって」说“身份与结果相称”，「だけのことはある」说“付出没白费”。排队两小时吃拉面，用后者；说名校毕业果然厉害，用前者。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: だけあって says status matches result; だけのことはある says the outlay was worth it. For queueing two hours for ramen, use the latter; for a famous school living up to its name, the former.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 不枉排了两个小时队，这碗拉面确实好吃。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Two hours in the queue was worth it — this ramen is genuinely good.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 贵有贵的道理，这家店的服务是一流的。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: You get what you pay for — the service here is first class.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 多年练习没白费，他的演奏很精彩。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Years of practice paid off — his performance was superb.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「光是……就……」——只这一个条件，结果就已经发生。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: “Just … is enough to…” — one condition alone already produces the result.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 满足 A 这一项，B 就成立，带“甚至不需要更多”的感觉。常和「思い出す」「分かる」「泣ける」这类反应动词搭配。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Satisfying A alone is enough for B, with the sense that nothing more is needed. It often pairs with reactions such as 思い出す, 分かる or 泣ける.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 名词／普通形＋だけで
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Noun / plain form + だけで

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 别机械译成“只有”。后项已经成立时，中文自然是“光是 A 就 B”；译成“只有”会让句子读不通。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Do not render it mechanically as 只有. When the second half has already happened, Chinese wants 光是 A 就 B, and 只有 makes the sentence unreadable.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 光是看到这张照片，就会想起那次旅行。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Just looking at this photo brings the trip back.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 光是听到名字就害怕了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Just hearing the name frightened me.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 光是走了一小会儿，脚就疼了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Just a short walk made my feet hurt.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「光靠……还不够」——A 单独撑不起后项。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: “A alone is not enough” — one condition cannot carry the result.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 后面几乎都是否定判断：「足りない」「できない」「難しい」「無理だ」。用来指出还缺别的条件，语气是提醒而不是责备。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: The second half is nearly always negative: 足りない, できない, 難しい, 無理だ. It points out that something else is still missing, as a reminder rather than a rebuke.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 名词／普通形＋だけでは
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Noun / plain form + だけでは

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「だけで」说 A 已经够，带来了 B；「だけでは」正相反，说 A 还不够。一个肯定一个否定，看到句尾的「ない」就知道是后者。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: だけで says A is already enough and B follows; だけでは says the opposite, that A is not enough. One affirms, one denies, and a ない at the end tells you it is the second.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 光靠读教科书，还练不出自然的会话。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Reading the textbook alone will not give you natural conversation.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 有些问题光道歉是解决不了的。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Some problems cannot be settled by apologising alone.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 只听讲解还是不太明白。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Hearing the explanation alone does not make it clear.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 能……多少就……多少
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: It's as much as it takes.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「調べられるだけ調べる」表示在能力和时间允许的范围内尽可能多查，不是只查一点。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: The " 調べられるだけ調べる " indicates that as many searches as possible, not just a few, are possible within the limits of capacity and time.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 尽量……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Try to...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 这里要求在可能范围内早点到，用「できるだけ」自然对应“尽量”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Here's the requirement to arrive as early as possible, using "できるだけ" for "as much as possible".

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 按提示的意思选择自然的说法。这道题有两个说法都成立，解析里说明了它们的区别。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Select a natural expression for the indicated meaning. More than one answer is accepted here; read the explanation for the differences.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 正因为……所以更……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: A reason that intensifies the result.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「だけに」＝正因为……，后面往往跟着随之而来的强烈结果；本句是「遗憾」这种负面结果，不用「だけあって」（它是对人或事物的正面评价，相当于「不愧是」）。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: だけに means precisely because; the clause that follows is the strong result that comes with it. This sentence ends in a negative result (regret), so だけあって does not fit: it praises someone or something as living up to expectations.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 按提示的意思选择自然的说法。这道题有两个说法都成立，解析里说明了它们的区别。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Select a natural expression for the indicated meaning. More than one answer is accepted here; read the explanation for the differences.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 正因为……所以更……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: A reason that intensifies the result.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「だけに」强调责任重大，才使小失误也更让人介意；后半是负面反应，「だけあって」（不愧是）与之不搭。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: だけに stresses that the weight of the responsibility is exactly why small mistakes bother him. The second half is a negative reaction, where だけあって (as befits) does not fit.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 按提示的意思选择自然的说法。这道题有两个说法都成立，解析里说明了它们的区别。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Select a natural expression for the indicated meaning. More than one answer is accepted here; read the explanation for the differences.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 不愧是……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: A result that fits the person's experience.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「だけあって」＝不愧是……，后项是与之相称的好结果；本句正是正面评价，用「だけあって」。「だけしか」后面要接否定，与本句不搭。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: だけあって means as befits or as you would expect, and the clause after it is a matching result. This sentence praises the natural wording, so it fits. だけしか needs a negative after it, which this sentence lacks.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 按提示的意思选择自然的说法。这道题有两个说法都成立，解析里说明了它们的区别。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Select a natural expression for the indicated meaning. More than one answer is accepted here; read the explanation for the differences.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 不愧是……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: A result that fits the establishment's reputation.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「さすが」与「だけあって」呼应，表示「果然不亏是……」；「だけに」虽然也能说「正因为」，但和「さすが」搭配不自然。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: さすが pairs with だけあって: as you would expect of such a popular place. だけに can mean precisely because, but it does not sit naturally with さすが.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 果然没白……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: It's not for nothing.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 已经看到会话进步，再回头肯定半年的练习没有白费，所以用「だけのことはある」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Having seen the progress of the session and being sure that six months of practice have not been wasted, use "だけのことはある " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 果然没白…… / 确实值……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: An evaluation that the expense was worthwhile.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 服务周到，让人觉得高费用花得值，用「だけのことはあって」。だけでは、だけで后面接否定或“仅凭这一点”；だけしか必须配否定，都与后句的正面评价接不上。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: だけのことはあって: the service shows the high price was worth it. だけでは and だけで mean "with only that"; だけしか needs a negative. None fits the praise that follows.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 光是……就……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Just... just...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 仅仅听到名字这一个条件，就会想起往事；后项已经成立，所以是「だけで」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: A mere condition of a name reminds me of the past; the latter has been established, so it is "だけで. "

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 光是……就……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Just... just...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 光是听这首歌就能振作起来，A 单独已经足以带来 B。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Listening to this song alone can cheer up, A alone enough to bring B.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 按提示的意思选择自然的说法。这道题有两个说法都成立，解析里说明了它们的区别。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Select a natural expression for the indicated meaning. More than one answer is accepted here; read the explanation for the differences.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 光靠……还不够
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: The stated condition alone is insufficient.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「だけでは」接否定，表示只做这一件事还不够、还需要别的条件；本句正是这个意思。「だけでなく」要求后项是「还……」，和否定的后半句不搭。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: だけでは plus a negative says that doing only this is not enough and other conditions are needed. だけでなく needs a positive but also continuation, which does not fit a negative ending.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 按提示的意思选择自然的说法。这道题有两个说法都成立，解析里说明了它们的区别。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: Select a natural expression for the indicated meaning. More than one answer is accepted here; read the explanation for the differences.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 光靠……还不够
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: The stated condition alone is insufficient.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.zh: 「だけでは」表示仅有天赋还不够；「だけしか」要与否定谓语搭配，「才能があるだけしか」不成立。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.4-dake.g.en: だけでは says that talent alone is not enough. だけしか needs a negative predicate, so 才能があるだけしか does not work.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 「最好……」——照我的经验，你就这么做吧。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: “You'd do best to…” — based on my experience, this is what you should do.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 给对方一条具体建议，语气像过来人叮嘱，不是命令。常出现在「～たいなら」「～悩んでいるなら」之后，回答“那我该怎么办”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: It gives one concrete piece of advice in the voice of someone who has been there, not an order. It usually follows ～たいなら or ～悩んでいるなら, answering so what should I do.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 动词辞书形／ない形＋ことだ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: Dictionary form / ない-form + ことだ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 别和语法上的「～こと」（名词化）混。这里句尾独立成句，是建议。中文先套“最好……”，不要译成“这件事是……”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: Do not confuse it with the nominaliser ～こと. Here it ends the sentence on its own and gives advice. In Chinese start with 最好 and avoid a literal this matter is.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 想把日语学好，最好每天都说。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: If you want to get good at Japanese, talk every day.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 感冒的时候就别硬撑。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: When you have a cold, do not push yourself.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 拿不定主意的时候，最好找人商量。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: When you are unsure, ask someone for advice.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 「用不着……」——给对方卸下压力。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: “There's no need to…” — takes the pressure off.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 告诉对方这个动作不必做，常用于安慰、劝阻、替人宽心。语气轻，不等于禁止，做了也不算错。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: It tells the listener the action is unnecessary and is common in reassurance and gentle dissuasion. The tone is light: it is not a ban, and doing it would not be wrong.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 动词辞书形＋ことはない
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: Dictionary form + ことはない

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 和「ことだ」正相反：一个劝你做，一个劝你别做。也别读成「てはいけない」——那是禁止，这个是“没必要”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: It is the mirror image of ことだ: one urges you to do it, the other says you need not. It is also not てはいけない, which forbids, while this merely says there is no need.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 还有时间，没必要着急。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: There is still time, so there is no need to rush.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 用不着这么道歉。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: You don't have to apologise so much.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 不用担心，有我在。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: There is nothing to worry about — I am here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 「以他那性格，肯定……」——靠对一个人的了解来推测。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: “Knowing him, he'll have…” — an inference built on knowing the person.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 根据某人平时的性格、习惯、处境，推断这次也会做出相符的反应。前项必须是具体的人，后面常接「だろう」「はずだ」「に違いない」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: From someone's usual character, habits or situation, the speaker infers the same reaction this time. What precedes it must be a specific person, and だろう, はずだ or に違いない usually follows.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 人物名／人称名词＋の＋ことだから
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: Person's name or a personal noun + の + ことだから

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 不是普通的因果「から」。它暗含“他这个人你又不是不知道”，所以只能接人，不能接“因为下雨”。接事物就变回普通原因了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: It is not an ordinary causal から. It implies you know what he is like, so it takes a person and not something like because it rained. Attach it to a thing and it reverts to a plain reason.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 以田中那么认真的性格，估计早就准备好了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: Tanaka is so diligent that he will have prepared already.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 山田总是慌慌张张的，今天肯定也要迟到。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: Yamada is always in a fluster, so he is bound to be late again today.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 部长对时间那么严格，晚一分钟都会生气吧。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: The department head is strict about time, so even a minute late will annoy him.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 「没……就……」——前项没发生，后项照样进行。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: “Without ever…” — the first action never happens and the second carries on anyway.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 书面语，报道、文章、正式叙述里常见。常用来突出“一次也没有”“始终没有”，比口语说法更有分量。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: A written register found in reports, articles and formal narration. It stresses never once or never at all, which gives it more weight than the spoken equivalent.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 动词辞书形＋ことなく
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: Dictionary form + ことなく

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 口语说「～ないで」。意思接近，但ことなく更正式，写邮件、写报告用它；聊天里用会像在念稿。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: Speech uses ～ないで. The meaning is close, but ことなく is formal and belongs in mail and reports; in conversation it sounds like reading from a script.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 他什么也没说，就离开了房间。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: He left the room without saying a word.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 十年里一次也没休息，一直工作。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: She worked for ten years without ever taking a break.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 计划在没人察觉的情况下推进着。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: The plan went ahead without anyone noticing.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 「令人……的是」——先给情绪定性，再说事实。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: “To my …” — labels the emotion first, then states the fact.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 把惊讶、遗憾、庆幸这类反应提到句首，再交代发生了什么。几乎都是固定搭配：驚いたことに、残念なことに、幸いなことに、不思議なことに。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: It puts the reaction at the front — surprise, regret, relief — and then reports what happened. The set phrases are almost fixed: 驚いたことに, 残念なことに, 幸いなことに, 不思議なことに.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: い形容词原形／な形容词词干＋な／感情动词た形＋ことに
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: i-adjective plain form / na-adjective stem + な / emotion verb た-form + ことに

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 它不表示目的，也不表示时间。看到「ことに」在句首、后面紧跟逗号，就当“令人……的是”；看到「～ことにしている」才是习惯。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: It marks neither purpose nor time. When ことに opens the clause and a comma follows, read it as to my …; only ～ことにしている means a personal habit.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 令人吃惊的是，他一个人全做完了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: To my surprise, he finished the whole thing alone.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 遗憾的是，那家店上个月关门了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: Unfortunately, the shop closed last month.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 所幸没有一个人受伤。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: Fortunately, nobody was hurt.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 「不知道有多……啊」——情绪大到说不出具体程度。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: “How … it was!” — the feeling is too big for a plain degree word.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 用反问的外形表达强烈感叹，句尾虽然有「か」，却不是在等人回答。常与「どんなに」「どれほど」「何度」呼应，多出现在回忆和抒情段落。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: It wears the shape of a question but expresses strong emotion, and the か at the end waits for no answer. It usually pairs with どんなに, どれほど or 何度 and belongs to reminiscence and lyrical passages.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 普通形＋ことか（な形容词・名词＋な＋ことか）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: Plain form + ことか (na-adjective / noun + な + ことか)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 别当成疑问句去回答。中文若译成“有多高兴呢？”，读者会以为在提问；应译“不知道有多高兴”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: Do not treat it as a question to be answered. Rendering it as how happy was it? makes readers expect a reply; the sense is I cannot tell you how happy I was.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 合格的时候，不知道有多高兴。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: You cannot imagine how happy I was when I passed.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 一个人在国外生活，不知道有多不容易。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: Living abroad alone was harder than words can say.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 这一天我盼了不知多少次。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: How many times I longed for this day.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 最好……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: It's better...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 这是根据情况给建议：想恢复身体，今晚最好好好休息，因此用「ことだ」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: This is a recommendation based on the situation: it is better to get some rest tonight if you want to get well, so use "ことだ " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 最好……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: It's better...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 后项是对学习方法的建议，中文自然地说“最好试着开口说”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: The latter is a proposal for learning methods, and Chinese naturally says “it is best to try to speak out”.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 没必要……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: There's no need...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 说话人在安慰对方：只失败一次，用不着那么消沉。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: Those who spoke comforted each other: it was only once that they failed, and there was no need to be so depressed.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 没必要……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: There's no need...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 离截止还有一周，没有现在立刻熬夜的必要，所以用「ことはない」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: One week from now, there is no need to stay up at night, so use "ことはない " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 以他那性格……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: With his character...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 根据对他责任感强这一性格的了解作推测，用「彼のことだから」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: The inference is based on knowing his strong sense of responsibility. Use 彼のことだから.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 以他那性格……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: With his character...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 以佐藤一向守时的性格来推测他已经到了，是典型人物判断。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: It's typical to assume that Sato has arrived by his time-honoured character.
No... just...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 一次也没有放弃，一直跑到最后；正式书面表达用「ことなく」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: Never gave up, never left; officially expressed in writing by " ことなく. "
No... just...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 没有说明理由就离开了，前项未发生而后项继续，用「ことなく」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: He left without a reason, the previous one did not occur and the latter continued with " ことなく " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 令人……的是
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: It's...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 先给后面的事实加“惊讶”标签，固定表达是「驚いたことに」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: 驚いたことに introduces the following fact as surprising.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 令人……的是
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: It's...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 对“无人受伤”先作幸运评价，用「幸いなことに」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: "No one gets hurt" was first evaluated by "幸いなことに".

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 不知道有多……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: I don't know how much...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 「どれほど」与「ことか」呼应，强烈感叹自己等这一天等了很久。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: "どれほど" echoes "ことか" and strongly laments that he has waited for this day for a long time.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 不知道有多……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: I don't know how much...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.zh: 不是疑问，而是感叹当时不知道有多不安，所以选「ことか」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.5-koto.g.en: It was not a question, but an exaggeration that I didn't know how uneasy it was, so I chose "ことか".

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 「正要……」——镜头定格在动作开始前的一刻。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: “About to…” — the camera stops just before the action starts.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 动作还没开始，但已经走到启动的节点。常和「今から」「ちょうど今」搭配，回答“你在干什么”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: The action has not begun but is at the starting line. It often pairs with 今から or ちょうど今 and answers what are you doing.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 动词辞书形＋ところだ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: Dictionary form + ところだ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 普通未来只说之后会做；「ところだ」把时间压到“就在这一刻”。中文的“要去了”有时只是打算，日文这里是真的马上动身。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: A plain future only says it will happen later; ところだ squeezes the time down to this very moment. Chinese 要去了 can be a mere plan, while this really means leaving right now.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 我正准备出门。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: I am just about to go out.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 正好现在要吃饭。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: I am just about to have lunch.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 会议正要开始。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: The meeting is about to begin.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 「正在……呢」——动作进行到一半，人还在里面。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: “In the middle of…” — the action is under way right now.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 强调此刻所处的阶段，常用来回应打扰或说明进度。比单纯的「～ています」更有“正做到这儿”的现场感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: It stresses the stage the speaker is at, often to answer an interruption or report progress. It feels more live than a plain ～ています.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 动词ている形＋ところだ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: ている form + ところだ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 「～ています」也能说正在做，但那是状态；「ところだ」是在报告进度。电话里说“正在开会”用后者更自然。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: ～ています also says it is happening, but as a state; ところだ reports progress. On the phone, saying you are in a meeting sounds more natural with the latter.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 现在正在查原因呢。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: We are looking into the cause right now.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 我正做资料呢，再等一会儿。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: I am still putting the materials together, so give me a moment.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 我打电话的时候，他正好在吃午饭。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: When I called, he was right in the middle of lunch.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 「刚……」——动作才结束，余温还在。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: “Just finished…” — the action has only just ended.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 说话人把动作看成“完成后不久”的状态，常和「今」「さっき」搭配。用于报告刚到、刚做完、刚听说。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: The speaker treats the action as having ended a moment ago, usually with 今 or さっき. It reports having just arrived, just finished or just heard.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 动词た形＋ところだ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: た-form + ところだ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 不要和「Vたところ、B」混。句末有「だ」是刚做完；后面还接一个结果句，才是“做了以后发现”。看逗号后面有没有 B。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: Do not confuse it with Vたところ、B. A だ at the end means just finished; a result clause after the comma means did it and found. Look at what follows the comma.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 我刚到公司。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: I have just arrived at the office.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 刚吃完午饭。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: I finished lunch just now.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 刚接到老师的通知。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: I have just heard from the teacher.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 「一……结果发现……」——做了才知道，事前并不确定。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: “I did …, and it turned out…” — the result was unknown until the action was taken.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 实际做了 A 之后，得到 B 这个结果或发现，B 往往是意外消息。常见于调查、询问、尝试之后的汇报。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: After actually doing A, the speaker obtains result B, which is often unexpected news. It appears in reports after checking, asking or trying.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 动词た形＋ところ、结果句
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: た-form + ところ + result clause

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 和「たところだ」只差一个逗号，意思完全不同：一个是刚做完，一个是做完之后发现。考试常把两句并排放在一起考。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: Only a comma separates it from たところだ, yet the meaning is entirely different: one is just finished, the other is did it and found. Exams like to place the two side by side.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 去医院检查了一下，结果没发现什么问题。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: I had the hospital check it, and there was nothing wrong.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 打了个电话一问，那家店已经关门了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: I called the shop, only to find it had already closed.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 交涉了一下，对方没有答应。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: I negotiated, but the other side would not agree.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 「差点就……」——事没发生，人还在后怕。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: “Nearly…” — it did not happen, and the speaker is still shaken.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 和「危うく」「もう少しで」一起用，表示险些发生而实际避开了。句尾几乎固定为「ところだった」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: Used with 危うく or もう少しで, it means something almost happened but was avoided. The ending is almost always ところだった.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 动词辞书形＋ところだった
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: Dictionary form + ところだった

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 不加「危うく」时可能只是回顾“那时正要出门”，不能一口咬定结果如何。有「危うく」「もう少しで」才是“差点”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: Without 危うく it may simply recall being about to leave, and says nothing about how it turned out. Only with 危うく or もう少しで does it mean nearly.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 差点把钱包忘了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: I very nearly left my wallet behind.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 差点没赶上电车。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: I almost missed the train.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 险些酿成事故。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: It nearly turned into an accident.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 「正当……的时候，偏偏……」——A 到关键处，B 插进来。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: “Just as … , along came…” — right at the critical moment, B cuts in.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 正在做 A 的那个节点上，另一个人、动作或事件突然出现。常和「～ようとしていた」「～ている」搭配，后半句多是打断或意外。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: At the very point of doing A, another person, action or event appears. It pairs with ～ようとしていた or ～ている, and the second half is usually an interruption or a surprise.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 动词辞书形・ている形・ようとしている＋ところに／へ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: Dictionary, ている or ようとしている form + ところに or ところへ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 「に」强调事件落在这个时点，「へ」带“朝这边过来”的方向感。别把它读成描述 A 的阶段——它真正的任务是引出 B。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.en: に places the event at that moment while へ adds a sense of movement toward the speaker. Do not read it as describing A's stage — its real job is to bring in B.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.6-tokoro.zh: 正准备出门的时候，偏偏下起雨来了。
