nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: It does not mean simply not doing it; it means there is no room for it in the present situation. Chinese 哪还 captures it best; rendering it as not travelling loses the whole tone.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 忙成这样，哪还有心思旅游。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I am so busy there is no question of a trip.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 受了伤，哪还顾得上工作。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I was injured and in no state to think about work.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 没钱，哪还有心思玩。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I have no money, so having fun is out of the question.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 「与其……还不如……」——对 A 抵触强，宁可换一个。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: “Rather than…, I'd sooner…” — strong resistance to A, so a substitute is preferred.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 说话人对 A 很排斥，宁愿选另一个也许同样不理想、但至少能接受的 B。后项常接「ほうがいい」「ましだ」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: The speaker rejects A and prefers B, which may be no better but is at least tolerable. The second half usually ends in ほうがいい or ましだ.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 动词辞书形＋くらいなら
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Dictionary form + くらいなら

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 这不是冷静比较两个方案，而是有情绪的取舍：“都要 A 了，那我宁愿 B”。所以后项几乎都带主观评价，不会只是中性地陈述事实。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: This is not a cool comparison of two options but an emotional trade-off: if it comes to A, I would sooner B. The second half is therefore almost always evaluative rather than a neutral statement.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 与其继续做讨厌的工作，还不如辞掉。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Rather than carry on with a job I hate, I would sooner quit.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 与其每天加班，少拿点工资也行。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Rather than work overtime every day, I would take a lower salary.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 与其撒谎，还不如不说。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I would sooner say nothing than lie.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 「到……这种程度」——拿一件事当尺子量程度。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: “To the point of…” — uses one thing as a measure of degree.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 用 A 当尺子，说明动作、状态或感受已经达到那么高的程度。常出现在夸张的表达里，如“痛到睡不着”“忙到没时间吃饭”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: A serves as the ruler for how far an action, state or feeling has gone. It thrives on exaggeration: hurting so much you cannot sleep, so busy you cannot eat.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 普通形／名词＋ほど
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Plain form / noun + ほど

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 单独的「ほど」表程度；「～ば～ほど」表两个程度联动，是“越……越……”。看到前后都是同一词的变化形式，就不是单纯的“到……程度”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Bare ほど marks degree; ～ば～ほど links two degrees and means the more the more. When both sides are forms of the same word, it is not a simple to the extent of.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 紧张到连声音都发不出来的程度。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I was so nervous I could not get a sound out.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 笑到流眼泪的程度。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I laughed until I cried.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 还没累到走不动的地步。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I am not so tired that I cannot walk.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 「越……越……」——同一个词说两遍，两头一起涨。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: “The more …, the more…” — the same word twice, both ends rising.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: A 的程度上升，B 也跟着变。日语的习惯是把同一个动词或形容词重复两次，前半用ば形，后半用辞书形加ほど。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: As A rises, B changes with it. Japanese repeats the same verb or adjective, with the ば-form first and the dictionary form plus ほど second.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: Vば形＋V辞书形＋ほど；い形容词去い＋ければ＋原形＋ほど；な形容词词干＋なら＋词干＋な＋ほど
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: V ば-form + dictionary form + ほど; i-adjective stem + ければ + plain form + ほど; na-adjective stem + なら + stem + な + ほど

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: な形容词的接法最容易错：静かなら静かなほど，也可以说静かであればあるほど，但不能写成「静かならであるほど」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Na-adjectives trip people up: 静かなら静かなほど, or 静かであればあるほど, but never 静かならであるほど.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 日语越学越有意思。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: The more you study Japanese, the more interesting it gets.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 越想越不明白。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: The more I think about it, the less I understand.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 并不是越便宜越好。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Cheaper is not always better.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 「甚至不惜……」——为了目标，连这种事都肯做。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: “Even at the cost of…” — willing to go that far for the goal.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 为了后项的目标，甚至采取平常难以接受、代价很高或过度的 A。说话人往往对这种代价持保留态度。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: To reach the goal in the second half, the speaker takes action A, which is normally unacceptable, costly or excessive. The speaker usually has reservations about that cost.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 动词て形＋まで
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: て-form + まで

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 「てまで」把极端行为放在目标前面（借金してまで買う）；「までして」把手段单独拎出来评价（借金までして買う）。一个偏动作，一个偏手段本身。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: てまで puts the extreme action in front of the goal (借金してまで買う), while までして lifts the means out for comment (借金までして買う). One leans on the action, the other on the means itself.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 我不想为了买那辆车，甚至不惜去借钱。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I do not want that car badly enough to borrow money for it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 我不想为了出人头地而牺牲家人。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I have no wish to get ahead at the cost of my family.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 没必要为了护着他而撒谎。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: There is no need to lie in order to protect him.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 「甚至做到这份上……」——把代价单独拎出来，表示惊讶或批评。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: “Going as far as…” — singles out the cost to express surprise or criticism.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 说话人把一个极端手段、牺牲或付出单独提出来，评价“竟然都做到这份上”。常带质疑：真有必要吗？
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: The speaker picks out an extreme means, sacrifice or outlay and comments that it went that far, often with doubt as to whether it was necessary.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 名词＋までして
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Noun + までして

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 两者都表超常程度。「てまで」接动词，重点在动作；「までして」接名词，重点在手段，如「借金までして」。句尾常接疑问或否定评价。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Both mark an unusual degree. てまで takes a verb and stresses the action; までして takes a noun and stresses the means, as in 借金までして. The sentence often ends in a question or a negative judgement.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 真有必要甚至做到借钱这份上，去买那辆车吗？
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Is that car really worth going into debt for?

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 甚至熬了通宵来准备志愿活动。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: He even stayed up all night preparing for the volunteer event.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 为什么要做到那个份上去帮他？
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Why go that far to help him?

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 别说……了，反而……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Don't say it. It's just...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 先否定“旅行很开心”，再说实际上雨不停、连门都出不了，用「どころか」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: You can't even get out of the door without saying, "Travel is fun." どころか 」。

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 别说……了，甚至……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Don't even say it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 不只日语，还会英语和中文，「どころか」也能从 A 推进到程度更高的 B。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Not only Japanese, but also English and Chinese, so that "どころか" can move from A to a higher B.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 哪还有心思……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: There's nothing to think about.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 考试准备还没完成，根本没有余裕看电影，用「映画どころではない」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Exam preparation is unfinished, leaving no time for a movie. Use 映画どころではない.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 哪还有心思……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: There's nothing to think about.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 公司都快破产了，当然根本顾不上奖金，「ボーナスどころではない」很自然。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: The company is close to bankruptcy, so bonuses are out of the question. ボーナスどころではない is natural.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 与其……还不如……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: It's better than...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 说话人对一边被抱怨一边工作很抵触，宁愿辞职，用「くらいなら」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: The talker who complains about work on one side is in conflict with the other and prefers to resign, using the term "くらいなら " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 与其……还不如……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: It's better than...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 与其和不喜欢的人结婚，宁愿独处，是典型的「くらいなら～ほうがいい」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Preferring to be alone rather than marry someone one dislikes is a typical use of くらいなら～ほうがいい.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 到……这种程度
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: To the extent that...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 疲惫程度高到无法站立，用「ほど」把前面的状态当作程度尺子。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: The level of fatigue is so high that it cannot stand, using " ほど " as a scale rule.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 到……这种程度
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: To the extent that...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 热闹程度高到听不见说话声，用「ほど」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: High enough to be deaf to speak with "ほど".
The more... the more...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 整句是「考えれば考えるほど」，表示越想越不明白。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: 考えれば考えるほど means that the more one thinks, the less one understands.
The more... the more...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 整句是「少なければ少ないほど」，表示行李越少，移动越轻松。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: 少なければ少ないほど means that the less luggage there is, the easier it is to move around.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 甚至不惜……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I don't even care.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 为了赚钱甚至不惜损害健康，说话人认为这种代价没有必要，用「てまで」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: In order to earn money and even to hurt health, the talker did not think it was necessary to use " てまで " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 甚至做到这份上……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: And even on this...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 把“借钱”这个极端手段单独拎出，说明说话人无法理解为买豪车做到这份上。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: The extreme means of “lending money” alone means that a person who speaks cannot be understood as buying a luxury car to do so.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「老是容易……」——不好的事反复发生。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: “Tends to keep…” — something undesirable keeps happening.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 某种不太理想的行为或状态反复出现，像容易掉进去的坑。通常偏负面：抜きがち、遅れがち、忘れがち。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: An undesirable behaviour or state recurs, like a pit one keeps falling into. It is usually negative: 抜きがち, 遅れがち, 忘れがち.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 动词ます形去ます／名词＋がち
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Masu-stem / noun + がち

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「がち」看的是反复出现的倾向，「気味」看的是当下略微有点。经常容易累用がち，最近有点累用気味。中文都用“容易/有点”，但时间跨度不同。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: がち looks at a recurring tendency while 気味 looks at a slight present state. Often getting tired takes がち; feeling a bit tired lately takes 気味. Chinese uses 容易 or 有点 for both, but the time span differs.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 一忙起来，就老是容易不吃早饭。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: When I am busy I tend to skip breakfast.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 冬天容易运动不足。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: In winter people tend to get too little exercise.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 他总是不好意思，不怎么表达自己的意见。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: He tends to hold back and not say what he thinks.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「最近有点……」——状态略微偏向某一边，还没到严重。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: “A bit … lately” — the state has begun to lean one way, not seriously.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 说话人感觉身体、情绪或情况开始略微偏向某个方向，程度轻，常和「少し」「最近」搭配。多用于身体状态。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: The speaker feels the body, mood or situation starting to lean slightly, with 少し or 最近 nearby. It is mostly used of physical condition.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 动词ます形去ます／名词＋気味
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Masu-stem / noun + 気味

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「疲れ気味」是最近有点累，「疲れがち」是经常容易累。前者是当下的程度，后者是反复的倾向。这一对最常考。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: 疲れ気味 means a bit tired lately, while 疲れがち means often getting tired. The first is a present degree, the second a recurring tendency, and this pair comes up most.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 最近感觉有点累。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: I have been feeling a bit tired lately.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 有点感冒的样子，今天早点回去。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: I feel a cold coming on, so I will head home early today.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 最近有点发胖，挺发愁。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: I have been putting on a little weight lately, which bothers me.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「动不动就……」／「很有……那味」——口语化的倾向与观感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: “Prone to…” / “-ish” — a colloquial tendency or impression.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 两种用法：一是某种行为很容易发生（忘れっぽい），二是人或物显得有某种特质、颜色或印象（子供っぽい、水っぽい）。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Two uses: a behaviour that happens easily (忘れっぽい), and a person or thing that gives an impression of some quality, colour or flavour (子供っぽい, 水っぽい).

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 部分动词ます形去ます／名词／部分形容词词干＋っぽい（搭配需单独记）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Some masu-stems / nouns / some adjective stems + っぽい (collocations must be learned one by one)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 不能把任意动词机械加っぽい——忘れっぽい、子供っぽい、水っぽい是固定搭配，安っぽい也是。自己造词很容易出错。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: You cannot bolt っぽい onto any verb: 忘れっぽい, 子供っぽい, 水っぽい and 安っぽい are fixed. Coinages go wrong easily.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 他特别爱忘事，所以什么都会记下来。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: He is so forgetful that he writes everything down.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 那种说法太孩子气了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: That way of putting it is childish.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 这汤有点寡淡。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: This soup tastes a bit watery.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「一路越来越……」——朝一个方向走，没有回头迹象。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: “Steadily more…” — moving one way with no sign of turning back.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 变化沿一个方向不断推进，看不出停止或反转。好坏都能用，但负面更常见：人口减少、物价上涨。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: The change keeps pushing in one direction with no stop or reversal in sight. It works both ways but is more often negative: shrinking population, rising prices.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 表变化的动词辞书形＋一方だ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Dictionary form of a change verb + 一方だ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「一方だ」相对中性，只说单向趋势；「ばかりだ」带“只会继续这样”的无奈。写报道用一方だ，抱怨用ばかりだ。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: 一方だ is fairly neutral and only reports the one-way trend, while ばかりだ carries the resignation of it will only keep going. Reports use 一方だ, complaints use ばかりだ.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 这座城市的人口越来越少，一路都在减少。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: The town's population keeps shrinking.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 日元贬值，进口商品价格一路上涨。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: With the weak yen, imported goods keep getting more expensive.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 技术进步让工作方式不断变化。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: As technology advances, the way we work keeps changing.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「只会越来越……」——趋势不回头，说话人有点认命。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: “Only getting…” — the trend will not turn, and the speaker has given up hoping.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 事情只沿着某个、往往不理想的方向继续走，带无奈或忧虑。常出现在抱怨物价、病情、局面的时候。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Things keep going one way, usually the unwanted way, with resignation or worry. It appears in complaints about prices, illness and difficult situations.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 表变化的动词辞书形＋ばかりだ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Dictionary form of a change verb + ばかりだ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 别和た形加ばかりだ的“刚刚……”混。这里接辞书形，讲趋势；接た形，讲刚做完。形式一变，意思完全换了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Do not confuse it with the た-form plus ばかりだ meaning just did. Here the dictionary form gives a trend and the た-form gives something just finished; change the form and the meaning changes entirely.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 物价只会越来越高，生活一点也没轻松。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Prices only keep rising and life gets no easier.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 病情只会越来越糟。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: His condition only gets worse.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 等了又等，情况只会越来越糟。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: However long we waited, the situation only deteriorated.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「一直……着也不管」——动作做完就不管了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: “Left …” — the action ends and nobody deals with the aftermath.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 两种意思：动作之后的状态一直放着没人处理（電気をつけっぱなし），或某动作一直持续（立ちっぱなし）。前者负面意味强，后者不一定。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Two senses: a state left unattended after the action (電気をつけっぱなし), or an action continuing without a break (立ちっぱなし). The first is clearly negative, the second need not be.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 动词ます形去ます＋っぱなし
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Masu-stem + っぱなし

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 别一律理解成“忘了关”。立ちっぱなし只是说一直站着、很累，不一定有人疏忽。判断标准是有没有“该处理却没处理”的对象。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Do not read it as forgetting to switch something off every time. 立ちっぱなし only says someone stood the whole time and got tired, with no neglect implied. The test is whether something should have been dealt with and was not.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 灯一直开着没关，我就睡着了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: I fell asleep with the lights left on.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 站了一整天，腿疼。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: I stood all day and my legs ache.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 请不要让水一直流着。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Please do not leave the tap running.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 老是容易……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: A repeatedly occurring, usually undesirable tendency.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 最近反复出现不出门、闷在家里的倾向，「家にこもりがち」表示经常容易这样。 补充：こもり気味描述最近略有闭门不出的状态；こもりっぱなし指持续不出门；こもりがち强调经常如此。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Target expression: がち. Intended meaning: A repeatedly occurring, usually undesirable tendency. Compared alternatives: 気味 / っぱなし. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 老是容易……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: A repeatedly occurring, usually undesirable tendency.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「なりがち」表示容易变得不规律，是反复出现的倾向。一方だ接辞书形（なる一方だ），不接ます形；にすぎない、ばかり接在「なり」后面都不成立。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: なりがち: meals easily become irregular. 一方だ takes the dictionary form (なる一方だ), not the masu-stem; にすぎない and ばかり cannot follow なり either.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 最近有点……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: A slight current condition, rather than repeated occurrences.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 说的是当下身体有一点疲惫，程度较轻，用「疲れ気味」。 补充：疲れがち也能说最近经常容易疲劳；疲れ気味则着重当下略有疲惫。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Target expression: 気味. Intended meaning: A slight current condition, rather than repeated occurrences. Compared alternatives: がち. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 最近有点……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: It's been a little...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 風邪気味是“有点感冒”的常用搭配，気味读ぎみ，表示略有某状态。不能只凭中文“有点发烧”生造「熱気味」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: 風邪気味 is an established expression meaning a slight cold. 気味 is read ぎみ and describes a slight condition. Do not invent 熱気味 simply from the idea of having a slight fever.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 动不动就……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: If you don't move...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「忘れっぽい」是很爱忘事的口语表达，接动词ます形词干。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: 忘れっぽい is a conversational expression for tending to forget. Attach っぽい to the verb's masu-stem.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 很有……那味
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: It's... it smells like...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 说成年人的说话方式很孩子气，名词「子供」后接「っぽい」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Attach っぽい to the noun 子供 to describe an adult's childish way of speaking.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 越来越……，一路往这个方向走
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: It's getting... it's going this way.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 失业率沿上升方向持续变化，中性描述单向趋势用「一方だ」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: The unemployment rate continues to rise. Use 一方だ for a neutral description of a one-way trend.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 越来越……，一路往这个方向走
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: It's getting... it's going this way.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 持续练习让演奏水平不断提高，说好变化也可用相对中性的「一方だ」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Continued practice steadily improves performance. The relatively neutral 一方だ can also describe positive change.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 只会越来越……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: It's only getting...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 如果不采取对策，情况只会继续恶化，带有无奈和担忧的「ばかりだ」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: If no response is taken, the situation will only continue to deteriorate and the " ばかりだ " , which has a sense of hopelessness and concern.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 只会越来越……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: It's only getting...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 不修缮的话建筑只会越来越旧，说话人对这个不良趋势带有忧虑。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: The building will only grow old without renovation, and the speaker is concerned about this negative trend.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 一直……着也不管
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: I don't care.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 门打开后本该关上，却一直开着就出门了，用「開けっぱなし」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: The door should have been closed, but was left open when the person went out. Use 開けっぱなし.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 一直……着也不管
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: I don't care.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 申请文件放在桌上后一直没处理，「置きっぱなし」带有放着不管的语气。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: The application papers were left on the desk without being dealt with. 置きっぱなし implies leaving them unattended.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「按理说应该……」——拿已知信息推，不是凭感觉。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: “By rights it should…” — reasoned from known facts, not felt.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 根据既有信息、常识、计划或时间表推出结论，说话人认为这个结论在道理上站得住。中文的“应该”多半对应它。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: A conclusion follows from known facts, common sense, a plan or a timetable, and the speaker holds that it stands to reason. Most Chinese 应该 maps here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 普通形＋はずだ（な形容词＋な；名词＋の）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Plain form + はずだ (na-adjective + な; noun + の)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 三个“应该”要分清：「はずだ」是按信息推理，「べきだ」是讲责任与规范，「に違いない」是几乎不怀疑的断定。中文都写“应该”，日文的依据完全不同。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Three kinds of should: はずだ reasons from information, べきだ speaks of duty and norms, に違いない asserts with almost no doubt. Chinese writes 应该 for all three, but the grounds differ completely.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 他十点就出发了，按理说现在应该已经到了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: He left at ten, so he should be there by now.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 按地图看，车站应该就在前面。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: According to the map, the station should be just ahead.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 昨天寄的，今天应该到。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: I sent it yesterday, so it should arrive today.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「照理就该……」——从责任和规矩出发的“应该”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: “Ought to…” — the should of duty and rules.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 说话人从责任、道德、规则或正确做法的角度，判断某人该不该做某事。语气带规范意味，不是推测。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: The speaker judges what someone should or should not do on grounds of duty, morality, rules or correct practice. The tone is normative rather than predictive.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 动词辞书形＋べきだ（する→すべきだ／するべきだ）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Dictionary form + べきだ (する → すべきだ or するべきだ)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 比「ことだ」强得多：ことだ是“你最好这样”，べきだ是“照理就该这样”。对上级或陌生人直接说，容易像在教训人。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: It is much stronger than ことだ: ことだ says you would do best to, while べきだ says you are duty bound to. Said to a superior or a stranger it sounds like lecturing.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 答应别人的事照理就该做到。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Promises ought to be kept.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 自己的意见应该自己说出来。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: You should speak up for your own views.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 不该说别人坏话。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: You should not speak ill of others.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「最好……」——针对眼前的问题给一条实用建议。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: “You'd do best to…” — one practical piece of advice for a concrete problem.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 这是 Day 5 的复习点。面对具体困扰，给出一个可操作的做法，语气像过来人，不带规范压力。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: This revisits Day 5. Faced with a concrete problem, it offers one workable move in the voice of someone who has been there, with no moral pressure.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 动词辞书形／ない形＋ことだ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Dictionary form / ない-form + ことだ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 和「べきだ」的差别在立场：ことだ是“我给你出个主意”，べきだ是“你照规矩该这样”。劝朋友用前者，写社论用后者。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: The difference from べきだ is stance: ことだ offers an idea, べきだ holds you to a standard. Use the first with a friend and the second in an editorial.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 想尽快恢复的话，最好好好休息。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: If you want to get well quickly, rest properly.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 拿不定主意时，最好先自己查一查。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: When in doubt, look it up yourself first.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 不想求人的话，平时就要做好准备。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: If you do not want to depend on others, prepare in advance.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「准是……」——线索摆在那儿，几乎不怀疑。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: “Must be…” — the evidence is there and there is hardly any doubt.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 根据眼前的迹象或说话人的确信，强烈断定某事就是如此。中文常译“一定”“准是”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: From visible signs or the speaker's conviction, it asserts strongly that this is so. Chinese usually renders it 一定 or 准是.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 普通形／名词＋に違いない（な形容词・名词通常不加だ）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Plain form / noun + に違いない (na-adjectives and nouns usually drop だ)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 和「はずだ」比，它更主观；和「に決まっている」比，它稍微讲点依据。はずだ重推理，に違いない重确信，に決まっている重态度。三者有交叉，别把某一条线索当成唯一答案。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: It is more subjective than はずだ and offers slightly more evidence than に決まっている. はずだ leans on reasoning, に違いない on conviction, に決まっている on attitude. They overlap, so no single clue settles the choice.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 灯亮着，里面准是有人。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: The light is on — someone must be inside.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 这笔迹准是他的。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: This handwriting must be his.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 练得那么苦，准能拿冠军。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: With all that practice, they must win.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「肯定就是……，这还用说」——不摆推理，直接下结论。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: “Obviously…” — no reasoning shown, just the verdict.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 凭信念、经验或常识斩钉截铁地断定，常带情绪，甚至有点不耐烦。句尾语气很硬。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: The speaker settles it flatly on belief, experience or common sense, often with feeling and a hint of impatience. The ending is blunt.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 普通形／名词＋に決まっている（な形容词・名词通常不加だ）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Plain form / noun + に決まっている (na-adjectives and nouns usually drop だ)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 它不展示推理链，直接说“肯定是这样”，所以语气比「はずだ」强得多，不适合需要谨慎、留余地的场合，比如向上级汇报调查结果。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: It shows no chain of reasoning and simply declares that it must be so, which makes it far stronger than はずだ and unfit for settings that need caution, such as reporting findings to a superior.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 那种天上掉馅饼的好事肯定是假的，这还用说。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: A deal that good is obviously a lie.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 每天练，肯定会变好。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Practise every day and of course you will improve.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 他要是不来，肯定就没意思了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: If he does not come, it will obviously be dull.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「恐怕有……的风险」——官方口吻的风险提示。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: “There is a risk that…” — the official way to flag danger.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 客观、正式地提示某个不良事件可能发生，用于天气、医疗、产品警示、新闻和官方说明。句中不出现说话人的情绪。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: It flags objectively and formally that something bad may happen, in weather reports, medical notes, product warnings, news and official statements. The speaker's feelings stay out of it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 动词辞书形／名词＋の＋おそれがある
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Dictionary form / noun + の + おそれがある

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「おそれがある」是公式提示，「かねない」是说话人按当前趋势发出警告。天气预报用前者，劝人别硬来用后者。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: おそれがある is an official warning while かねない is the speaker warning from a present trend. Weather forecasts use the first; telling someone to stop before it is too late uses the second.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 今晚恐怕有降下大雪的风险。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: There is a risk of heavy snow tonight.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 这种药有产生副作用的风险。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: This medicine carries a risk of side effects.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 大雨可能导致河流泛滥。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: The heavy rain may cause the river to flood.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「搞不好会……」——照这样下去，坏结果真有可能。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: “Could well…” — carry on like this and the bad outcome is real.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 从现在的做法或趋势看，一个不好的结果完全有可能发生。说话人用它警告对方或表达担忧，后项基本是坏结果。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Given the current course, an unwanted outcome is entirely possible. It warns or worries, and the second half is almost always bad.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 动词ます形去ます＋かねない
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Masu-stem + かねない

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 形式上有「ない」，意思却是“有可能”，这是最大的陷阱。而且不能用来预测好事——说「合格しかねない」是错的。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: It looks negative but means possibly will, which is the biggest trap. It also cannot predict good news: 合格しかねない is wrong.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 这样下去，搞不好会酿成大事故。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Carry on like this and it could turn into a serious accident.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 那么硬撑，搞不好会把身体搞坏。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Push yourself that hard and you could ruin your health.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 疏于确认的话，搞不好会出大错。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Skip the checks and you could make a serious mistake.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 按理说应该……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: It's supposed to be...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 根据在日本工作五年这条信息，推理他按理会说日语，用「はずだ」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: On the basis of the information that he worked in Japan for five years, it was reasoned that he spoke Japanese and used " はずだ " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 按理说应该……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: A reasonable inference based on the stated evidence.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 根据地图上的时间做出合理推测，不是说对方有义务到达。 补充：に決まっている可表达更强的主观确信；はずだ更贴合根据地图计算路程的推理。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Target expression: はずだ. Intended meaning: A reasonable inference based on the stated evidence. Compared alternatives: に決まっている. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 照理就该……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: A duty or norm, rather than personal advice.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 按照责任和规则，借来的东西就应该如期归还，用「べきだ」。 补充：返すことだ也能直接给建议；返すべきだ更强调归还借物的规范与责任。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Target expression: べきだ. Intended meaning: A duty or norm, rather than personal advice. Compared alternatives: ことだ. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 照理不应该……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: An admonition about the proper course of action.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 从应有做法的角度劝阻独断，用「べきではない」。はずではない表示与预期不符；おそれ要用「おそれがある」；しだい接名词或ます形，「決めるしだいではない」不成立。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: べきではない says you should not decide alone. はずではない means things were not supposed to be so; おそれ takes おそれがある; しだい follows a noun or masu-stem, so 決めるしだいではない is ungrammatical.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 最好……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Practical advice for this particular problem, without a strong moral obligation.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 面对感冒如何早点好的具体问题，给出“最好早睡”的建议，用「ことだ」。 补充：寝るべきだ也是建议，但更强硬；具体养病建议用ことだ通常更合适。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Target expression: ことだ. Intended meaning: Practical advice for this particular problem, without a strong moral obligation. Compared alternatives: べきだ. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 准是……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: It's probably...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「きっと」结合鞋子这个线索，表达很有把握的推断，选に違いない。べきだ表达规范、ことだ表达建议，均不等于这里的行踪推断。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: きっと and the clue provided by the shoes indicate a confident inference, so use に違いない. べきだ expresses an obligation and ことだ gives advice; neither expresses this inference about someone's whereabouts.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 肯定就是……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: The speaker's emphatic subjective certainty, rather than a mere possibility.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 说话人以强烈、口语的方式断定便宜的名牌货肯定是假的，名词直接接「に決まっている」。 补充：のはずだ表达推断；のおそれがある只说有假货风险；に決まっている是强烈断定，不能把价格低当成已经证实假货。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Target expression: に決まっている. Intended meaning: The speaker's emphatic subjective certainty, rather than a mere possibility. Compared alternatives: のはずだ / のおそれがある. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 肯定就是……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: It's definitely...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: “他”以很强的主观确信说自己的队伍肯定会赢，用「に決まっている」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: He is strongly convinced that his team will win. Use に決まっている.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 恐怕有……风险
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: A formal warning of a possible risk, without claiming certainty.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 这是对道路结冰的正式风险提示，像天气或交通公告，用「おそれがある」。 补充：に決まっている是强烈断定会结冰；おそれがある仅说明风险，天气提醒中更合适。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Target expression: おそれがある. Intended meaning: A formal warning of a possible risk, without claiming certainty. Compared alternatives: に決まっている. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 恐怕有……风险
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: I'm afraid there's a risk.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 产品警示中客观说明可能起火，名词「発火」后用「のおそれがある」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: A product warning objectively states a risk of fire. Attach のおそれがある to the noun 発火.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 搞不好会……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Maybe...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 如果继续隐瞒，搞不好会让整个公司失去信誉，用动词ます形词干「失い」接「かねない」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Continued concealment might cost the whole company its credibility. Attach かねない to the masu-stem 失い.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 搞不好会……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Maybe...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 警告鲁莽驾驶可能酿成重大事故，「起こし」后接「かねない」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Reckless driving may cause a serious accident. Attach かねない to 起こし.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 「不管……都……」——条件怎么变，结果不变。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: “Regardless of…” — change the condition, the result stays.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 前项的差别、条件或选项不影响后项，所有情况得到同样结果。常接「年齢」「性別」「天候」「理由」这类可变的分类。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Differences, conditions or options in the first half make no difference to the second, and every case gets the same result. It takes variables such as age, sex, weather or reason.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 名词／相对词组／动词辞书形・ない形＋にかかわらず
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Noun / paired terms / dictionary or ない-form + にかかわらず

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 和 Day 8 的「にもかかわらず」只差一个「も」，意思完全不同：有「も」是“尽管 A 居然 B”，没有「も」是“不管 A，B 都一样”。考试最爱在这里设陷阱。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: One も separates it from Day 8's にもかかわらず, and the meaning flips: with も it means despite A, B happened; without も it means whatever A, B is the same. Exams love to hide the trap here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 不管年龄多大，任何人都可以报名。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Anyone may apply, regardless of age.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 不管天气如何，比赛照常举行。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: The match will go ahead whatever the weather.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 不管有没有理由，都不允许缺席。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Absence is not permitted, with or without a reason.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 「不论……一概……」——正式宣告不作限制。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: “Irrespective of…” — a formal declaration that a criterion does not apply.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 正式地宣布某个分类标准不作限制，凡符合其他条件的人或情况一概适用。招聘、活动、公告里最常见。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: It formally announces that a category is not a restriction, so anyone or anything meeting the other conditions qualifies. It is most common in recruitment, events and notices.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 名词＋を問わず
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Noun + を問わず

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 意思接近「にかかわらず」，但更书面、更像招聘广告。常见搭配是固定的：年齢・性別・国籍・経験の有無を問わず。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Close to にかかわらず but more formal and more like a job ad. The collocations are fixed: 年齢・性別・国籍・経験の有無を問わず.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 不论有无经验，一概可以报名。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: You may apply whether or not you have experience.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 不分性别，很多人参加了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Many people took part, regardless of gender.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 不论星期几，随时联系我。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Contact me any day of the week.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 「……先不说」——A 暂时不评价，重点转到 B。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: “Setting A aside…” — A goes unjudged while B takes the focus.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 暂时不评价 A，或不把 A 当作当前重点，转而强调更值得关注的 B。多用于比较评价：A 姑且不论，B 至少如何。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: A is left unjudged or off the agenda while B, the more important point, is emphasised. It usually compares: whatever A may be, B at least is such and such.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 名词／普通形＋の＋はともかく
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Noun / plain form + の + はともかく

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 和「はさておき」比，它更常带评价：“价格先不说，质量很好”。はさておき则更像主持人把话题挪开，不一定要比较优劣。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Compared with はさておき it more often carries an evaluation: never mind the price, the quality is good. はさておき is more like a host moving a topic aside and need not compare better or worse.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 价格先不说，质量确实很好。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Never mind the price — the quality is excellent.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 卖相先不说，味道我保证。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Never mind how it looks; I guarantee the taste.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 结果先不说，你已经很努力了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Whatever the result, you worked hard.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 「……先放一边」——把话题挪开，进正题。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: “Let's leave A aside” — move the topic and get to business.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 有意识地把当前话题 A 暂时搁置，为更重要或更正式的话题 B 腾出位置。话题操作的意味很强。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: The current topic A is deliberately parked so that a more important or more formal topic B can take its place. The sense of managing the conversation is strong.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 名词／普通形＋の＋はさておき
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Noun / plain form + の + はさておき

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 典型场景是「冗談はさておき、本題に入りましょう」。它不一定要比较 A 和 B 哪个更好，只是把 A 挪开——这点和「はともかく」不同。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: The typical setting is 冗談はさておき、本題に入りましょう. It need not weigh A against B at all, only move A aside, which is where it differs from はともかく.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 玩笑先放一边，我们进入正题吧。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Jokes aside, let us get to the point.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 费用先放一边，先考虑安全性吧。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Let us put cost aside and think about safety first.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 名字先不管，这道菜很好吃。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Never mind the name — this dish is delicious.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 「不过就是……」——把被看重的压回它真实的分量。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: “Nothing more than…” — presses something back down to its real weight.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 把对方可能看得过重的人、事、数量或判断压回有限范围：它没有超出 A。带弱化语气，常用于自谦或降温。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: It presses a person, thing, quantity or judgement that may have been overrated back into a limited range: it goes no further than A. The tone deflates, and it serves for modesty or cooling things down.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 名词／普通形＋にすぎない
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Noun / plain form + にすぎない

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 方向是弱化：“别把它想得太重，不过就是 A”。和「にほかならない」正好相反——那个是强化与聚焦：“本质上正是 A”。同一件事用两者说，评价完全相反。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: It deflates: do not take it too seriously, it is only A. It is the opposite of にほかならない, which intensifies and focuses: it is precisely A. The same fact takes either, with opposite evaluations.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 这不过就是我个人的看法。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: This is nothing more than my personal opinion.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 他不过还是个新人。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: He is still only a newcomer.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 原因不过是个误会。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: The cause was nothing more than a misunderstanding.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 「说白了就是……／正是……」——排除别的解释，锁定本质。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: “Nothing other than…” — rules out other explanations and pins the essence.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 把事物的真正原因、核心或本质精确锁定为 A。语气坚定，常用于议论、演讲、结论句。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: It pins the true cause, core or essence precisely on A. The tone is firm, and it belongs to argument, speeches and conclusions.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 名词＋にほかならない；原因句常用「～のは、～からにほかならない」
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Noun + にほかならない; causal sentences often take ～のは、～からにほかならない

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 和「にすぎない」是一对反向表达：一个限制价值（不过是），一个强调本质（正是）。判断标准是说话人想把这件事说小还是说重。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: It is the mirror of にすぎない: one limits the value (only), the other stresses the essence (precisely). The test is whether the speaker wants to play the thing down or play it up.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 成功的原因，说白了正是每天的努力。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: The reason for the success is nothing other than daily effort.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 他生气，说到底是因为他想被信任。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: He was angry for no other reason than wanting to be trusted.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 这个结果，正是准备不足的体现。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: This result is nothing but a symptom of inadequate preparation.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 不管……都……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: A condition that makes no difference to eligibility.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 有没有经验不影响起点，所有人都从同一基础课开始。前面是完整问句形式，用「にかかわらず」。 补充：はともかく是暂时不讨论经验；にかかわらず明确表示不把经验作为分班条件。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Target expression: にかかわらず. Intended meaning: A condition that makes no difference to eligibility. Compared alternatives: はともかく. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 不管……都……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: A condition that makes no difference to the decision.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 下雨还是不下雨都不影响比赛举行，相对条件后用「にかかわらず」。 补充：はさておき可先搁置天气话题再说明比赛安排；にかかわらず明确表示天气不影响决定。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Target expression: にかかわらず. Intended meaning: A condition that makes no difference to the decision. Compared alternatives: はさておき. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 不论……一概……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: A formal statement that nationality is not a restriction.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 比赛规则正式声明不限国籍，名词「国籍」后用公告式的「を問わず」。 补充：はともかく可暂不讨论国籍；を問わず直接说明没有国籍限制。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Target expression: を問わず. Intended meaning: A formal statement that nationality is not a restriction. Compared alternatives: はともかく. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 不论……一概……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: A formal statement that age and gender are not restrictions.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 招聘信息中正式表示不论年龄和性别，「を問わず」最符合公告语气。 补充：はさておき可先放下年龄性别的话题；を問わず更明确是招聘条件不限制这些因素。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Target expression: を問わず. Intended meaning: A formal statement that age and gender are not restrictions. Compared alternatives: はさておき. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: ……先不说
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: I'm not going to say anything.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 设计好不好暂且不评价，转而强调电脑的性能好。题干已有「は」，补「ともかく」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Designs are not yet evaluated, instead they emphasize the performance of computers. The subject has been "は" and is supplemented by "ともかく. "

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: ……先不说
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: I'm not going to say anything.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 方法正不正确先不说，至少结果已经出现。题干已有「は」，补「ともかく」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: The method is not correct, at least the results have already appeared. The subject has been "は" and added "ともかく " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: ……先放一边
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: ...and put it aside first.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 主动把费用话题暂时搁置，把讨论转到能否实现上，用「はさておき」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Take the initiative to put the issue of costs on hold and move the discussion to whether it is possible to do so, using "はさておき " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: ……先放一边
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: ...and put it aside first.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 把开场铺垫暂时放到一边，要求直接说结论，是主动转换话题的「はさておき」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Putting the opening mat aside for the time being and asking for a direct conclusion is " はさておき " , which changes the subject.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 不过就是……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: It's just...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 「伝えたにすぎない」把行为限定为转达。にほかならない通常接名词／名词化表达，如「伝えただけということにほかならない」，不能用无名词化的动词句机械替换。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: 伝えたにすぎない limits the action to passing on a message. にほかならない normally follows a noun or nominalized expression, such as 伝えただけということにほかならない. Do not mechanically replace it after a non-nominalized verb clause.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 不过就是……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Only a personal opinion, downplaying its authority.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 将发言限定为个人意见，不要当成组织立场，是弱化的「にすぎない」。 补充：にほかならない强调“本质就是个人意见”；にすぎない弱化意见的权威与代表性。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Target expression: にすぎない. Intended meaning: Only a personal opinion, downplaying its authority. Compared alternatives: にほかならない. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 正是……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: That's right.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 「～のは、～からにほかならない」强调成功的真正原因。这里需要完整的原因形式，不能把「のは」与一个孤立的名词原因机械拼起来。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: In ～のは、～からにほかならない, the clause before から states the real reason. A complete reason clause is needed; an isolated noun cannot simply be inserted into that position.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 说白了就是……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: An emphatic identification of the essential cause.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.zh: 强调失败的本质正是准备不足造成的，用「にほかならない」。はさておき、にかかわらず、に先立って后面都必须再接句子，不能结句。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.15-scope.en: にほかならない: the failure is nothing other than the result of poor preparation. はさておき, にかかわらず and に先立って all need a following clause and cannot end the sentence.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.0.zh: 一类动词（五段）：词尾在う段。以る结尾也可能是一类，例如帰る、入る、走る、切る、知る、要る。不能只看到る就判定二类。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.0.en: Group 1 (godan): the final kana has a u-vowel. Some verbs ending in る also belong here: 帰る, 入る, 走る, 切る, 知る and 要る. A final る alone does not identify Group 2.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.0.zh: 二类动词（一段）：辞书形通常以「い段＋る」或「え段＋る」结尾，变形时去掉る。食べる、見る、起きる、借りる都是二类；记单词时一起记类别。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.0.en: Group 2 (ichidan): dictionary forms usually end in an i- or e-vowel plus る. Remove る when conjugating. 食べる, 見る, 起きる and 借りる are Group 2. Learn the group with each verb.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.0.zh: 三类动词（不规则）：する、来る，以及勉強する等「名词＋する」。来る的读音会变：くる、きます、こない，不能只看汉字。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.0.en: Group 3 (irregular): する, 来る and compounds such as 勉強する. The reading of 来る changes: くる, きます, こない. The kanji alone does not show the change.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.0.zh: 只知道「～ます」时，先查回辞书形和类别。「切ります」来自一类切る；「借ります」来自二类借りる，两者不能套用同一规则。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.0.en: If you only know the ます form, check the dictionary form and group first. 切ります comes from Group 1 切る, but 借ります comes from Group 2 借りる. They follow different rules.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 「未然形」「連用形」这些名字来自日本学校的语法，JLPT 的语法书和词典也常这么叫。教材（みんなの日本語等）习惯按用途叫「ない形」「ます形」——两套名字指的是同一批词尾变化，先记住对照表，再看后面每一种形。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Names such as 未然形 and 連用形 come from the grammar taught in Japanese schools, and JLPT references and dictionaries use them too. Textbooks like みんなの日本語 name the same endings by their use (ない形, ます形). Learn the mapping first, then the forms.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 以「書く」为例：未然形＝書か（接ない）／書こ（接う）；連用形＝書き（接ます・て・た）；終止形＝書く（结句）；連体形＝書く（接名词）；仮定形＝書け（接ば）；命令形＝書け。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: With 書く: 未然形 = 書か (before ない) / 書こ (before う); 連用形 = 書き (before ます, て, た); 終止形 = 書く (ends a sentence); 連体形 = 書く (before a noun); 仮定形 = 書け (before ば); 命令形 = 書け.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 未然形是「还没发生」的那半截：后面接ない、ぬ、う・よう、れる・られる、せる・させる。一类把词尾换到ア段（書く→書か、買う→買わ），要接「う」时换オ段（書こう）；二类去掉る（食べる→食べ）；する→し／さ／せ，来る→こ。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: The 未然形 is the "not yet happened" stem: it takes ない, ぬ, う/よう, れる/られる, せる/させる. Group 1 shifts the final kana to the a-row (書く→書か, 買う→買わ) and to the o-row before う (書こう); Group 2 drops る (食べる→食べ); する→し/さ/せ, 来る→こ.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 連用形接「ます」，也接「て」「た」「たい」「ながら」。一类换到イ段（書く→書き），二类去掉る（食べる→食べ），する→し，来る→き。注意て形还有促音便、イ音便，光看連用形推不出来（書く→書いて）。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: The 連用形 takes ます, and also て, た, たい, ながら. Group 1 shifts to the i-row (書く→書き), Group 2 drops る (食べる→食べ), する→し, 来る→き. The て form also has sound changes, so 連用形 alone does not predict it (書く→書いて).

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 終止形就是辞书形，用来结句：「行く。」「食べる。」现代日语里它和連体形同形，所以很多教材干脆只叫「辞書形」。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: The 終止形 is the dictionary form and ends a sentence: 行く。食べる。 In modern Japanese it has the same shape as the 連体形, which is why many textbooks simply call it the dictionary form.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 連体形接名词：「書く本」「食べる人」「来る日」。现代日语里和終止形同形，只有形容动词和部分助动词不同（だ→な）。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: The 連体形 modifies a noun: 書く本, 食べる人, 来る日. In modern Japanese it is the same shape as the 終止形; only na-adjectives and some auxiliaries differ (だ→な).

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 仮定形只接「ば」：一类换到エ段（書く→書けば），二类加れば（食べれば），する→すれば，来る→くれば。行く在这里是规则的：行けば。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: The 仮定形 only takes ば: Group 1 shifts to the e-row (書く→書けば), Group 2 adds れば (食べれば), する→すれば, 来る→くれば. 行く is regular here: 行けば.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 命令形：一类换到エ段（書け），二类加ろ（食べろ），する→しろ／せよ，来る→こい。语气很硬，只对平辈、下级或喊口号时用；礼貌请求用「てください」。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: The 命令形: Group 1 shifts to the e-row (書け), Group 2 adds ろ (食べろ), する→しろ/せよ, 来る→こい. It is blunt, used to subordinates, equals, or in slogans; use てください for polite requests.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.2.zh: 辞书形是词典里的形式，也叫原形；不是一律去ます后加る。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.2.en: The dictionary form is the form used as a dictionary headword. Do not simply replace every ます with る.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.2.zh: 「見ます→見る」不是一类变化。接こと、前に、ように等时，要确认句型要求的是辞书形还是普通形。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.2.en: 見ます → 見る is a Group 2 change. Check whether the sentence pattern requires the dictionary form specifically or any plain form.
I brush my teeth before going to bed.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.2.zh: 去ます，把最后一个い段假名改为同一行的う段。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.2.en: Remove ます, then change the final i-vowel kana to the u-vowel kana in the same row.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.2.zh: 去ます，直接加る；不要再把词干里的假名改成う段。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.2.en: Remove ます and add る. Do not alter the last kana of the stem.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.2.zh: 不按前两类推算，记住固定对应。

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.3.zh: 先做出ます词干，再根据肯定、否定及时间选择词尾。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.3.en: Build the stem first, then choose the ending for polarity and tense.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.3.zh: 「ます」既可表示习惯，也可表示将来，时间由语境决定。「ましょう」用ます词干＋ましょう；邀请「ませんか」用ます词干＋ませんか。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.3.en: ます can express habits or future events depending on context. For a suggestion, attach ましょう to the stem; for an invitation, attach ませんか.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.3.zh: 昨天没有学习，今天会学习。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.3.en: I did not study yesterday. I will study today.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.3.zh: 辞书形最后的う段假名改为同一行い段，再加ます。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.3.en: Change the final u-vowel kana to its i-vowel counterpart and add ます.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.3.zh: 去掉辞书形的る，加ます。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.3.en: Remove the final る and add ます.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.3.zh: 记住する与来る的词干。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.3.en: Use the irregular stems of する and 来る.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.3.zh: 非过去肯定用ます，非过去否定用ません，过去肯定用ました，过去否定用ませんでした。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.3.en: Use ます for affirmative non-past, ません for negative non-past, ました for affirmative past, and ませんでした for negative past.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.4.zh: 「ます形去ます」指词干，不是辞书形，也不是て形。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.4.en: The ます stem is the ます form without ます. It is neither the dictionary form nor the て form.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.4.zh: たい、ながら、すぎる、やすい、にくい、そうだ（样态）、つつある、かねない等接ます词干，但各自的意思和适用语境不同。不要写「読みますながら」。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.4.en: たい, ながら, すぎる, やすい, にくい, appearance そうだ, つつある and かねない attach to the stem, but differ in meaning and usage. Do not write 読みますながら.
I cook while listening to music.
Make the ます form, then remove ます.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.4.zh: 去る得到词干，再接句型。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.4.en: Remove る to get the stem, then attach the pattern.
Use し for する and き for 来る.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.5.zh: 一类不能统一去ます加て，要从辞书形词尾判断音便；二类和三类另外处理。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.5.en: For Group 1, the dictionary ending determines the sound change. Group 2 and Group 3 follow separate rules.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.5.zh: 特例：行く→行って，不是行いて。用ます形记忆时，必须先知道类别：帰ります→帰って；借ります→借りて。て形本身不决定过去或现在。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.5.en: Exception: 行く → 行って, not 行いて. If starting from ます, identify the group first: 帰ります → 帰って, but 借ります → 借りて. The て form itself does not mark past versus present.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.5.zh: 请打开窗户。我现在正在看书。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.5.en: Please open the window. I am reading a book now.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.5.zh: 词尾变成って。这里只包含一类的る结尾动词。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.5.en: Replace the ending with って. The る rule here applies only to Group 1.
Replace the ending with んで.
Usually replace く with いて.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.5.zh: 把ぐ变成いで；注意用で，不是て。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.5.en: Replace ぐ with いで, using で rather than て.
Remove る and add て.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.5.zh: 行く不按「く→いて」变化，要单独记为行って。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.5.en: 行く does not follow the usual く → いて pattern. Memorize 行って.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.6.zh: 先掌握て形，再把末尾的て换成た、で换成だ。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.6.en: First build the て form, then replace final て with た or final で with だ.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.6.zh: 行く→行った。た形可表示过去，也用于「たことがある」「たり」「たほうがいい」等结构；不能把所有た形都简单译成“过去”。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.6.en: 行く becomes 行った. The た form also appears in たことがある, たり and たほうがいい; it does not always describe a past event.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.6.zh: う・つ・る→った；む・ぶ・ぬ→んだ；く→いた；ぐ→いだ；す→した。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.6.en: Use った for う・つ・る, んだ for む・ぶ・ぬ, いた for く, いだ for ぐ, and した for す.
Remove る and add た.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.6.zh: する→した；来る→来た，读きた。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.6.en: Use した for する and 来た (きた) for 来る.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.6.zh: 行く的过去形是行った，不是行いた。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.6.en: The past form of 行く is 行った, not 行いた.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.7.zh: 一类换あ段，二类去る，三类单独记。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.7.en: Group 1 changes to an a-vowel; Group 2 drops る; Group 3 is irregular.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.7.zh: ある的否定是ない，不是あらない。接「なければ」「なくても」时，把整个ない换掉：書かない→書かなければ／書かなくても。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.7.en: The negative of ある is ない, not あらない. To build なければ or なくても, replace the whole ない: 書かない → 書かなければ／書かなくても.
I intend not to go to school tomorrow.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.7.zh: 词尾う段改成同一行あ段，加ない；但词尾う要变わ。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.7.en: Change the final u-vowel kana to its a-vowel counterpart and add ない. Final う changes to わ.
Remove る and add ない.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.7.zh: する变しない；来る变来ない，读こない。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.7.en: Use しない for する and 来ない (こない) for 来る.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.8.zh: 先完成ない形，再把ない的い变成かった。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.8.en: Build the ない form first, then replace its final い with かった.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.8.zh: 礼貌体对应「ませんでした」，普通体对应「なかった」。不要写「書くなかった」。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.8.en: The polite counterpart is ませんでした; the plain past negative is なかった. 書くなかった is incorrect.
I did not do my homework yesterday.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.8.zh: 不要从辞书形直接硬接なかった；先根据类别做出ない。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.8.en: Do not attach なかった directly to a dictionary form. First form the appropriate negative.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.8.zh: ある→ない，再按ない→なかった变化。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.8.en: Start with the irregular negative ない, then change it to なかった.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.9.zh: 动词普通形包括非过去肯定、非过去否定、过去肯定、过去否定四种。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.9.en: A verb has four basic plain forms: affirmative non-past, negative non-past, affirmative past and negative past.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.9.zh: 动词普通形后不加だ：行くと思う，不是行くだと思う。名词和な形容词的普通形规则不同，不要套到动词上。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.9.en: Do not add だ after a plain verb: 行くと思う, not 行くだと思う. Nouns and な-adjectives have different plain-form rules.
Tanaka said they would not come tomorrow.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.9.zh: 依次使用辞书形、ない形、た形、なかった形；先确定要表达的时间和肯定／否定。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.9.en: Choose the dictionary, ない, た or なかった form according to tense and polarity.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.9.zh: 接と思う、と言う、し或修饰名词时，保留所需的普通形，再接后面的词。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.9.en: For と思う, と言う, し or noun modification, choose the appropriate plain form before attaching the rest.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 表达能力或条件上的可能；不是把所有动词都加られる。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: This form expresses ability or the possibility of an action. Not every verb takes られる.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 本页使用教材标准形式「食べられる／来られる」。口语的食べれる、来れる属于ら抜き。見える／聞こえる通常表示自然看见／听见，不能当作見る／聞く的机械可能形。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: This guide uses standard textbook 食べられる／来られる. Colloquial 食べれる／来れる omit ら. 見える／聞こえる usually describe something being visible/audible; they are not the mechanically formed potentials of 見る／聞く.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 我能读日文报纸。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: I can read Japanese newspapers.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 词尾う段变同一行え段，再加る。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Change the final u-vowel kana to its e-vowel counterpart and add る.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 去る，加られる。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Remove る and add られる.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: する→できる；来る→来られる，读こられる。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Use できる for する and 来られる (こられる) for 来る.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 可能形变成二类方式继续活用：去る后接ない／ます。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Conjugate the resulting potential verb like Group 2: remove る before ない or ます.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 普通体意向形常接と思う、と思っている、とする。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: The plain volitional form often precedes と思う, と思っている or とする.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 礼貌的提议用ます词干＋ましょう。書く→書こう，不能从書きます直接拼成書きよう。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: For a polite suggestion, use the ます stem plus ましょう. 書く becomes 書こう, not 書きよう.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 我打算周末在图书馆学习。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: I am planning to study at the library this weekend.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 词尾う段变同一行お段，加う。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Change the final u-vowel kana to its o-vowel counterpart and add う.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 去る，加よう。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Remove る and add よう.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: する→しよう；来る→来よう，读こよう。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Use しよう for する and 来よう (こよう) for 来る.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 命令形和禁止形是两套规则。语气强，先学会辨认标语和紧急指示。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Commands and prohibitions use different rules. Their tone is strong; learn to recognize them in signs and urgent instructions.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 帰れ是命令，帰れる是可能；食べるな是禁止，不是食べない。礼貌请求通常用てください／ないでください。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: 帰れ is a command; 帰れる is potential. 食べるな is a prohibition, distinct from the negative 食べない. Polite requests normally use てください／ないでください.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 不要在这里停车。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Do not park here.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 词尾う段改同一行え段，不加る。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Change the final u-vowel kana to its e-vowel counterpart; do not add る.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 去る，加ろ。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Remove る and add ろ.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 记住しろ／せよ和来い。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Use the irregular しろ／せよ and 来い.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 辞书形原样保留，直接加な。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Keep the dictionary form unchanged and add な.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 肯定动词和否定动词的变化入口不同。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Affirmative and negative conditions start from different forms.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 「行けば」不是「行きば」。ば、たら、なら、とは不能随意互换；这里先解决形态，具体条件语感看本课文法。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Use 行けば, not 行きば. ば, たら, なら and と are not interchangeable; consult the lesson explanation for their differences in meaning.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 每天练习的话，就会进步。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: If you practice every day, you will improve.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 词尾う段改え段，加ば。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Change the final u-vowel kana to its e-vowel counterpart and add ば.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 去る，加れば。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Remove る and add れば.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: する→すれば；来る→来れば，读くれば。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Use すれば for する and 来れば (くれば) for 来る.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 先变ない形，再把ない改成なければ。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Build the ない form, then replace ない with なければ.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 不要直接在辞书形后加たら；先完成た形或なかった形。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Do not attach たら directly to the dictionary form. Build the た or なかった form first.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 形式里有た，不等于事情已经发生：明日雨が降ったら说的是明天的条件。读んだら保留浊音だ。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: The た in this form does not mean the event has happened: 明日雨が降ったら describes a condition tomorrow. 読んだら keeps voiced だ.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 回到家以后，请打电话。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Please call when you get home.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 各类动词先变た形，再加ら。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: For every group, build the た form and add ら.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 先变ない，再变なかった，最后加ら。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Build ない, change it to なかった, then add ら.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 先变被动动词，再处理句子里谁受到谁的动作。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: First form the passive verb, then identify who is affected by whose action.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 二类和来る的可能形、被动形同形，要靠主语、助词和语境判断。一类可以直接对比：書ける＝能写，書かれる＝被写。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Group 2 and 来る have identical potential and passive forms; use subjects, particles and context to distinguish them. For Group 1: 書ける means can write, while 書かれる is passive.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 我受到了老师的表扬。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: I was praised by my teacher.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 词尾う段改あ段，加れる；う→わ。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Change the final u-vowel kana to its a-vowel counterpart and add れる; う becomes わ.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 去る，加られる。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Remove る and add られる.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: する→される；来る→来られる，读こられる。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Use される for する and 来られる (こられる) for 来る.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 被动形形成后按二类继续变。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Conjugate the resulting passive like Group 2.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 使役可以表达要求、允许或引发某种反应，不能只机械译成“强迫”。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: The causative can express instructions, permission or causing a reaction; it does not always mean forcing someone.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 注意三种不同形式：食べられる（被动／可能）、食べさせる（使役）、食べさせられる（使役受身）。句中动作对象仍用を时，被使役的人常用に。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Distinguish 食べられる (passive/potential), 食べさせる (causative) and 食べさせられる (causative-passive). When を marks the action’s object, the person made or allowed to act commonly takes に.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 老师让学生写了作文。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: The teacher had the students write an essay.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 词尾う段改あ段，加せる；う→わ。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Change the final u-vowel kana to its a-vowel counterpart and add せる; う becomes わ.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 去る，加させる。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Remove る and add させる.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: する→させる；来る→来させる，读こさせる。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Use させる for する and 来させる (こさせる) for 来る.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 使役动词按二类处理：去末尾る，加て，才能接ください／もらう／いただく。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Treat the causative as Group 2: remove final る and add て before ください, もらう or いただく.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 先做使役形，再把使役动词变成被动形。先掌握完整形式，再记常见缩略。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Build the causative first, then make that verb passive. Learn the full forms before the common contractions.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 主语是被要求做动作的人。使役＋てもらう是“获得允许／请对方让自己做”，不要与使役受身混为一谈。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: The subject is the person made to act. Causative + てもらう expresses receiving permission or arranging to be allowed to act; it is not the causative-passive.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 我被老师要求写了作文。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: I was made to write an essay by my teacher.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: あ段词干＋せる，再把せる变せられる。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Use the a-vowel stem plus せる, then change せる to せられる.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.zh: 多数非す结尾的一类动词可把せられる缩成される。す结尾不按此缩。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.1.en: Many Group 1 verbs not ending in す shorten せられる to される. Do not apply this contraction to verbs ending in す.
